HTML:
Vuoi essere al centro di prospettive di crescita uniche?

Entra all’interno del team di Customer di PwC e diventa:

Customer Data Scientist | Senior Associate

Your Perspectives 

Ti unirai al gruppo di Customer di PwC su sfidanti progetti di Customer Advance Analytics, Data Science e Generative AI in ambito Consumer Markets, Financial Services, Energy&Utilities e Telco&Media, per supportare le organizzazioni nel valorizzare il patrimonio informativo sui propri Clienti e Consumatori finali, utilizzando i dati a disposizione per sviluppare soluzioni innovative basate su AI. 

 

Grazie all’accesso alle vaste competenze del nostro network internazionale, potrai dare spazio alle tue idee e applicare su progettualità concrete le tue conoscenze analitiche fornendo il tuo contributo innovativo. 

 

Sarai coinvolto con crescenti responsabilità nelle seguenti attività: 

  • Disegno, sviluppo, test e misurazione delle performance di modelli di Machine Learning e di modelli statistici in ambito Marketing e Sales: segmentazioni, Customer scoring, modelli di classificazione, modelli predittivi, modelli di propensione/raccomandazione; 

  • Sviluppo e implementazione di tecniche di Generative AI per la creazione di soluzioni conversazionali innovative, utilizzando tecnologie basate su Large Language Model (LLM) e framework quali il Retrieval Augmented Generator (RAG). 

  • Analisi dati avanzate sul comportamento dei Clienti sia su canali fisici che digitali attraverso esplorazione di dati strutturati e non strutturati, al fine di ottenere insight di business;  

  • Sviluppo di analisi quantitative e modelli di Machine Learning a supporto di progettualità di data-driven Strategy & Decision Making, 

  • Raccolta dei requisiti progettuali a diretto contatto con il cliente per il disegno e l’implementazione di soluzioni data-driven ed AI-driven; 

 

Your unique strengths 

  • Possiedi una laurea magistrale preferibilmente ad indirizzo ingegneristico o scientifico (es. Data Science, Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria Matematica, Informatica, Statistica, Matematica, Fisica); 

  • Hai maturato esperienza di 3-4 anni in Aziende Leader nel proprio mercato di riferimento o in primarie Società di consulenza all’interno di progetti di Advance Analytics e Data Science in ambito Marketing; 

  • Hai un’ottima conoscenza del linguaggio Python; 

  • Possiedi una buona conoscenza dei database relazionali e del linguaggio SQL; 

  • Sei esperto nell’utilizzo di piattaforme Cloud come AWS, Azure e GCP; 

  • Conosci tecnologie basate su Large Language Model (LLM) e tecniche di Generative AI (RAG o PEFT) per lo sviluppo di applicazioni; nonché sperimentazione di framework agentici più avanzati (LangChain, AutoGen); 

  • Hai forti competenze analitiche e ti interessa usare i dati per trovare soluzioni funzionali, creative ed innovative a problemi complessi; 

  • Parli e scrivi in inglese fluentemente; 

  • Le tue ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative ti permettono di instaurare rapporti di fiducia con i clienti; 

  • Ti interessa lavorare in team, coordinare gruppi di lavoro, crescere professionalmente in un ambiente dinamico, stimolante e positivo; 

Per questa opportunità è previsto un inserimento con contratto al 1° livello CCNL Commercio con una retribuzione indicativa tra 36.000€-50.000€, la cui determinazione finale sarà definita anche in base alla valutazione delle tue competenze ed esperienze pregresse. In aggiunta, è prevista una componente variabile legata alla performance fino a un massimo del 10% della retribuzione.

Entrare in PwC significa anche poter contare su un ecosistema di iniziative e benefit pensati per supportare benessere, crescita e work-life integration, tra cui:

• Buoni pasto del valore di 8€
• Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa, estendibile ai familiari
• Piano welfare dedicato
• Programmi e iniziative di wellbeing
• Convenzioni

Title: Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Entra nel nostro mondo.

Trasforma insieme a noi.

QUANTITATIVE ANALYST

Quale sarà la tua sfida?

La figura si occuperà di:

Quantitative Development


Sviluppare repliche indipendenti ed efficienti in Python dei modelli di calcolo dei margini (VaR) utilizzati in produzione.
Approfondire e documentare tutti i dettagli metodologici, individuando e verificando eventuali disallineamenti rispetto ai modelli produttivi.
Effettuare root-cause analysis dei findings e valutarne l'impatto sui margini.
Costruire prototipi di modello flessibili, anche a supporto di migrazioni dati su larga scala, e mantenere il versioning del codice (Git).


 Risk Analyst


Produrre i report di Internal Model Validation.
Condurre input data analysis e verifica della soundness metodologica dei modelli.
Descrivere e quantificare gli errori presenti in produzione.
Eseguire e documentare Stress Test, Back Test e Sensitivity Test.


Sarai tu a entrare nel nostro team?

 Requisiti fondamentali


Da 3 a 6 anni di esperienza nel ruolo;
Laurea (Magistrale) in Ingegneria Matematica, Matematica, Fisica, Finanza Quantitativa, Statistica o discipline affini.
Solida padronanza della programmazione in Python applicata a contesti numerici/quantitativi.
Conoscenza dei fondamenti di finanza quantitativa e risk management (VaR, pricing di strumenti su Power/Energy/Commodities o asset class affini).
Mentalità analitica, precisione e rigore metodologico.
Basi di Machine Learning ed AI.


Plus


Esperienza con SQL e gestione/qualità del dato.
Familiarità con Git e pratiche di software engineering.
Esperienza in model validation, central counterparty clearing o contesti regolamentati.


Soft skills


Autonomia e flessibilità.
Capacità di documentare e comunicare in modo chiaro risultati tecnici complessi, anche verso interlocutori istituzionali.
Affidabilità, organizzazione e orientamento al dettaglio.
Buona conoscenza dell'inglese.


Perchè Bip?


Crescita e Formazione
Più di 300 corsi su tecnologie e business emergenti, programmi di sviluppo personalizzati e iniziative di training e people care per supportare la tua crescita professionale e personale.
 
Flessibilità e Work-Life Integration
Lavoro agile con possibilità di programmare le giornate da remoto e in ufficio con il proprio responsabile e in base alle esigenze di progetto, Banca Ore Solidale per usufruire o mettere a disposizione ore di permesso a colleghi e colleghe che vivono momenti di difficoltà e una cultura che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita e lavoro.
 
Salute & Benefits 
Assicurazione sanitaria, check-up agevolati, piattaforme per il benessere psicofisico e un piano welfare integrativo. Ticket restaurant e altri benefit dedicati.
 
Famiglia e Genitorialità
Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda.
 
Inclusione e Valori
Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99).


Cosa offriamo / What we offer

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra € 34.000 e € 48.000 lordi annui, in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di seniority del candidato.

L'inquadramento sarà definito durante il processo di selezione sulla base del profilo individuato e nel rispetto della normativa e del CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria

La retribuzione indicata si riferisce alla sola RAL (Retribuzione Annua Lorda).

Il pacchetto complessivo può includere ulteriori componenti variabili, correlate al raggiungimento di specifici obiettivi individuali e/o aziendali, welfare e benefit aziendali. La proposta economica finale sarà definita in base alle caratteristiche del profilo selezionato e alla coerenza con i requisiti della posizione.

Next Steps

Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente.

Se c’è un match con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, ti contatteremo per iniziare la nostra conoscenza reciproca.

Su di Noi

Nati nel 2003, abbiamo raccolto e valorizzato l’esperienza storica della consulenza e abbiamo aggiunto due ingredienti chiave: l’innovazione e la digitalizzazione.

Grazie a questo percorso siamo oggi oltre 5000 professionisti, presenti in 13 Paesi, con oltre 4500 progetti alle spalle e le conoscenze più all’avanguardia nell'ambito della Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Industry 4.0, IOT e di tutte le Disruptive Technologies che mettiamo a servizio di ogni settore di mercato.

Aiutiamo i nostri clienti a fare la differenza creando qualità su larga scala attraverso una formula che opera su tre leve: Valore, Persone e Tecnologia.

Crediamo nel valore dell’eccellenza, che è la bussola su cui orientiamo il nostro agire, e adottiamo un approccio etico e leale nei confronti di quante e quanti scelgono di lavorare con noi, promuovendo un ambiente in cui le persone possano crescere insieme, grazie alla contaminazione tra competenze diverse.

Title: AI & Data Engineer
Description:
Il nostro obiettivo è sempre stato quello di creare e ampliare nel tempo un gruppo di persone qualificato, affidabile e disponibile; puntando su professionisti esperti, ma anche sulla formazione, investendo risorse nella crescita professionale.

Dipendenti e collaboratori attraverso consolidate competenze tecniche, contribuiscono a rendere Craon un’azienda altamente qualificata e competitiva sul mercato ICT.

Cerchiamo un AI & Data Engineer con 3-5 anni di esperienza appassionato di dati e machine learning, pronto a lavorare su progetti end-to-end, dalle pipeline dati alla modellazione e deployment di modelli ML/AI su cloud.

Cosa farai:


Sviluppo di pipeline ETL/ELT e orchestrazione
Big Data processing e data engineering su Databricks e PySpark
Modellazione e addestramento di modelli ML (classification, regression, clustering)
Deployment e monitoraggio di modelli in produzione
Collaborazione con team Data, DevOps e Business per soluzioni scalabili



Competenze chiave:


Python (pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, PySpark), SQL avanzato, Bash, Git
Databricks, MLflow, Docker, CI/CD
Cloud: AWS, GCP, Azure (servizi dati e ML)

Title: AI Specialist
Description:
CEME Group è un'azienda leader a livello internazionale nella progettazione e produzione si sistemi e soluzioni per il passaggio di fluidi per applicazioni industriali, professionali e domestiche.

Per il nostro headquarter sito a Trivolzio (PV), siamo alla ricerca di un AI Specialist che contribuisca all'implementazione, alla governance e alla diffusione delle soluzioni AI all'interno dell'organizzazione.







🎯 Il ruolo




L'AI Specialist, a diretto riporto del Business Intelligence Manager, rappresenterà il punto di riferimento operativo per l'implementazione, il monitoraggio e l'evoluzione delle iniziative di Intelligenza Artificiale all'interno di CEME Group.

La figura lavorerà a stretto contatto con i team aziendali, le funzioni di business e i partner tecnologici esterni per garantire la corretta delivery delle soluzioni AI, il raggiungimento degli obiettivi progettuali e la loro adozione efficace da parte degli utenti finali.

Il ruolo prevede un coinvolgimento diretto sia nella gestione operativa dei progetti AI, dalla definizione degli use case al deployment delle soluzioni, sia nel monitoraggio delle performance e nella governance delle tecnologie implementate.







💼 Responsabilità principali




AI Solutions Implementation & Monitoring

Supportare la progettazione, lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di soluzioni basate su Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning e Generative AI.
Collaborare con team interni ed esterni per garantire il corretto rilascio delle soluzioni nei tempi e nelle modalità previste.
Monitorare le performance dei modelli AI attraverso KPI tecnici e di business (accuracy, precision, recall, drift, utilizzo e valore generato).
Garantire il corretto funzionamento delle soluzioni AI in esercizio e gestirne le attività di manutenzione evolutiva.
Identificare opportunità di miglioramento continuo e ottimizzazione delle performance.

Use Case Development & Business Support

Collaborare con le funzioni aziendali per identificare, analizzare e prioritizzare use case AI ad alto impatto.
Tradurre esigenze e requisiti di business in specifiche tecniche e modelli analitici.
Supportare l'intero ciclo di vita dei progetti AI, dalla fase di analisi alla messa in produzione.
Facilitare il dialogo tra stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici.
Supportare gli utenti finali nell'adozione delle nuove soluzioni attraverso attività di training e change management.

AI Governance & Best Practices

Contribuire alla definizione e all'applicazione delle linee guida aziendali relative all'utilizzo dell'Intelligenza Artificiale.
Supportare l'implementazione di policy e framework relativi a governance, sicurezza, compliance ed etica dell'AI.
Assicurare il rispetto degli standard aziendali e delle best practice di settore.
Promuovere la diffusione della cultura AI all'interno dell'organizzazione.
Collaborare alle iniziative di formazione e sensibilizzazione sui temi dell'AI







🎓 Requisiti




Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Data Science o discipline affini.
Esperienza di 3-5 anni in ambito Al / Machine Learning / Advanced Analytics.
Conoscenza di linguaggi e strumenti di sviluppo (es. Python, SQL, librerie ML).
Familiarità con piattaforme AI/ML e ambienti cloud (es. Azure Al, AWS, Google Cloud).
Conoscenza e utilizzo operativo di piattaforme di Al generativa e assistenti enterprise, come Microsoft Copilot, Claude e soluzioni analoghe, con capacità di valutarne applicabilità, limiti e modalità di adozione in contesti aziendali.
Conoscenza base di architetture dati e integrazione con sistemi aziendali (ERP, BI, Data Platform).
Conoscenza professionale della lingua inglese.







🧠 Soft skills




Forte orientamento al problem solving e al miglioramento continuo.
Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team cross-funzionali e multiculturali.
Capacità di gestione delle priorità e dei progetti.
Proattività, curiosità e forte interesse verso l'innovazione tecnologica.
Attitudine all'apprendimento continuo e all'aggiornamento professionale.







Contratto collettivo applicato: CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria

Livello di inserimento: B2

Fascia retributiva: 45.000 / 50.000 euro lordi

Title: Data Scientist – Senior Consultant
Description:
We are currently looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our Data & Analytics team.

This position is a unique opportunity to unlock insights contained in the data universe working in a dynamic and innovative environment.

We are looking for candidates with an international background that have experience and strong knowledge in Data Analytics applications in multi-disciplinary environments that provide real-world impact for organizations.

You will be based in our office in Milan (preferably) or in Turin.

Background & Experience


Master's Degree in Statistics, Finance, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or related area
4–5 years of experience in Data & Analytics, with proven ability to design and deliver data-driven solutions in business contexts


Technical Skills


Experience in developing and applying analytical models and machine learning techniques to solve real business problems (including both predictive and exploratory approaches)
Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with modern data science libraries and frameworks
Experience working with data across the full lifecycle, from data preparation and exploration to model development and deployment
Familiarity with working in cloud-based data and AI environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP), leveraging advanced analytics and scalable processing capabilities (e.g. Databricks or similar platforms)
Exposure to Generative AI and LLMs, including use cases such as text analysis, content generation, or process automation
Understanding of prompt engineering principles and ability to integrate LLM-based solutions into data and analytics workflows
Awareness of best practices in model lifecycle management, reproducibility and collaboration within data teams
Ability to understand business requirements and identify the best solution to achieve the expected outcome
Ability to handle an analytical project end-to-end, from business need understanding till results presentation
Ability to communicate both in Italian and English at all levels of the Organization (other European languages will be considered as a plus)
Experience in planning and coordination of project team activities maintaining challenging and collaborative environment
Ability to contribute to the management of a team-oriented environment
Experience in guiding or coaching junior team members within project delivery contexts
Willingness to continuously learn and research on new approach and technologies related to data management and analytics
Highly self-motivated, proactive
A collaborative mindset
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills


Personal Attributes


Highly self-motivated, proactive
A collaborative mindset
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills


You will have an advantage if, additionally, you have:


Previous Consulting and/or professional services experience

Experience with NLP and text mining

Ability to bridge business needs and technical implementation in data and analytics projects
Experience in identifying new business opportunities
Experience in answering to RFIs or RFPs concerning analytics topics or software selection


We want to offer you a unique experience!

You will work with other like-minded and creative individuals to develop new ideas that have the potential to make a real difference to the businesses we work with
You will have the opportunity to support the development of new business and service offerings
You will have the opportunity to build strong relationships with BearingPoint top management and companies you will be working with

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
Company Description

Moviri started as a research spinoff at Politecnico of Milan and was incubated at its startup accelerator.

Data and experimentation are part of our DNA: it is for this reason that we continuously focus on research, emerging ideas, and new technologies, routinely partnering with top academic and engineering research institutions.

Moviri Consulting is the first company of Moviri and its foundation. Moviri’s professionals use data, software, and insights to solve substantial business challenges for Fortune 500 corporations, multinational banks, global media conglomerates and some of the most respected brands in a variety of industries. The Moviri Consulting Performance Engineering team optimizes performance of IT systems to make them responsive, infinitely scalable, reliable, resilient and cost-effective.




What you'll do

As part of our AI Labs team, you'll contribute to projects ranging from traditional Machine Learning to the latest Generative AI applications.




Your responsibilities will include:

Designing and developing solutions based on Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI.
Building data pipelines for data collection, processing, and validation across multiple sources.
Developing, training, and optimizing advanced models for real-world use cases.
Deploying AI models and applications into production environments, ensuring reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to transform business challenges into impactful technology solutions.
Exploring new frameworks, tools, and methodologies while contributing to the continuous evolution of the team’s capabilities.
Working with cutting-edge technologies in Generative AI, Natural Language Processing, and Advanced Analytics.




Who we're looking for

We are seeking a curious, proactive employee with a genuine passion for technology.




Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM field.
Experience in software development and programming using Python, Java, C++, R, or similar languages.
Familiarity with Data Science and Machine Learning frameworks such as Pandas, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, Matplotlib, and FastAPI.
Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with Git, Agile methodologies, and CI/CD practices.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Knowledge of Big Data ecosystems, including Spark and Hadoop.
Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
Interest in or experience with Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, and Generative AI solutions.




Why Moviri is your place

Moviri is where you can truly grow, challenge yourself, and make an impact.




Work on meaningful projects: you'll contribute to innovative initiatives for leading international organizations, applying AI to real-world challenges with measurable impact.




Grow fast: we invest in our people. You'll learn from experienced professionals, work with emerging technologies, and continuously develop both technical and consulting skills.




Flexibility and trust: we believe autonomy and accountability go hand in hand. We offer a hybrid working model and empower our people to take ownership of their work and make an impact.




Tech Your Way: great ideas come from people who have the right tools to bring them to life. Whether you're a Mac or Windows enthusiast, you'll be free to choose the setup that best supports the way you create, build, and innovate.




Rewards & Benefits: we offer a competitive compensation package, with a salary range between €27,000 and €32,000 depending on experience and qualifications, along with Satispay meal vouchers and a yearly welfare allowance of €600. As part of the overall compensation package, employees may also be eligible for an annual performance-based bonus (MBO), reflecting both individual contribution and company performance.




Fresh Ideas, Fresh Fruit: Well-being matters too. That's why, through our partnership with Cortilia, we provide fresh fruit in the office every week, supporting healthy habits and a more sustainable workplace.




We also believe that great workplaces are built through shared experiences. Throughout the year, we organize team-building activities, company events, and informal gatherings (Beer Friday, Company Parties...) creating opportunities to connect, collaborate, and celebrate together.




Location: Milan or Padua (Italy), with a hybrid working model.




The selection process

We're looking for people who can grow and make a meaningful impact over time. That's why our selection process is designed to assess not only technical skills, but also potential, curiosity, and problem-solving ability.




The process may include multiple stages, such as technical interviews and discussions with team members. Every application is reviewed carefully, and we strive to provide a transparent and respectful experience for all candidates.




Technology evolves constantly, and nobody knows everything. What matters most is the willingness to learn, challenge yourself, and contribute with curiosity, accountability, and a collaborative mindset.




Join us

If you'd like to work on cutting-edge AI projects, grow in a collaborative environment, and help build innovative solutions used in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

Technology evolves constantly, and nobody knows everything. What matters most is the willingness to learn, challenge yourself, and contribute with curiosity, accountability, and a collaborative mindset.


Join us

If you'd like to work on cutting-edge AI projects, grow in a collaborative environment, and help build innovative solutions used in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Junior IT Data & AI Engineer
Description:
Descrizione del Ruolo

Il candidato sarà inserito all'interno del team IT Data & Integration per supportare la gestione e l'ottimizzazione della filiera del dato aziendale. La risorsa lavorerà in sinergia con consulenti esterni per implementare le logiche dell'architettura dati e si occuperà operativamente della modellazione, della creazione di soluzioni di data visualization e dello sviluppo di modelli statistici e predittivi a supporto delle decisioni di business.

Responsabilità Tecniche

Progettare e ottimizzare modelli dati relazionali e dimensionali su database aziendali, predisponendo le strutture per l'analisi avanzata.
Creare, pubblicare e mantenere report interattivi e scalabili utilizzando moderni strumenti di data visualization (Power BI/Looker), integrando KPI predittivi e metriche di Machine Learning.
Scrivere query SQL efficienti per l'estrazione e la manipolazione di grandi moli di dati da ambienti cloud (Azure/GCP) finalizzate anche al Machine Learning.
Monitorare la coerenza dei dati tra i sistemi sorgente, i modelli di analytics e i report finali.
Collaborare con i consulenti esterni per definire, monitorare e testare gli sviluppi di integrazione e le pipeline di alimentazione dei modelli.
Gestire piccoli interventi correttivi e ottimizzazioni sulle piattaforme BI in uso e sui relativi script di automazione.

Hard Skills

Ottima conoscenza del linguaggio Python per l'automazione dei dati, la manipolazione e l'implementazione di algoritmi di Machine Learning e AI.
Ottima conoscenza linguaggio SQL per interrogazione database e preparazione dati.
Padronanza di Power BI (incluso linguaggio DAX) e/o Looker (gradita conoscenza di LookML).
Familiarità con Prompt Engineering, Copilot Studio, RAG Architecture e simili.
Familiarità con le console di Azure e GCP e con i loro servizi dedicati all'Intelligenza Artificiale.
Capacità di strutturare tabelle dei fatti e dimensioni per analisi performanti.
Utilizzo avanzato di Excel per analisi ad-hoc e data validation.

Soft Skills

Capacità di dialogare con gli stakeholder per tradurre bisogni di business in specifiche tecniche di analytics e data science.
Orientamento all’innovazione e al continuous improvement: identificazione opportunità di automazione, diffusione della cultura data-driven all’interno dell’organizzazione
Rispetto dell'ambito di progetto all'interno del perimetro di budget e timing condiviso per il rilascio delle soluzioni in produzione.
Proattività nel proporre nuove feature, approcci algoritmici innovativi o ottimizzazioni dei modelli dati nelle piattaforme BI.




Formazione

Laurea in Ingegneria, Informatica, Statistica, Matematica o discipline affini.

Esperienza

2-3 anni in ruoli di Data Engineering, Data Science o Advanced Analytics.
Esperienza su ambienti cloud e piattaforme dati moderne.
Esperienza in implementazione di use case AI costituisce titolo preferenziale.

Lingue

Italiano: madre lingua
Inglese: fluente




RAL: la posizione prevede una Ral di 25.000/30.000€ (in base all'esperienza del/la candidato/a) +mensa e welfare.

Title: Senior Data Sciencist - AI & Scientific Applications
Description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Description

Want to apply AI to real scientific and healthcare challenges?

At Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine, we are building AI-powered applications that help teams find evidence faster, analyze scientific information at scale, and reduce manual work in research and evidence-generation workflows.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist based in Madrid or Milan to design, build, test, and deploy AI solutions that combine machine learning, large language models, data engineering, and software development. You will work closely with scientists, medical experts, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to understand their workflows, challenges, and unmet needs. Rather than simply implementing predefined requirements, you will help shape solutions by translating complex scientific and business problems into practical technology capabilities, including AI-powered approaches where appropriate.

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, writing high-quality code, testing AI outputs, and building scalable solutions that deliver meaningful value in scientific and healthcare workflows.

What You Will Do

You will build applications that support scientific literature search, evidence synthesis, data exploration, study planning, and scientific content generation. This includes working with Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, prompt design, APIs, databases, cloud services, and enterprise data sources.

You will write and review Python code, develop data pipelines, integrate AI models, troubleshoot technical issues, and help move prototypes into production. You will also improve existing workflows by making them more accurate, scalable, maintainable, and easier to test.

A key part of the role is AI quality. You will create test sets, evaluation methods, benchmarks, and validation approaches that measure accuracy, consistency, reproducibility, and robustness. You will document assumptions, limitations, and recommended use so teams can understand when and how to rely on AI-generated outputs.

You will also guide technical decisions, review solution designs, mentor colleagues, and share practical knowledge across the team. We value people who can explain complex technical choices clearly and help others build better systems!

Required Experience And Skills


Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, or a related field.
5 or more years of experience building data science, machine learning, AI, or analytics solutions.
Strong Python programming skills.
Experience building applications, services, or pipelines that run beyond proof of concept.
Experience with Large Language Models, Generative AI, prompt design, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, or related AI architectures.
Experience working with APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and modern software development practices.
Strong understanding of statistics, machine learning, data engineering, and model evaluation.
Experience working with large, complex, or messy datasets.
Ability to turn ambiguous scientific or technical problems into practical implementation steps.


Preferred Experience And Skills


Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, clinical research, medical affairs, or life sciences.
Experience with MLOps, CI/CD, automated testing, model monitoring, or AI evaluation frameworks.
Experience developing AI systems for regulated or quality-controlled environments.
Familiarity with cloud-native applications, containers, orchestration frameworks, or enterprise AI platforms.
Experience contributing to scientific publications, conference presentations, or technical communities.


Why Join Us?

We work on technical problems that matter. In this role, you will help create AI applications that support scientific research, reduce repetitive work, and make evidence-generation workflows faster and more consistent.

We offer opportunities to learn from experts across science, medicine, data, and technology while contributing to systems that are used in real-world healthcare and life sciences settings. We support continuous learning, practical experimentation, and collaboration across disciplines.

What You Will Help Deliver


AI applications that reduce manual work in evidence generation workflows.
More reliable methods for searching, synthesizing, and generating scientific information.
Reusable technical components that help teams build faster.
Tested and documented AI workflows that can be deployed, monitored, and improved over time.

L’azienda opera in un contesto altamente regolamentato, con standard qualitativi elevati. La struttura è organizzata su scala globale, con team cross‑funzionali. L’innovazione e l’impatto sul benessere delle persone sono al centro della sua strategia.

Il tuo nuovo ruolo

In qualità di Senior Data Scientist, sarai inserito all’interno del team di Digital Transformation e contribuirai alla creazione di valore attraverso l’utilizzo dei dati. Ti occuperai di progettare, sviluppare e mettere in produzione soluzioni di machine learning e advanced analytics, lavorando a stretto contatto con stakeholder business e team tecnici. Avrai un ruolo chiave nel tradurre esigenze di business in modelli analitici concreti, contribuendo a migliorare i processi decisionali e l’efficienza operativa.

In particolare, ti occuperai di:

Sviluppare e ottimizzare modelli di machine learning per diversi use case aziendali; analizzare e strutturare dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee (CRM, sistemi interni, piattaforme cloud);
costruire e monitorare modelli predittivi e workflow analitici;
collaborare con data engineer e stakeholder per industrializzare le soluzioni;
supportare le attività di deploy, testing e miglioramento continuo dei modelli;
comunicare risultati e insight in modo chiaro a interlocutori tecnici e non tecnici;
Contribuire alla diffusione di best practice di data science all’interno dell’organizzazione.

In questo ruolo, è fondamentale combinare solide competenze tecniche con una forte capacità di comprensione del business.

Title: Forward Deployed AI Scientist, Italy - BCG X
Description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

We Are BCG X

We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.

What You'll Do

Our BCG X teams own the full analytics value-chain end to end: framing new business challenges, designing innovative algorithms, implementing, and deploying scalable solutions, and enabling colleagues and clients to fully embrace AI. Our product offerings span from fully custom-builds to industry specific leading edge AI software solutions.

Our Forward Deployed AI Scientist and Senior Forward Deployed AI Scientist are part of our rapidly growing team to apply data science methods and analytics to real-world business situations across industries to drive significant business impact. You'll have the chance to partner with clients in a variety of BCG regions and industries, and on key topics like climate change, enabling them to design, build, and deploy new and innovative solutions.

Additional responsibilities will include developing and delivering thought leadership in scientific communities and papers as well as leading conferences on behalf of BCG X. Successful candidates are intellectually curious builders who are biased toward action, creative, and communicative.

We Are Looking For Dedicated Individuals With a Passion For Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research And Redefining Organizations Into AI Led Innovative Companies. Successful Candidates Possess The Following


Comfortable in a client-facing role with the ambition to lead teams
Likes to distill complex results or processes into simple, clear visualizations
Explain sophisticated data science concepts in an understandable manner
Love building things and are comfortable working with modern development tools and writing code collaboratively (bonus points if you have a software development or DevOps experience)
Significant experience applying advanced analytics to a variety of business situations and a proven ability to synthesize complex data
Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques and their mathematical underpinnings, and can translate this into business implications for our clients
Have strong project management skills
Fluency in both Italian and English

Master’s or PhD degree program in Computer Research Science, Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field

Programming: Python

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Title: Senior CRM Data Scientist
Description:
Per rafforzare il team CRM stiamo cercando un/a Senior CRM Data Scientist che guidi la costruzione della nostra capability analitica avanzata, sviluppando modelli predittivi, sistemi di segmentazione e insight strategici data-driven a supporto della crescita del valore cliente.

Il/la Senior Customer Intelligence Analyst sarà responsabile dello sviluppo end‑to‑end dei principali modelli di machine learning applicati al CRM, della trasformazione dei dati cliente in insight azionabili e della definizione dei framework analitici alla base delle strategie di personalizzazione, retention e loyalty.

La figura opererà come punto di riferimento tecnico e metodologico per le analisi avanzate, contribuendo attivamente alla roadmap data-driven dell’azienda.




Responsabilità principali:




Customer Intelligence & Advanced Analytics

Progettazione e sviluppo di modelli predittivi avanzati (churn, CLV, propensity, next best action) con Python e SQL.
Costruzione e gestione di sistemi di clustering e segmentazione avanzata basati su machine learning (unsupervised).
Esecuzione di analisi comportamentali sui clienti finalizzate a migliorare acquisition, retention e valore del customer lifecycle.
Creazione di framework analitici per ottimizzare targeting, personalizzazione e comunicazioni CRM.
Conduzione di analisi sperimentali e A/B test sui principali touchpoint.

Data Visualization & Performance Reporting

Sviluppo e governance di dashboard strategiche in Tableau su KPI cliente, CLV, engagement e performance campagne.
Costruzione di metriche avanzate e modelli di attribution per misurare l'impatto delle iniziative CRM.

Data Management & Data Quality

Collaborazione con IT per garantire disponibilità, integrità e scalabilità dei dataset cliente.
Definizione dei requisiti per nuove fonti dati e processi di data enrichment.
Supervisione dell’integrazione dati tra sistemi legacy, CRM platform e data warehouse.

Supporto Strategico & Cross‑team Leadership

Partner strategico del team CRM per definizione di logiche di personalizzazione, journey e automazioni.
Supporto nella definizione di strategie basate su machine learning e insight avanzati.




Competenze tecniche:

Esperienza consolidata: 5+ anni in Data Science, Customer Analytics, CRM Analytics o ruoli simili.
Ottima conoscenza di SQL e gestione di dataset complessi (big data, multi-touchpoint).
Padronanza di Python o altri tools per modellistica statistica e machine learning.
Esperienza comprovata nello sviluppo di:
modelli predittivi (churn, CLV, propensity)
clustering avanzato e segmentazione comportamentale
regressioni e modelli classificatori
Solida capacità di costruire dashboard e KPI complessi in Tableau.
Conoscenza delle logiche CRM, loyalty, database marketing e customer lifecycle.
Plus: esperienza con piattaforme di automazione marketing e modelli LLM applicati all’analisi clienti.




Soft skills

Approccio analitico rigoroso e orientamento alla risoluzione di problemi complessi.
Capacità di rendere comprensibili e azionabili insight tecnici per stakeholder non tecnici.
Mindset strategico con attenzione al dettaglio.
Ottime doti comunicative e capacità di lavorare in team cross‑funzionali.
Proattività, autonomia e orientamento all'innovazione.




Cosa offriamo:

Un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione customers data-driven dell’azienda
Possibilità di lavorare con tecnologie moderne.
Opportunità di guidare la costruzione di modelli e framework analitici avanzati.
Ambiente dinamico, collaborativo e con forte orientamento all’innovazione.




Contratto a tempo indeterminato
Inquadramento livello Quadro CCNL Commercio

Title: Python Developer
Description:
Vuoi iniziare una nuova avventura professionale come Python Developer & IoT Engineer in una delle nostre opportunità nel settore Domotica a Bergamo?




👉 Cosa farai?

• Sviluppare software in Python per la raccolta, pulizia e organizzazione dei dati aziendali provenienti da dispositivi IoT.

• Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere pipeline dati e infrastrutture che automatizzano i flussi di raccolta e trasformazione dei dati.

• Sviluppare e manutenere librerie Python a supporto dei sistemi di data analysis e delle pipeline.

• Supportare il ciclo di vita dei modelli ML/LLM, garantendo ambienti e strumenti necessari al loro corretto funzionamento.

• Lavorare su sistemi di domotica e smart home per abilitare la comunicazione tra dispositivi.

• Analizzare i dati per identificare anomalie, fornendo insight utili al miglioramento dei sistemi.

• Partecipare a riunioni collettive e contribuire alla definizione e gestione del ciclo di vita del dato.

• Collaborare con i team tecnici e di business per garantire che i dati siano disponibili, strutturati e affidabili per le diverse esigenze aziendali.




✍️ Cosa richiediamo?

• Laurea in Computer Science, Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria dell’Automazione, Meccatronica, Automation & Robotics o esperienza equivalente.

• Almeno 2 anni di esperienza come Python Developer, preferibilmente su sistemi dati e/o dispositivi IoT.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di pipeline dati e nella gestione di dati provenienti da sistemi IoT (domotica, smart home, colonnine, ecc.).

• Conoscenza della lingua italiana a livello C1 e della lingua inglese a livello B2.

• Capacità di lavorare in team, autonomia operativa e attitudine a un ambiente dinamico e innovativo.




Nice to have:

• Esperienza in domotica, smart home, mobility o in contesti con dispositivi connessi (IoT).

• Esperienza nel supporto al ciclo di vita di modelli di Machine Learning / LLM / AI.

• Familiarità con strumenti e metodologie di data engineering / ML Ops.




✨ Che cosa offriamo?

• Una comunità internazionale che riunisce oltre 110 nazionalità diverse.

• Un ambiente in cui la fiducia è centrale e la crescita interna è valorizzata.

• Un solido sistema di formazione con Academy interna e moduli disponibili.

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico con eventi interni (afterwork, team building, ecc.).

• Un forte impegno verso benessere e work-life balance.




Benefici locali in Italia:

• Buoni pasto.

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili secondo policy aziendale (possibilità di smart working).

• Assicurazione sanitaria e programmi di benessere, ove applicabili.




💰 Remunerazione e trasparenza

• Gross Annual Salary Range: EUR 24.000 – EUR 36.000.

• CCNL del Commercio.

• La fascia retributiva è definita secondo criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere.

• Durante il processo di selezione non chiederemo informazioni sulla tua retribuzione attuale o precedente.

La collocazione all’interno della fascia dipenderà dalla tua esperienza specifica, dalle tue competenze e da ciò che potrai portare nel ruolo.




Requisiti logistici

• Sede di lavoro: Bergamo.

• È richiesta la possibilità di raggiungere la sede in autonomia (preferibilmente automunito).

• Possibili trasferte in base alle esigenze di progetto.

Boldness: il nostro spirito di avventura imprenditoriale è ciò che ci unisce tutti e ci porta al successo.

Trust: la fiducia è il fondamento di tutte le relazioni, la fiducia ci consente di promuovere la libertà di espressione, creatività e innovazione.

Title: Computational Scientist and Bioinformatician
Description:
IFOM is an internationally recognized non-profit cancer research institute supported by the Italian Association for Cancer Research (AIRC), based in Milan within a highly dynamic urban environment.

IFOM's continued success is ensured by the recruitment of highly selected undergraduate, graduate and post-graduate researchers from over 24 countries worldwide.

IFOM is hosted within a research campus shared with the European Institute of Oncology and the Italian Institute of Technology.

IFOM is committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment, based on mutual respect and the enhancement of diversity, offering equal job opportunities to all qualified candidates.




We seek for our Institute: Computational Scientist and Bioinformatician




The successful candidate will join the Computational Oncology and Bioinformatics Unit and report directly to the Head of the Unit. This is a permanent, full-time position with a central role in delivering bioinformatics and computational analyses across strategically relevant institutional, translational and collaborative research programmes at IFOM.

The Unit coordinates bioinformatics and computational medicine activities, promotes the development of advanced analytical platforms, integrates molecular and clinical data, and implements innovative research projects in collaboration with IFOM research groups and external clinical, academic and industrial partners.

The Unit operates as a research and development structure rather than a task-based facility. The candidate will therefore contribute as an integrated scientific partner throughout the research process, from study design and analytical planning to biological interpretation, dissemination and publication.

The Unit aims to generate clinically relevant knowledge and novel therapeutic opportunities by:

integrating genomic, transcriptomic and other molecular data with clinical and phenotypic information;
characterizing tumour evolution, heterogeneity, cellular plasticity, treatment response and resistance;
developing and validating computational methods and reproducible analytical platforms for tissue- and liquid-biopsy studies;
supporting high-priority institutional programmes and collaborative projects with robust, innovative and quantitatively sound analyses.

We are looking for a scientist with at least 3 years of relevant experience in bioinformatics, computational biology or biomedical data science, including doctoral research where applicable.

The candidate will be responsible for:

Designing, implementing and interpreting bioinformatics analyses of next-generation sequencing and multi-omic datasets, including WES/WGS, targeted sequencing, RNA sequencing and liquid-biopsy data.
Developing, validating and maintaining reproducible analytical pipelines, standard operating procedures and documentation, with appropriate QA/QC, version control and testing.
Integrating molecular data with clinical and experimental variables to generate biologically and clinically meaningful results.
Contributing to study design, analytical strategy, statistical planning and the definition of computational endpoints for preclinical, translational and clinical research projects.
Working closely with wet-lab scientists, clinicians, computational researchers and external partners to translate scientific questions into effective analytical solutions.




About the position

Coordinating computational activities across multiple projects, managing priorities, milestones, deliverables and dependencies in agreement with the Head of the Unit.
Communicating analytical approaches and results clearly through technical reports, project meetings, presentations, manuscripts, grant applications and institutional deliverables.
Contributing to the management, optimization and responsible use of servers, HPC resources and data storage in coordination with IFOM IT, RCDS unit and infrastructure teams.
Ensuring secure and compliant handling of research and clinical data in accordance with institutional data-governance policies, GDPR requirements and research ethics.
Providing technical guidance and contributing to the training and mentoring of junior researchers and students.
Developing independent methodological contributions and actively supporting the scientific growth and visibility of the Unit.




Qualification

Strong background in cancer biology and/or computational sciences, with demonstrated experience in translational, biomedical or clinically oriented research contexts.
Solid knowledge of statistics, quantitative methods and sound principles of experimental and observational data analysis.
Demonstrated experience in the analysis of NGS and/or multi-omic data and in the biological interpretation of complex datasets.
Programming skills in Bash, Python and/or R; experience with C, C++ or comparable languages is considered an advantage.
High confidence in Linux-based systems and command-line environments.
Experience with computational infrastructures, including servers and/or HPC environments, job schedulers, resource management and storage systems.
Experience with reproducible research practices, including workflow automation, version control, code documentation, software testing and containerized environments.
Basic to intermediate knowledge of IT infrastructure and information-security best practices, including user and access management, data protection, backup principles and compliance with data-governance policies.
Proven ability to manage computational analyses across multiple projects, exercise independent scientific judgement and take ownership of technical deliverables.
Ability to communicate analytical choices and results clearly and to work constructively within multidisciplinary teams spanning biology, computation and clinical research.
Flexible, reliable and problem-solving-oriented approach, with the ability to adapt to evolving scientific and project requirements.
Experience with LLM is a plus.




Education

Candidates with a PhD in biology or another life-science discipline will also be considered when supported by a strong and demonstrable computational profile. PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, applied mathematics, statistics or biostatistics, data science, computer or biomedical engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.




Languages

Professional proficiency in spoken and written English, sufficient to work effectively in an international scientific environment and communicate technical results.
Experience with C, C++ or comparable languages is considered an advantage.
Knowledge of Italian is not required but will be considered an advantage.




Soft skills

Scientific curiosity and a rigorous, solution-oriented mindset.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to collaborative research.
Clear and pragmatic communication with colleagues from different scientific and professional backgrounds.
Strong organization, reliability, adaptability and attention to the quality and reproducibility of results.
The ideal candidate should be rigorous and uncompromising when it comes to data quality, while remaining respectful, constructive, and collaborative with colleagues.




What we offer

An international and highly collaborative research environment, continuous training and flexible working time.
Relocation-cost support and a guest house within the campus.
Support for candidates and their families, including housing, schooling, registration with the Italian National Health Service and work-permit procedures, through the IFOM Welcome Office.
Campus facilities and benefits, including a bar and canteen, lunch benefit, company nursery, medical service, laptop, CAF tax-declaration service and agreements with local gyms, pharmacies, psychological services and shops.
Access to Lab G, a laboratory specifically designed for pregnant or breastfeeding researchers.




Contract

Permanent contract, full time.




Location

Milan - Scalo di Porta Romana area




Contact Details

If you are interested in this opportunity, please submit your CV and a letter of interest to recruitment(at)ifom.eu and giovanni.crisafulli(at)ifom.eu.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
In Mavriq, parte di Moltiply Group, aiutiamo le persone a fare la scelta giusta, che si tratti di un mutuo, un'assicurazione, una fornitura di energia, un piano telefonico o dell'acquisto di un nuovo prodotto.

Con i nostri comparatori italiani (tra cui MutuiOnline.it, Segugio.it, SOStariffe.it, Trovaprezzi.it e Switcho) e internazionali (come LeLynx.fr, Rastreator.com, Pricewise.nl e Verivox.de), offriamo chiarezza in mercati spesso complessi e poco trasparenti.

Crediamo nel potere dei dati, nella trasparenza e nell'innovazione. Perché cambiare le regole, quando non funzionano al meglio, è nel nostro DNA!

Posizione:

Cerchiamo un/a Data Engineer con solide competenze tecniche e interesse ai processi di marketing automation. Entrerai a far parte del Team Data Engineering, collaborando quotidianamente con i team Marketing e Tech per progettare soluzioni data-driven che migliorino personalizzazione, segmentazione ed efficacia delle campagne.

Lavorerai in un contesto dinamico e collaborativo, in cui precisione, sperimentazione e miglioramento continuo sono parte integrante del modo di lavorare.

Cosa offriamo

Crediamo che la crescita nasca dall’incontro tra curiosità e autonomia. Offriamo un ambiente di lavoro ibrido e flessibile, formazione continua e spazio per sperimentare, imparare e migliorare. Lavorerai in un team con cui condividerai successi, affronterai sfide e raggiungerai risultati. A completare il quadro, una RAL indicativa tra i 32-42k, un pacchetto di benefit solido: assicurazione sanitaria integrativa, mensa interna, palestra, welfare, accesso a piattaforme di e-learning e altri servizi gratuiti al dipendente (come 730, o ricarica per auto elettriche e a metano in sede).

Dove lavorerai

La sede di lavoro è in Via Lanzoni 13, Giussago (Pavia). Lavoriamo in modalità ibrida: almeno due giorni in presenza e fino a tre in smart working, con flessibilità in ingresso e uscita. La sede non è servita da mezzi pubblici, quindi è necessario disporre di un mezzo proprio.

Cosa farai


Progetterai e manterrai pipeline di dati a supporto delle attività di marketing automation.
Integrerai sistemi interni con piattaforme MarTech (es. Google Ads, Microsoft Ads).
Ottimizzerai i flussi di dati tra strumenti interni e piattaforme esterne.
Supporterai la creazione di dashboard e report per monitorare le performance.
Collaborerai con team cross-funzionali per migliorare targeting e conversione.


Requisiti:


Laurea in discipline STEM.
2–3 anni di esperienza in ruoli affini.
Capacità di collaborare con team multidisciplinari e gestire progetti in parallelo.
Attitudine al problem solving e orientamento al risultato.
Precisione, spirito analitico e desiderio di migliorare continuamente.


Conoscenze tecniche


Programmazione orientata agli oggetti (OOP).
TTD, Python, .NET, SQL, PostgreSQL.
Bash su ambiente Linux.


Nice to have


BigQuery.
Google Ads API.
Power BI.


Altre informazioni:

In Mavriq non diamo nulla per scontato: pensiamo, testiamo, impariamo.

Ogni giorno è un giorno uno, e ogni sfida è un’occasione per migliorare.

Se ti rivedi in questo approccio, non vediamo l’ora di conoscerti.

(La ricerca è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle Leggi n. 903/77 e n. 125/91.)

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
At Lexroom.ai, we set the bar for legal AI—clear, fast, and built for trust.

In just a few years, what began as an idea has become a reliable platform adopted by thousands of legal professionals across Europe.

Our mission is clear: make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable, giving lawyers, law firms, and companies the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters.

We’re growing fast, backed by top-tier investors and a world-class team committed to rigor, clarity, and impact.

Today, Lexroom is a trusted partner, shaping the evolution of legal AI with the same rigor and precision that define our product.

Why Lexroom.ai?


Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.
Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional minds driven by competence, curiosity, and ambition.
Deliver Meaningful Results: Your contribution will empower legal professionals to make faster, clearer, and more reliable decisions worldwide.


At Lexroom.ai, we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.

What You'll Do


Design and build agent-driven and RAG-based AI systems to solve complex legal tasks with precision and efficiency.
Fine-tune and post-train LLMs using cutting-edge supervised and reinforcement learning techniques to raise response quality.
Develop and optimize large-scale search pipelines for LLM-powered agents.
Implement and refine NLP algorithms to extract, structure, and validate information from legal documents.
Run end-to-end evaluations to pinpoint bottlenecks, measure performance, and guide continuous improvements.
Work closely with legal experts to design evaluation protocols and build reliable, domain-specific datasets that strengthen every layer of the stack.
Maintain technical excellence by following established best practices, coding standards, and rigorous code-review processes.


What You’ll Bring


Proven expertise in building and managing robust ML pipelines.
Strong Python skills with hands-on experience in LLM research and deep learning systems.
Knowledge of search technologies such as full-text search, vector databases, or other large-scale retrieval systems.
Collaborative mindset and readiness to work with legal experts, researchers, and engineers to keep improving the product.
Familiarity with MLOps and integrating ML models into production backends (a strong plus).
Up-to-date with LLM innovation, ideally with experience in pre-training or deploying large-scale models in real-world scenarios.


What Sets Us Apart

An Exceptional Team.

At Lexroom.ai, you’ll work alongside top talent in tech and legal AI.

Our focused teams operate with purpose and autonomy, so every contribution delivers visible results.

You’ll collaborate with people who pair innovation with rigor, curiosity with discipline, ambition with depth.

Growth that Matters.

We hire exceptional people to make a difference—and we give them space to lead.

As we scale, your work will shape the future of legal technology and set new standards for the field.

Impact is defined by vision and execution, not by age or title. If you’re ready to take responsibility, you’ll find real opportunities to grow and lead high-stakes projects.

Rewarding Your Contribution.

We value excellence and share success:


Annual Salary Range: €45,000 – €100,000
Equity Package: Align your growth with the company’s long-term success.


Benefits That Matter


Hybrid Work: Flexibility to balance remote work with in-person collaboration at our Milan HQ.
Health Coverage: Comprehensive insurance to keep you secure and focused.
Meal Vouchers: Daily support for your lunch breaks.
Performance Bonuses: Rewards directly tied to measurable results.
Team Retreats & Off-sites: Dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas.
At Lexroom.ai, ambition meets discipline and purpose.


We’re not just building a product—we’re setting a new standard for the legal world. If you’re ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we’d love to hear from you.**

Compensation Range: €40K - €100K

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our AI team focused on bringing ML & Generative AI into the heart of our operations (e.g. claims, underwriting, customer support).

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to redefine the core operative processes, leveraging ML & GenAI techniques to enhance not only efficiency but, most importantly, the overall effectiveness and quality of outcomes.

You’ll collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business leaders to design and deliver AI-driven products that create tangible business value and redefine the future of ops at Prima.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What You’ll Do


Leverage Machine Learning and GenAI to solve complex business problems, making our processes better and faster;
Analyze and interpret complex data to support decision-making;
Contribute directly to Prima’s long-term success and financial impact through concrete solutions.


What We’re Looking For


Strong academic background in quantitative fields such as Math, Physics, Data Science, or Engineering;
All experience levels, including recent graduates with no prior working experience;
Strong analytical and quantitative skills;
Structured problem solving skills and being able to analyze and break down complex problems;
Curiosity, proactivity, quick learning and an innovative mindset.


Nice-to-Have


Hands-on experience with Python and coding best practices;
Experience with machine learning and Generative AI (openAI/Gemini APIs, agentic frameworks, …)
Business proficiency in Italian or Spanish, in addition to English.


€38,000 - €55,000 a year

Why you’ll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks..

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Per il potenziamento dell’area di Data.Tech.AI, Alkemy è alla ricerca di un Data Engineer.

Ottima conoscenza dei linguaggio Python

Esperienza nella relazione con il Cliente per la raccolta di requisiti, la finalizzazione dell’analisi funzionale e la redazione di documenti tecnici

Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese
Propensione all’innovazione
Attitudine al lavoro di gruppo

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
SDG Group is looking for AI Engineers, motivated professionals with 1 to 3 years of experience in AI & ML, to join our AI & ML Engineering team.

From day one, you will be fully integrated into an international delivery unit, working with multicultural teams on high-impact projects across cutting-edge and highly competitive sectors such as Fashion & Luxury, Utilities, Banking, Insurance, and Healthcare.

This role is ideal for candidates eager to grow fast in a dynamic, international, and constantly evolving environment, with direct exposure to Generative AI and advanced Machine Learning projects.




Your Challenges:

Full-Lifecycle AI Development: Manage the entire journey of an AI solution, from initial problem-solving and data cleaning to building production-ready systems.
Cutting-Edge Modeling: Implement a wide range of algorithms—from traditional statistical optimization and predictive modeling (supervised/unsupervised) to advanced Generative AI using LLMs and Transformers.
Industrialization & AIOps: Transition models from local environments to the cloud using an engineering mindset. You will ensure systems are scalable and reliable by applying AIOps methodologies.
Cloud Mastery: Work across the "Big Three" (AWS, GCP, and Azure) and leverage specialized platforms like Databricks, SageMaker, and Vertex AI to handle large-scale data science needs.
Strategic Insight & Communication: Translate complex datasets into actionable business insights. You will act as a bridge between technical data and client needs, presenting findings that solve real-world challenges.
Collaborative Deployment: Work in synergy with Data Engineers to integrate models into live systems, ensuring they are not just "smart" but operational.




Requirements:

Education: Master’s degree in a STEM field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or related).
Experience: Professionals with 1 to 3 years of experience in AI / ML / Data Science are a strong fit.
Programming: Proficiency in Python and its ecosystem (NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn).
Technical Foundations: Familiarity with Git, virtual environments, and SQL/NoSQL databases.
Machine Learning / AI Basics: Understanding of core ML concepts (regression, classification, clustering, dimensionality reduction) or experience with Generative AI: LLMs, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, OpenAI API, LangChain, vector databases.
Languages: Fluency in Italian (C1 level) and proficiency in English. Please note that language skills will be tested during the interview process.




Rock your future with SDG:

Continuous Growth & Learning: Access our Internal Academies for 80 hours of initial training, followed by ongoing coaching and support for top-tier certifications (AWS, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, etc.) to keep you at the forefront of AI innovation.
A Meritocratic Ecosystem: Forget rigid structures. We offer semi-annual performance reviews to discuss your achievements, new challenges, and salary adjustments based on your results.
High-Impact Projects: From Day 1, you’ll be part of a team implementing real-world AI, deep learning, and predictive analytics for global industry leaders across multiple sectors.
Young & International Culture: Join a diverse, inclusive, and energetic team with an average age under 30, where you’ll rub shoulders with top AI experts and enjoy opportunities for international travel.




What we offer:

Contract: Permanent contract (CCNL Commercio).
Salary: Indicative Gross Annual Salary (RAL) ranging from €28,000 to €36,000. Positioning within this range will be determined based on technical skills, specific role experience, and interview outcomes, following objective and predefined criteria. (For exceptional profiles falling outside this range, a salary revision may be evaluated subject to internal approval).
Work Mode: Total flexibility. 100% remote, hybrid, or in-office. You decide where and how you work best.
Other Benefits: Supplementary health insurance, meal vouchers (Ticket Restaurant), and a structured corporate welfare plan.







About SDG Group: Working at SDG means joining one of the fastest-growing management consulting firms globally in the fields of Business Analytics, Corporate Performance Management, and Advanced Business Solutions. With more than 2,500 professionals worldwide, SDG has been recognized by Gartner as a leader and one of the 37 most cutting-edge companies in the Data & Analytics sector—the only Italian firm and the second in Europe. SDG operates in Italy with 3 offices (Milan, Florence, Verona) and has branches in Spain, Portugal, France, the UK, the USA, and the Middle East. We put our analytics expertise at the service of companies to empower their business strategies, helping them transform into successful data-driven organizations.

Are you ready to be part of the future of AI? Apply now!

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
At Lexroom.ai, we set the bar for legal AI—clear, fast, and built for trust.

In just a few years, what began as an idea has become a reliable platform adopted by thousands of legal professionals across Europe.

Our mission is clear: make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable, giving lawyers, law firms, and companies the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters.

We're scaling rapidly, backed by top-tier investors and a world-class team dedicated to rigor, clarity, and impact.

Today, Lexroom is a trusted partner, shaping the future of legal AI with discipline and purpose.

Why Lexroom.ai?


Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.
Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition.
Deliver Meaningful Results: Your work will directly influence how legal professionals operate—faster, clearer, and more efficiently.


At Lexroom.ai, we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you'll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.

What You'll Do


Own the data transformation layer from raw sources to trusted, documented datasets—designing and maintaining a dbt project on BigQuery with staging, intermediate, and mart layers.
Model product analytics events (user interactions, feature adoption, feedback signals), engineering metrics, and business KPIs into reliable, self-service data models.
Build and maintain the data foundations powering our dashboards, decisions, and team health metrics.
Implement data quality frameworks: tests, freshness checks, anomaly detection, and clear ownership and SLAs on key datasets.
Collaborate with engineers to improve event tracking and data contracts at the source (Pub/Sub, application events).
Create and curate dashboards and semantic layers that Product, CS, and Sales teams can query directly—enabling true self-service analytics.
Partner with the AI & Search Platform team to instrument and measure model performance, feedback loops, and benchmark results.
Support Product teams with ad-hoc analysis: feature impact, user segmentation, satisfaction trends, and power-user behavior.


What You'll Bring


3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a data analyst role with a strong engineering mindset.
Expert SQL skills and hands-on experience with dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud).
Solid experience with BigQuery or comparable cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift).
Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data testing, and documentation-as-code practices.
Comfortable working in a Python ecosystem (scripting, basic ETL, notebooks for exploration).
Experience building data models that serve multiple stakeholders (product, engineering, business).
Fluent English; Italian is a strong plus.


Nice to Have


Experience with event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka) and streaming data.
Familiarity with Elasticsearch, Pinecone, or vector databases.
Exposure to engineering metrics (DORA, PR analytics) or developer productivity measurement.
Experience with BI/visualization tools (Retool, Looker Studio, Metabase).
Interest in AI/ML model evaluation and LLM output quality measurement.
Previous experience in legal-tech, RegTech, or B2B SaaS.


What Sets Us Apart

An Exceptional Team

At Lexroom.ai, you'll work alongside top talent in tech and legal AI.

Our focused teams operate with purpose and autonomy, so every contribution delivers visible results.

You'll collaborate with people who pair innovation with rigor, curiosity with discipline, ambition with depth.

A Foundational Role

This is our first dedicated analytics hire. You won't inherit a legacy stack or fight bureaucracy—you'll design the analytics function from scratch with direct executive sponsorship, a modern stack (BigQuery, dbt, Pub/Sub, Python, GCP), and real strategic impact from day one.

Growth that Matters

Progettare e sviluppare soluzioni Data Platform & AI su cloud e architetture moderne

Integrare dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee (database, API, sistemi industriali, applicazioni enterprise e dispositivi)

Realizzare e mantenere pipeline ETL/ELT e processi di data ingestion e trasformazione

Contribuire alla creazione di dataset, modelli dati, semantic layer e data product a supporto di analytics e AI

Supportare attività di troubleshooting, ottimizzazione e miglioramento continuo delle piattaforme dati

Collaborare con Data Architect, AI Engineer, Business Analyst e stakeholder di business

Utilizzare strumenti di Generative AI per accelerare attività di analisi, sviluppo, testing e documentazione

2-6 anni di esperienza in uno o più dei seguenti ambiti: Data Engineering, Data Platform, Cloud Analytics, AI Engineering

Conoscenza di tecnologie quali Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Spark, SQL, Python, dbt o strumenti equivalenti

Capacità di lavorare con dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee e di supportarne la trasformazione, modellazione e valorizzazione

Familiarità con temi di data quality, governance, sicurezza e gestione del ciclo di vita del dato

Attitudine al lavoro in team e alla collaborazione con stakeholder tecnici e di business
