Title: Data Science Manager
Description:
About us

Sky is the technology and media company that makes entertainment and connectivity a personal, simple, and seamless experience.

Our motto is We Believe in Better: we believe people deserve the very best, and we innovate every day to create value and simplify our customers’ lives.

As part of Sky Group and Comcast, we operate in an international environment driven by continuous innovation and powered by world-class technology that allows us to reach millions of people every day.

With an IP-first approach, we design cutting-edge technology platforms – Sky Stream, Sky Q, Sky Glass, and NOW – that bring together premium content, trusted news, and world-class sports within a simple and intuitive ecosystem.

We connect with audiences across Italy through our free-to-air channels – TV8, Cielo, and Sky TG24 – and go beyond entertainment with Sky Wifi and Sky Mobile, offering ultra-fast connectivity at home and on the go.

This is how we deliver the joy of a better experience, guided by our values:

Creative. We are ambitious and innovative, embracing new technologies and leveraging insights to stay one step ahead, continuously raising the bar for our customers.

Welcoming. We are inclusive, collaborative, and respectful, creating a strong sense of belonging.

Simplifying. We focus on what matters most, set clear priorities, bring clarity, and remove complexity.

Do the Right Thing. We build a culture of clarity, fairness, and trust, supported by transparent processes and decisions people can rely on.




Role: Manager Data Scientist

We are looking for a Data Science Manager who combines strong hands-on expertise with strategic leadership.

This is not a traditional people-management role: you will operate primarily as a senior individual contributor, while acting as the data science lead on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives. You will own complex projects end-to-end, partnering with business and technology stakeholders to turn data into measurable business impact.

You will play a pivotal role in bridging business challenges and advanced analytics, shaping how data science is applied across the organization and elevating both its impact and maturity.

What you will do:

Lead data science projects from problem framing to production deployment
Make key decisions on methodology, trade-offs, and technical direction
Develop and deploy machine learning and AI models to drive customer value and operational efficiency
Act as Data Lead on strategic initiatives, and serve as the go-to data science expert on critical, cross-functional programs
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems
Drive alignment between stakeholders and ensure delivery of tangible, measurable outcomes
Stay deeply hands-on
Apply advanced analytics techniques in complex, multi-source and big data environments
Promote high standards in code quality, reproducibility, and model governance
Support adoption of responsible and ethical AI practices
Provide guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists
Foster a culture of ownership, pragmatism, and continuous improvement
Partner with business stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities
Communicate complex analytical insights in a clear, compelling, and actionable way
Drive data adoption and data-driven decision making across the organization




Your profile:

Almeno 4 years of experience in data science or advanced analytics roles
Proven ability to own projects end-to-end in production environments
Strong track record of working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
Natural ownership mindset: you don’t just build models—you drive impact
Machine learning (supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised)
Statistical modeling and experimentation
Advanced proficiency in: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, etc.), SQL, and/or R
Productionization and collaboration with engineering teams
Solid understanding of Data pipelines and large-scale data processing
Experience with version control (Git)
Ability to connect data work to real business outcomes and KPIs
Experience interacting with stakeholders and influencing decisions
Capability to identify and prioritize high-value use cases
Experience leading projects or initiatives, even without direct reports
Experience mentoring or coaching other data scientists
Fluency in English and Italian is required




What we offer:

For employees covered by the Private Radio and Television Collective Labour Agreement (CCNL), compensation starts from €51,000 gross per year.

Permanent employment contract.
Compensation commensurate with experience and specific skills.
Eligibility for the annual incentive scheme.
Access to Sky’s wellbeing programme, Sky4You, designed to support employees throughout different stages of life. Benefits include:
Free access to Sky TV services through Sky Q or Sky Stream.
Sky Wifi and Sky Mobile at exclusive employee rates.
Private healthcare insurance extendable to family members and cohabitants.
Life and accident insurance.
Free access to the company gym (Milan office only).
Financial support for new parents and caregivers.
Free tax return assistance.
Meal vouchers.
Additional initiatives focused on mental, physical, and financial wellbeing, summer camps and language courses for children, as well as a range of discounts and partnerships.




Hybrid Working

Hybrid working that truly works.

Depending on your role, you can benefit from up to 12 days per month of remote working, while our offices provide inspiring spaces where people collaborate, innovate, and make decisions together.

Our Milan hub is located in Rogoredo, Santa Giulia district, just a few minutes’ walk from Milano Rogoredo Station (M3 Rogoredo FS, regional and high-speed trains, suburban rail services), with convenient bus connections and easy access by car or motorcycle.

At the Sky Campus, you'll find cafés, a company restaurant, Sky Cinema, and collaborative spaces designed to foster innovation and idea-sharing. The surrounding area also offers restaurants, bars, supermarkets, and a wide range of services.




Learning & Development:

At Sky, we invest in your growth.

We believe in internal mobility as a key driver of professional development and offer opportunities to explore new roles and career paths across the organization.

Through Sky Learn, our learning platform, you will have access to continuous training, digital learning content, and upskilling and reskilling programmes to help you grow, evolve, and build your future career.




Social Impact & Inclusion

At Sky, we believe in people.

We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves and achieve their full potential. We actively support wellbeing and ensure equal opportunities for all, including candidates belonging to protected categories under Italian Law 68/99.

Sky hosts several employee networks, including Body&Mind, LGBTQ+, Women@Sky, and Parents&Carers—voluntary communities that bring colleagues together to promote wellbeing, inclusion, and empowerment initiatives.

We strive every day to create a lasting positive impact on our communities through Sky Cares volunteering programmes, Sky Up digital education initiatives, and immersive educational experiences offered through the Academy Studios.




Why Wait?

Apply now to build an extraordinary career and join a brilliant team.

We can’t wait to meet you. At Sky, ideas become experiences for millions of people.




Sky welcomes every form of talent. All applications, including those from candidates belonging to protected categories under Italian Law 68/99, will be considered based on equal opportunity and inclusion principles, without discrimination of any kind. Sky Italia guarantees a fair, inclusive, and non-discriminatory recruitment process.

In line with this commitment and Legislative Decree 96/2026, Sky Italia does not request or collect information regarding candidates’ previous compensation or employment grading, either during interviews or through any third parties involved in the recruitment process.

Title: Senior Data Sciencist - AI & Scientific Applications
Description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function

Data Analytics & Computational Sciences

Job Sub Function

Data Science

Job Category

Scientific/Technology

All Job Posting Locations:

Madrid, Spain, Milano, Italy

Job Description

Want to apply AI to real scientific and healthcare challenges?

At Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine, we are building AI-powered applications that help teams find evidence faster, analyze scientific information at scale, and reduce manual work in research and evidence-generation workflows.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist based in Madrid or Milan to design, build, test, and deploy AI solutions that combine machine learning, large language models, data engineering, and software development. You will work closely with scientists, medical experts, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to understand their workflows, challenges, and unmet needs. Rather than simply implementing predefined requirements, you will help shape solutions by translating complex scientific and business problems into practical technology capabilities, including AI-powered approaches where appropriate.

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, writing high-quality code, testing AI outputs, and building scalable solutions that deliver meaningful value in scientific and healthcare workflows.

What You Will Do

You will build applications that support scientific literature search, evidence synthesis, data exploration, study planning, and scientific content generation. This includes working with Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, prompt design, APIs, databases, cloud services, and enterprise data sources.

You will write and review Python code, develop data pipelines, integrate AI models, troubleshoot technical issues, and help move prototypes into production. You will also improve existing workflows by making them more accurate, scalable, maintainable, and easier to test.

A key part of the role is AI quality. You will create test sets, evaluation methods, benchmarks, and validation approaches that measure accuracy, consistency, reproducibility, and robustness. You will document assumptions, limitations, and recommended use so teams can understand when and how to rely on AI-generated outputs.

You will also guide technical decisions, review solution designs, mentor colleagues, and share practical knowledge across the team. We value people who can explain complex technical choices clearly and help others build better systems!

Required Experience And Skills


Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, or a related field.
5 or more years of experience building data science, machine learning, AI, or analytics solutions.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Il nostro obiettivo è sempre stato quello di creare e ampliare nel tempo un gruppo di persone qualificato, affidabile e disponibile; puntando su professionisti esperti, ma anche sulla formazione, investendo risorse nella crescita professionale.Dipendenti e collaboratori attraverso consolidate competenze tecniche, contribuiscono a rendere Craon un’azienda altamente qualificata e competitiva sul mercato ICT.

Per unprogetto enterprise siamo alla ricerca di un Data Engineer con 2-5 anni di esperienza nella progettazione, realizzazione e gestione di pipeline dati scalabili, affidabili e ad alte prestazioni.

La risorsa entrerà a far parte di un team specializzato e contribuirà allo sviluppo di moderne piattaforme dati, occupandosi dell'integrazione, trasformazione e ottimizzazione dei flussi informativi, garantendo qualità, affidabilità e performance delle soluzioni implementate.

Responsabilità

La risorsa sarà coinvolta nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di pipeline dati, nella realizzazione di processi ETL/ELT, nell'integrazione di dati provenienti da sistemi eterogenei e nell'ottimizzazione delle performance delle piattaforme dati. Collaborerà con Data Engineer, Data Scientist, Software Engineer e stakeholder di progetto per supportare la realizzazione di soluzioni scalabili e orientate al business.

Requisiti tecnici

È richiesta una buona esperienza nello sviluppo con Python e/o Scala, unita a una solida conoscenza di SQL e dei principali database relazionali, quali PostgreSQL e MySQL.

Sono richieste competenze nell'utilizzo di piattaforme Big Data, in particolare Apache Spark, Hadoop, Hive e distribuzioni Cloudera, oltre a una buona conoscenza delle architetture dati e dei processi ETL/ELT.

Il candidato ideale possiede esperienza con ambienti Cloud (AWS, Microsoft Azure o Google Cloud Platform) e con i principali servizi dedicati alla gestione dei dati, quali BigQuery, Amazon Redshift o servizi equivalenti. È inoltre richiesta familiarità con strumenti di orchestrazione dei workflow e delle pipeline dati.

Saranno considerate un plus la conoscenza di database NoSQL, come MongoDB e Cassandra, l'esperienza con tecnologie di containerizzazione quali Docker e Kubernetes, la familiarità con pipeline CI/CD, con strumenti di versionamento come Git e con i principali concetti di Data Warehouse e modellazione dei dati.

Soft Skills


Capacità di lavorare in team multidisciplinari.
Orientamento al problem solving e alla scalabilità delle soluzioni.
Autonomia nello sviluppo, ma con attitudine alla collaborazione



Sede: Milano/Torino ibrido

Offriamo contratto a tempo indeterminato (CCNL Commercio e Servizi) con RAL compresa tra 25.000 € e 35.000 €, da definire sulla base dell'esperienza professionale e delle competenze maturate.

Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91 e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03.

Title: Senior CRM Data Scientist
Description:
Per rafforzare il team CRM stiamo cercando un/a Senior CRM Data Scientist che guidi la costruzione della nostra capability analitica avanzata, sviluppando modelli predittivi, sistemi di segmentazione e insight strategici data-driven a supporto della crescita del valore cliente.

Il/la Senior Customer Intelligence Analyst sarà responsabile dello sviluppo end‑to‑end dei principali modelli di machine learning applicati al CRM, della trasformazione dei dati cliente in insight azionabili e della definizione dei framework analitici alla base delle strategie di personalizzazione, retention e loyalty.

La figura opererà come punto di riferimento tecnico e metodologico per le analisi avanzate, contribuendo attivamente alla roadmap data-driven dell’azienda.




Responsabilità principali:




Customer Intelligence & Advanced Analytics

Progettazione e sviluppo di modelli predittivi avanzati (churn, CLV, propensity, next best action) con Python e SQL.
Costruzione e gestione di sistemi di clustering e segmentazione avanzata basati su machine learning (unsupervised).
Esecuzione di analisi comportamentali sui clienti finalizzate a migliorare acquisition, retention e valore del customer lifecycle.
Creazione di framework analitici per ottimizzare targeting, personalizzazione e comunicazioni CRM.
Conduzione di analisi sperimentali e A/B test sui principali touchpoint.

Data Visualization & Performance Reporting

Sviluppo e governance di dashboard strategiche in Tableau su KPI cliente, CLV, engagement e performance campagne.
Costruzione di metriche avanzate e modelli di attribution per misurare l'impatto delle iniziative CRM.

Data Management & Data Quality

Collaborazione con IT per garantire disponibilità, integrità e scalabilità dei dataset cliente.
Definizione dei requisiti per nuove fonti dati e processi di data enrichment.
Supervisione dell’integrazione dati tra sistemi legacy, CRM platform e data warehouse.

Supporto Strategico & Cross‑team Leadership

Partner strategico del team CRM per definizione di logiche di personalizzazione, journey e automazioni.
Supporto nella definizione di strategie basate su machine learning e insight avanzati.




Competenze tecniche:

Esperienza consolidata: 5+ anni in Data Science, Customer Analytics, CRM Analytics o ruoli simili.
Ottima conoscenza di SQL e gestione di dataset complessi (big data, multi-touchpoint).
Padronanza di Python o altri tools per modellistica statistica e machine learning.
Esperienza comprovata nello sviluppo di:
modelli predittivi (churn, CLV, propensity)
clustering avanzato e segmentazione comportamentale
regressioni e modelli classificatori
Solida capacità di costruire dashboard e KPI complessi in Tableau.
Conoscenza delle logiche CRM, loyalty, database marketing e customer lifecycle.
Plus: esperienza con piattaforme di automazione marketing e modelli LLM applicati all’analisi clienti.




Soft skills

Approccio analitico rigoroso e orientamento alla risoluzione di problemi complessi.
Capacità di rendere comprensibili e azionabili insight tecnici per stakeholder non tecnici.
Mindset strategico con attenzione al dettaglio.
Ottime doti comunicative e capacità di lavorare in team cross‑funzionali.
Proattività, autonomia e orientamento all'innovazione.




Cosa offriamo:

Un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione customers data-driven dell’azienda
Possibilità di lavorare con tecnologie moderne.
Opportunità di guidare la costruzione di modelli e framework analitici avanzati.
Ambiente dinamico, collaborativo e con forte orientamento all’innovazione.

XTEL is a leading global revenue management solutions provider for consumer goods companies (CPG). We help our clients' businesses grow smarter, every day, through our holistic and proven digitalisation and change management approach. By combining state-of-the-art technology, deep industry expertise, and a proven approach to data and change management, XTEL's Revenue Management suite supports CPGs towards value realisation and profitable revenue growth.




Position Overview

The Data Scientist supports the design and delivery of analytics and machine learning solutions by working with complex datasets, building tailored models, and contributing to scalable data pipelines. The role collaborates closely with technical, functional, product, and client stakeholders to develop robust solutions and help standardize analytics practices across projects.




Key Responsibilities

Analyze and preprocess complex data sets from various sources to prepare them for analytics solutions.
Develop, implement, and fine-tune machine learning models tailored to specific project needs.
Collaborate with the team to build robust and scalable data pipelines.
Participate in client meetings to discuss technical results and gather feedback.
Work together with the functional team involved in the project, including business experts and the project manager.
Provide technical support and mentorship to junior team members, promoting knowledge sharing within the team.
Work together with the product team to integrate developed solutions into our products.
Document processes and contribute to the standardization of analytics solutions.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in STEM fields, such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related disciplines.
3-6 years of work experience in Data Science and Analytics.
Knowledge for Data Science, including Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Operations Research.
Strong knowledge of Python and main Machine Learning frameworks, such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with object-oriented programming.
Practical experience in developing, validating, and tuning Machine Learning models.
Experience with cloud services to store data, build automated pipelines, and run analytics or machine learning solutions.
Experience with Databricks.
Familiarity with development tools such as VSCode or other IDEs, and Jupyter notebooks.
Knowledge of Git, including push, pull, fetch, and merge.
Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and communicate complex results clearly.
Strong analytical skills with a critical thinking attitude.
Proficient in English.

Nice to have:

Experience with SQL for data manipulation and analysis.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist – Advanced Analytics | Retail Industry




We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join an Advanced Analytics team within the retail industry.

You will work on high-impact data and AI initiatives across e-commerce, marketing, customer experience, stores, product, supply chain, and procurement. The role combines traditional Data Science with Generative AI, AI Agents, and MLOps, offering the opportunity to contribute to an ambitious digital retail strategy.




Your Responsibilities




Data Science & Machine Learning

Analyze large and complex datasets using advanced statistical and machine learning techniques.
Identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights to support business decision-making.
Design, build, and deploy predictive and prescriptive ML models.
Develop solutions leveraging Generative AI and AI Agents.
Continuously optimize, fine-tune, and improve model performance.




MLOps & Production

Apply MLOps best practices throughout the machine learning lifecycle.
Implement model versioning, CI/CD, and automated deployment.
Monitor model performance and establish retraining and maintenance processes.
Ensure models are scalable, reliable, and production-ready.




Collaboration & Business Impact

Work closely with data platform teams, data insights teams, and business stakeholders.
Translate business challenges into effective data-driven solutions.
Communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Independently lead Data Science projects from concept through delivery.




Innovation & Generative AI

Stay current with developments in Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
Explore new technologies and approaches to strengthen advanced analytics capabilities.
Investigate and implement emerging AI-agent technologies.




Your Profile




Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, or another relevant scientific/business discipline.
Minimum 3 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist.
Strong experience with advanced statistics, predictive modelling, and machine learning.
Ability to transform complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly:
Vertex AI
BigQuery
Dataform
Experience with Agentic AI on GCP, such as ADK or Model Armor, is a strong plus.
Understanding of MLOps, model deployment, monitoring, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban).
Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of projects end-to-end.
Strong communication and collaboration skills with both technical and business stakeholders.
Previous retail or e-commerce experience is a plus.
Fluent English + professional French or Dutch.




Why This Opportunity?




This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Data Science, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and digital retail, delivering solutions with direct business impact across multiple domains.

You'll join a collaborative Advanced Analytics environment where you can take ownership of challenging projects and help shape the next generation of AI-driven retail solutions.

Title: Data Scientist Engineer
Description:
Devoteam is a leading consulting firm focused on digital transformation. We help our clients leverage technology to achieve their business goals.

Our longstanding partnerships with leaders like AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft, and ServiceNow amplify our capabilities, allowing us to deliver top-tier expertise and award-winning services. We complement these partnerships with in-depth Cyber, Data & AI, Software development and multi cloud expertise.

For 30 years, we have always been guiding our customers on the next tech wave. Devoteam has guided organizations through the Internet and cloud. The next revolution? AI.

With 11,000 tech natives working in 25+ countries, we bring you highly skilled IT experts across Europe

At Devoteam, tech is in our DNA, and it’s the people we empower with tech. Now, with responsible AI, we’re ready to unlock a future where technology drives positive change.

Job Description

Are you passionate about data-driven platforms, machine learning models, and innovative applications? As a Data Scientist/Engineer at Devoteam, you'll play a hands-on role in delivering impactful solutions across various clients and industries. Each mission we undertake has clear deliverables and deadlines, ensuring you gain diverse experience. For example, one month you might develop a predictive maintenance model, and the next, a customer segmentation model for a retail client.

Key Responsibilities:


Platform Setup: Design and implement robust data platforms using Azure, AWS or Google Cloud and Databricks.
Data Management: Gather, prepare, and manage data for analysis.
Model Research: Investigate and select appropriate machine learning models.
ML Modeling: Develop and refine machine learning models.
Client Collaboration: Spend approximately 50% of your time working directly with clients, either independently or as part of a team.



Your Role:


Build and maintain data platforms and pipelines using Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, Databricks, and Python.
Develop predictive and machine learning models tailored to client needs.
Advise clients on translating their business requirements into technical solutions using machine learning techniques.
Stay updated on the latest trends in machine learning and AI, sharing insights with clients.
Act as a strategic partner to client Data Science teams, helping them navigate their challenges and aspirations.
Inspire clients with new data-driven opportunities.
Bring best practices in Git, DevOps, and CICD to enhance client data platforms.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Business Stakeholders.
Represent Devoteam both online and offline, showcasing our expertise.



Qualifications

About You:


Reside in Belgium. (Mandatory)
Hold a university degree in Computer Science, (Business) Engineering, or a specialized master's in Machine Learning or AI.
Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role.
Have a solid understanding of various machine learning models (e.g., SVM, RNN, Deep Learning) and their applications.
Possess foundational knowledge of Data Science, including sampling techniques and evaluation metrics.
Proficient in SQL and Python.
Experience with Spark and/or cloud ecosystems is a must.
Experience with Databricks is real asset
Eager to learn and passionate about data and machine learning technologies.
Excited to join a dynamic and growing team.
Fluent in English; proficiency in Dutch or French is mandatory
Sponsorship for a work permit not possible



Additional Information

Why choose us?


Thrive in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment
Work with innovative and impactful Cloud, Data & AI projects for industry-leading clients
Connect with extraordinary talents in a collaborative and diverse culture
Enjoy a healthy work-life balance in an inspiring, eco-friendly workplace
Competitive compensation package



At Devoteam, we combine strong values – respect, frankness, ambition, entrepreneurship & collaboration – with a fun and supportive environment that empowers you to innovate, grow, and succeed in the fast-paced world of Cloud, Data & AI.

Title: Data scientist
Description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Hoe maak jij mee het verschil?

Als Data Scientist – in de Corporate strategy dienst – ontwikkel en onderhoud je strategische modellen die diepgaande inzichten opleveren en direct bijdragen aan beleidskeuzes en investeringsbeslissingen.

Je werkt op het kruispunt van data, business en strategie en zorgt ervoor dat complexe assumpties en berekeningen transparant, robuust en reproduceerbaar worden geïmplementeerd in schaalbare data-oplossingen.

Je komt terecht in een agile team waar PySpark centraal staat voor de ontwikkeling van dataoplossingen. Daarbij werken we met Azure Databricks, Azure DevOps en VS Code. Samenwerking, kennisdeling en kwaliteit staan centraal.

Wat is jouw rol bij NMBS?

Als Data Scientist Heb Je De Volgende Verantwoordelijkheden


Je ontwikkelt, onderhoudt en industrialiseert strategische modellen op basis van businessassumpties, in samenwerking met de relevante stakeholders.
Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende NMBS-directies in een transversale context over de hele organisatie.
Je vertaalt bestaande modellen, die vandaag lokaal beheerd worden, naar robuuste en schaalbare PySpark-oplossingen.
Je automatiseert dataverwerking en modelruns via pipelines in Databricks.
Je werkt met Python en PySpark binnen een Azure Databricks-omgeving om data te verwerken, modellen te implementeren en analyses uit te voeren.
Je waakt over transparantie, reproduceerbaarheid en best practices bij het implementeren van modellen.
Je verkent opportuniteiten om bijkomende databronnen en analysetechnieken (zoals ruimtelijke data, AI of geavanceerde visualisaties) te integreren wanneer deze een duidelijke meerwaarde bieden voor strategische inzichten.
Je volgt de AI en machine learning evoluties actief op en denkt mee na over hoe ze het strategisch modelleren kunnen versterken.


Waarom is deze job iets voor jou?


Je beschikt over een masterdiploma bij voorkeur in wiskunde, statistiek, data science, ingenieurswetenschappen of een andere kwantitatieve richting) (of gelijkwaardig door ervaring) EN een ervaring van minstens 4 jaar ervaring in de industrie als data scientist.


EN Je Beschikt Over De Volgende Vaardigheden


Je hebt een sterke Python-kennis voor data wrangling data-analyse en modellering.
Je hebt een goede en aantoonbare kennis van PySpark en het werken met grotere datasets. PySpark is een kerncompetentie voor deze functie.
Je hebt ervaring met het industrialiseren van analyses of modellen.
Je kan autonoom werken, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je opdrachten en weet zelfstandig tot oplossing te komen, met de nodige afstemming binnen het team.
Je communiceert vlot, zowel in het Nederlands als in het Engels en je kan complexe modellen en assumpties helder toelichten aan niet-technische stakeholders.
Je hebt een gestructureerde mindset en bent oplossings- en kwaliteitsgericht.

We vinden het dan ook belangrijk dat je jezelf kan zijn. Want dat maakt NMBS sterker. Daarom hechten we veel belang aan diversiteit en inclusie.

Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

Een aantrekkelijk salaris aangevuld met een 13e maand, onkostenvergoeding, maaltijdcheques en een collectieve en individuele bonus.
Een deel van het salaris wordt aangeboden als een flexibel budget. Je kan daarbij kiezen voor fietslease, lease auto, terugbetaling pensioensparen, ...
Een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Flexibele werkuren, de mogelijkheid om te telewerken en 33 vakantiedagen per jaar.
Een treinabonnement in België, kortingen op internationale treinreizen en een fietsvergoeding.
Voordelen voor je gezin: o.a. kortingen op gezinsactiviteiten en in winkelketens.


Waar ga je werken?

Je werkt in de buurt van het station Brussel-Zuid, in het gebouw Delta.

What’s next?


Je solliciteert online en je voegt een motivatiebrief toe. Beschrijf daarin kort je professionele ervaring met PySpark: hoeveel jaar ervaring je hebt, hoe recent je ermee hebt gewerkt en in welke context. Vermeld ook je ervaring met Databricks of vergelijkbare platformen. Vertel tot slot waarom deze functie je aanspreekt.
We screenen je CV en motivatiebrief. Bij een positieve screening volgt een HR-gesprek om je motivatie en match met NMBS te bespreken. We stellen ook enkele technische verkennende vragen.
Verloopt dit positief? Je ontvangt een technische opdracht die besproken wordt in een tweede gesprek. Ter voorbereiding op dit gesprek vragen we jou om een online persoonlijkheidsvragenlijst in te vullen.
Op basis van de volledige selectieprocedure kiezen we de best passende kandidaat. Daarna volgt een kennismaking met de Head of Corporate Strategy en de betrokken leidinggevende.
Verloopt deze laatste kennismaking goed? Er volgt dan een contractvoorstel.
Je bent klaar voor je eerste werkdag!

Title: Data scientist _FR
Description:
Comment pouvez-vous faire la différence ?

En tant que Data scientist – dans le service Corporate strategy, vous développez et maintenez des modèles stratégiques qui fournissent des insights approfondis et qui contribuent directement aux choix politiques et aux décisions d’investissement.

Vous travaillez à l’intersection des données, du business et de la stratégie et vous veillez à ce que des hypothèses et calculs complexes soient implémentés de manière transparente, robuste et reproductible dans des solutions de données évolutives.

Vous intégrez une équipe agile où PySpark occupe une place centrale dans le développement de solutions data. Nous travaillons avec Azure Databricks, Azure DevOps et VS Code. La collaboration, le partage de connaissance et la qualité sont essentiels.

Quel est votre rôle à la SNCB ?

En tant que Data scientist, vous aurez les responsabilités suivantes :


Vous développez, maintenez et industrialisez des modèles stratégiques sur la base d’hypothèses métier, en collaboration avec les parties prenantes concernées.
Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des collègues de différentes directions de la SNCB dans un contexte transversal à l’échelle de toute l’organisation.
Vous traduisez des modèles existants, aujourd’hui gérés localement, en solutions PySpark robustes et évolutives.
Vous automatisez le traitement des données et l’exécution des modèles via des pipelines dans Databricks.
Vous travaillez avec Python et PySpark dans un environnement Azure Databricks pour traiter les données, implémenter des modèles et réaliser des analyses.
Vous veillez à la transparence, à la reproductibilité et au respect des bonnes pratiques lors de l’implémentation des modèles.
Vous explorez les opportunités d’intégrer des sources de données et des techniques analytiques supplémentaires (telles que les données spatiales, l’IA ou des visualisations avancées) lorsqu’elles apportent une réelle valeur ajoutée aux insights stratégiques.
Vous suivez activement les évolutions IA et machine learning et réfléchissez à la manière dont elles peuvent renforcer la modélisation stratégique.


Un job fait pour vous ?


Vous avez un master, de préférence en mathématiques, statistiques, data science, sciences de l’ingénieur ou une autre discipline quantitative (ou équivalent par expérience) ET une expérience de minimum 4 ans en tant que data scientist en industrie.


ET vous disposez des compétences suivantes :


Vous êtes doté.e d’une solide connaissance de Python pour le data wrangling, l’analyse de données et la modélisation.
Vous avez de l’expérience avec PySpark et le travail avec de grands volumes de données.
Vous avez de l’expérience dans l’industrialisation d’analyses ou de modèles (par exemple la migration d’Excel vers du code de production).
Vous communiquez aisément, aussi bien en français qu’en anglais et pouvez expliquer clairement des modèles complexes et des hypothèses à des parties prenantes non techniques.
Vous avez un esprit structuré et êtes orienté.e solution et qualité.
Vous avez un intérêt pour le machine learning, les applications d’IA, les données géographiques ou outils GIS (par ex. QGIS, ArcGIS), le transport, la mobilité ou des systèmes opérationnels complexes ? Il s’agit d’atouts en plus.


Si vous avez obtenu votre diplôme à l'étranger, vous devez être en possession d'une attestation d'équivalence délivrée par la Communauté française pour pouvoir participer à la sélection.

Chaque personne est unique. Il est important pour nous que vous puissiez être vous-même. C’est ce qui rend la SNCB plus forte. C’est pourquoi nous accordons beaucoup d’importance à la diversité et à l’inclusion .

Qu'avons-nous à vous offrir ?

Choisir la SNCB, c'est choisir un environnement où vous pouvez apprendre et vous épanouir. Vous serez entouré de chouettes collègues qui vous soutiendront. En tant que Data Scientist, vous recevez un package salarial qui se compose de :


Un salaire attractif complété d'un 13e mois, d'une indemnité de frais, des chèques-repas et d'un bonus collectif et individuel.
Une partie du salaire est offerte sous forme de budget flexible. Vous pouvez opter pour la location d'un vélo, une voiture en leasing, pour le remboursement de l'épargne-pension, etc.
Une assurance hospitalisation et collective.
Un horaire flexible, un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à 33 jours de congés par an.
Un abonnement de train en Belgique, des avantages sur les lignes internationales et une indemnité vélo.
Des avantages pour votre famille comme des réductions sur les sorties en famille et dans les magasins.


Où allez-vous travailler ?

Vous travaillerez à proximité de la gare du Midi, dans le bâtiment Delta.

What’s next ?


Vous postulez en ligne et ajoutez votre lettre de motivation. Vous y décrivez brièvement votre expérience professionnelle avec PySpark : le nombre d’années d’expérience, à quel point cette expérience est récente et dans quel contexte vous l’avez utilisé. Indiquez-y également votre expérience avec Databricks ou des plateformes comparables. Finalement, racontez-nous ce qui vous attire dans ce job.
Nous analysons votre CV et lettre de motivation. Le screening est positif ? Un court entretien HR pour discuter de votre motivation, du match avec la SNCB est planifié. Nous vous posons également quelques questions techniques.
L’entretien est positif ? Vous recevez alors un exercice technique qui sera abordé pendant le 2e entretien. Pour préparer cet entretien, vous complétez un questionnaire de personnalité en ligne.
Sur la base de l’ensemble de la procédure de sélection, nous choisissions le candidat ou la candidate qui convient le mieux. Vous faites alors la connaissance du Head of Corporate strategy et du manager.
Si cette dernière rencontre est positive, vous recevez une proposition salariale.
Vous commencez votre nouveau job !


Nous nous réservons le droit d'ajuster ou de suspendre cette procédure en cas de nécessité. Notre équipe de recrutement sélectionnera les profils les plus en adéquation avec les exigences du poste afin de garantir une correspondance optimale.

Les statistiques

De la connaissance des méthodologies agiles

Une excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais est attendue, ainsi qu’une bonne maîtrise du néerlandais.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Are you an experienced data scientist? Do you know how to create reliable predictions and optimal decisions based on complex and large datasets? Do you want to put your talent to use and contribute to the energy transition by building innovative energy management solutions?




What you'll work on

Probabilistic forecasting of electricity consumption and on-site generation at client premises — not only point forecasts, but the uncertainty estimates the control layer needs to make defensible decisions.
Turning forecasts into control actions: converting forecasts and price signals into dispatch decisions across our clients' assets — batteries, PV and EV charging — with a single objective, minimizing their energy bill. In practice this means formulating and solving a constrained optimisation problem over each site's tariff structure, capacity limits and asset behavior, and doing it well enough that the result holds up when the forecast turns out to be wrong.
Real-time execution, including control logic running on edge devices, that stays stable when conditions deviate from plan.
Closing the loop between prediction, decision and execution, so the system runs unattended and improves on its own operating history. In practice: tracking forecast error against realized load and generation to drive retraining; comparing the savings actually achieved against what the optimiser expected, and attributing the gap to the forecast, the formulation or the asset; and correcting our models of the assets themselves — round-trip efficiency, degradation, state-of-charge drift — against what the fleet really does.
R&D delivery: work alongside our Research Manager and top tier Research institutes on the data science workstreams of our ongoing research projects.




What we're looking for

Mathematical optimisation is essential for this role: linear and quadratic programming, mixed-integer formulations, and ideally stochastic programming. You should be comfortable moving from a business objective to a formulation, and from a formulation to something that solves reliably within an operational time budget.
A strong foundation in machine learning, time series forecasting and statistical modelling.
Practical experience with real-time control algorithms on edge devices — PID, rule-based supervisory control, MPC, or comparable approaches you have deployed and maintained in the field.
A problem solver by instinct: you're comfortable being handed an ambiguous situation, working out what's actually going on, and deciding what to do about it.
The ability to explain a complex model or control decision to a non-technical audience — colleagues in sales and operations, and clients who want to understand why their battery did what it did.
Commercial judgement: you can tell the difference between the solution that is optimal on paper and the one that goes live this quarter and starts paying for itself.
Fluency in Python.




A clear plus

Working knowledge of energy systems: electricity markets, load forecasting, asset dispatch, balancing mechanisms.
Experience with AI Coding.
Experience with AWS.
A track record with messy field data — gaps, drift, sensors that contradict one another.
Experience shipping models and controllers into production systems that run unattended, with monitoring in place. Notebooks are where the work starts, not where it ends.




What's in it for you

Hardware in the loop. Your algorithms don't stop at an API boundary. They move megawatts through equipment installed at real sites.
A short feedback loop. Models go live, are measured against real financial outcomes, and get improved. You'll know within days whether an idea worked.
Room to set the direction. The team is small enough that your decisions about modelling, tooling and control architecture become the way Octave.energy does it.
A mission with urgency. A renewable grid runs on flexibility: shifting demand towards the hours when the wind blows and the sun shines. Batteries, PV and EV charging are the three levers we pull, and better forecasting and control get more out of each of them.




We also offer

An attractive salary package
Offices in Mechelen and Brussels
Flexible hours and hybrid working (2–3 days in the office)
A collaborative team with genuine room to learn and grow in a fast-growing cleantech scale-up
An attractive benefits package: Car/mobility budget, hospitalization & group insurance, training budget, cafeteria plan with 13th-month optimization, €10/day of lunch vouchers, eco-cheques and extra benefits (e.g., gym subscription).




About Octave.energy

Founded in April 2020, Octave.energy is a Belgian cleantech company specialized in battery energy storage and energy management services for businesses. We have sold over 200 MWh of storage capacity and operate the largest fleet of behind-the-meter batteries in Belgium. Backed by private investors, imec, and the European Commission's EIC Accelerator, we work at the forefront of the energy transition.




Interested?

Send your CV to recruitment@octave.energy, along with a few lines about something you've built — a forecasting model, a controller you designed, a project that shows how you approach a problem. We'll get back to you shortly.

Description:
About Umicore

Powering the cars of today and tomorrow. Reducing harmful emissions. Giving unique properties to high-end applications. Giving new life to used metals. As a global advanced materials and recycling group, we develop, produce, and recycle materials for a better life.

Title: Data Scientist Sparen & Betalen
Description:
Ben jij gepassioneerd door data, analytics en AI? Krijg je energie van het ontdekken van patronen en het bouwen van slimme modellen die écht impact hebben op de business? Dan ben jij de Data Scientist die we zoeken om Argenta verder te laten groeien als datagedreven organisatie.

Welkom in het team

Als Data Scientist help je mee om complexe data om te zetten in inzichten, modellen en concrete toepassingen die onze business versterken. Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende stakeholders en draagt zo actief bij aan innovatie, automatisering en betere beslissingen op basis van data.

Jouw rol in het team:


Je analyseert businessnoden en vertaalt deze naar concrete data science oplossingen en use cases.
Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en onderhoudt modellen en algoritmes (descriptief, predictief en prescriptief).
Je detecteert niet-triviale patronen in data via machine learning en statistische technieken.
Je bouwt en operationaliseert beslissingsalgoritmes en automatisaties samen met de business.
Je beheert de volledige lifecycle van modellen: van intake en ontwikkeling tot monitoring en optimalisatie.
Je werkt met tools zoals Python, R en data science platformen om robuuste oplossingen te bouwen.
Je verzekert de kwaliteit van data en modellen via monitoring, validatie en data cleaning.
Je ondersteunt de business in het begrijpen van inzichten en algoritmes en vertaalt deze naar acties.
Je draagt bij aan een datagedreven cultuur en begeleidt collega’s bij het gebruik van data science oplossingen.
Je werkt samen met stakeholders uit business, IT en data teams om impactvolle oplossingen te realiseren.


Argenta en jij: een match?

Als je bij Argenta komt werken, word je Argentaan. Maar Argentaan zijn is meer dan een job hebben bij Argenta.

Bij alles wat je doet, verlies je nooit onze focuswaarden uit het oog: we werken samen, in alle eenvoud, voor onze klanten.

Dat doe je met kennis van zaken, en altijd met twee voeten op de grond. Als Argentaan geef je elke dag opnieuw het beste van jezelf. Je komt terecht in een veilige omgeving waarin je fouten mag maken. En waarin we elkaar durven uitdagen en feedback geven. We zijn ambitieus en leggen de lat hoog. Door elkaar te helpen raken we samen over die lat. Zo maken we een positief verschil voor onze medewerkers, onze klanten en de samenleving.

Wees gerust: bij Argenta kun je gewoon jezelf zijn. Jouw talenten en ambities staan centraal. Groeien en samen winnen, daar gaan we voor.

Jouw loonpakket


Een aantrekkelijk brutoloon
Maaltijdcheques
Groepsverzekering
Hospitalisatieverzekering
Netto onkostenvergoeding van 165 euro per maand
Een cafetariaplan waarmee je het bedrag van je 13de maand flexibel kunt inzetten om aan voordelige voorwaarden bijvoorbeeld een smartphone te leasen of extra verlofdagen aan te kopen
Keuze tussen een bedrijfswagen (inclusief tankkaart of laadoplossing) of een aantrekkelijk mobiliteitsbudget dat je kunt spenderen aan duurzame mobiliteitsalternatieven, zoals de aankoop van een fiets, het gebruik van een deelauto of de terugbetaling van je huisvestingskosten


Extra

Een goede balans tussen werk en privé vinden we even belangrijk als een mooie verloning. Je werkuren vul je dan ook flexibel in. Op kantoor of thuis werken? Jij kiest. Je werkt gemiddeld 60% van thuis uit.

Jouw troeven

Zin in de job? Voel je de match? Check nog even of je ook de juiste ingesteldheid en achtergrondkennis hebt en ga ervoor.


Je hebt een masterdiploma en relevante ervaring binnen data science.
Je hebt ervaring met data science technieken, algoritmes en machine learning.
Je hebt hands-on ervaring met tools zoals Python, R of gelijkaardig.
Kennis van de LangChain-stack, om de orchestratie van AI-workflows zelfstandig mee vorm te geven, is een plus.
Je bent sterk in het vertalen van businessvragen naar analytische oplossingen.
Je hebt een analytische en kritische mindset en ziet snel verbanden in complexe data.
Je bent communicatief en in staat om complexe inzichten helder uit te leggen aan stakeholders.
Je hebt interesse in AI, IDP, automatisatie en datagedreven procesoptimalisaties.
Je werkt resultaatgericht en proactief en neemt ownership over je oplossingen.
Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring in een financiële context of complexe data-omgevingen.
Je hebt oog voor datakwaliteit, governance en risicobeheersing.


Heb je nog een vraag?

Stuur gerust een e-mail naar Karine Geurts via jobs@argenta.be.

Title: DATA SCIENTIST
Description:
At Ayesa Digital, we grow with you.




Every professional in our company is essential. Thanks to their talent, we continue to expand: today, we are a global team of more than 11,000 people working toward a shared mission.




Ayesa Digital is currently participating in high-impact European Union projects designed to address major European challenges and drive science and innovation. These strategic technological initiatives stand out for their international scope and strong commitment to socially oriented results.




We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our international team and contribute to collaborate with stakeholders to collect requirements, fram business problemas as data science hypotheses, define success metrics, and develop or deploy advanced data mining and machine learning solutions.




Key Responsibilities




Collaborate with User Experience (UX) and product teams to specify design requirements for the effective presentation and interpretation of model outputs and insights.
Develop process to monitor and analyse data accuracy.
Identify, collect, and prepare data for analysis, collaborating with Data Analysts to ensure robust production-grade data pipelines, with a focus on feature engineering and data readiness for modelling.
Produce data models according to specific problems statements.
Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and scripts to solve specific business problems.
Collaborate with Data Analysts and Architects on the design of the analytics architecture to ensure it supports the scalability and performance requirements of data science models.
Write the different documentation associated with the tasks and liaise with other teams as necessary to address cross-system interdependencies.
Developing visualizations to communicate model behaviour, key insights, and performance metrics, and collaborating with Data Analysts on integrated dashboard reporting.
Design, develop, and evaluate predictive models capable of handling both structured and unstructured data, including model selection, training, and hyperparameter tuning
Elaborate processes to ensure the compliant implementation of regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act), including model risk management, monitoring for drift/bias, and comprehensive documentation (e.g., model cards).
Ensure that model development, deployment, and monitoring practices adhere to all relevant regulatory frameworks and internal governance policies.
Communicate model insights, limitations, and behaviour effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences, and create interpretable outputs and documentation.
Conduct rigorous experiment design (e.g., A/B testing), employ cross-validation techniques, and perform statistical significance testing to validate findings and model performance.
Deploy and maintain models into production using Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) practices, including Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, model registries, and ensuring reproducibility.




What We Are Looking For (Requirements):




Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques and tools (e.g., Python, R, SAS, Spark) to design and implement data-driven solutions.
Knowledge of machine learning and natural language processing (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face) to build predictive and text-based models.
Knowledge of programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL; Perl optional) commonly used in data science for modelling and automation.
Knowledge of MLOps practices (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, model registry, unit testing frameworks) to ensure reproducibility and quality in model delivery.
Knowledge of business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, SAS, SAP Analytics) to visualise and communicate model outputs and insights.
Knowledge of data engineering and ETL processes using tools (e.g., Talend, Informatica, dbt, Azure Data Factory) to prepare training datasets.
Knowledge of data storage and query technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL, MongoDB, Hadoop) to extract and process data at scale.
Knowledge of designing scalable data storage solutions (e.g., data lakes, lakehouses, distributed stores) for advanced analytics and AI workloads.
Knowledge of advanced analytics applications such as forecasting, recommendation systems, anomaly detection, or sentiment analysis for business impact.
Knowledge of AI governance principles (e.g., transparency, explainability, fairness, accountability) aligned with emerging EU AI Act requirements.
Knowledge of AI compliance, risks, and mitigation practices (e.g., bias monitoring, drift detection, model cards).
Knowledge of data and AI regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, EU AI Act) and ability to design models compliant with legal and ethical standards.
Knowledge of experiment design (e.g., A/B testing, cross-validation, significance testing) to validate models rigorously.
Knowledge of model deployment practices (e.g., containerization, APIs, serving frameworks) to operationalise machine learning solutions.




One of the following or an equivalent certification:

AWS Certified Machine Learning.
Specialty or Azure AI Engineer Associate.




What We Offer:

Prestigious projects within European institutions.
International, innovative, and multicultural environments.
Continuous support from a team of experts in EU projects.




If you are ambitious, enthusiastic, and seeking a new professional challenge in international projects with real-world impact, this is the place for you!

Furthermore, we promote diversity and reject any discrimination based on race, gender, functional diversity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other personal or social condition, striving to build an inclusive and enriching environment.

Title: Applied Data Scientist
Description:
Company Overview

team.blue is the market leader in enabling digital success for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) across Europe, catering to over 3 million customers in 25+ languages. Our mission is to make online business success simpler, by providing our customers with all the tools and resources they need to excel online and remain ahead of the curve.

Position Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Applied Data Scientist who thrives at the intersection of AI, product thinking, and innovation. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing Data Science & ML algorithms to solve complex, real-world business problems across the team.blue group. This role requires strong analytical skills, programming, problem solving and data wrangling skills, good communication abilities, and up-to-date knowledge of the latest Data Science/ML/AI developments.

Responsibilities:


Break down multi-domain business problems with a strong focus on return on investment and impact metrics, and think through the appropriate technical methods from POC to production
Develop solutions and extract insight from data using data science and classical machine learning methods and generative AI (GenAI)
Take ownership of developing, implementing, and automating robust data science and ML models and pipelines, including feature generation, modeling, evaluation, retraining and deployment
Translate sophisticated analytical findings and model outcomes into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, demonstrably driving value and improvements in key business metrics
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver innovative Data Science/ML/AI solutions
Conduct research on the latest Data Science/ML/AI developments and apply them to improve our systems
Document processes, code, and findings for future reference and knowledge sharing



Required Skills:


8+ years hands-on industry experience solving data science and machine learning problems to address real-world business problems across multiple verticals
Expert programming skills in Python and SQL and with relevant Data Science & ML frameworks (Scikit-learn, Pandas, PyTorch, etc)
Ability to think through problems from fundamental principles and operate with a high degree of independence and autonomy while bringing clarity to under-specified problems
Deep understanding of statistical and ML algorithms, methodologies and approaches ranging from SVMs to deep learning & LLMs
Ability to own the end to end of the lifecycle of ML/AI projects from conception to containerization
History of hands-on ownership & implementer of projects that have been put in production and made an impact
Experience in applying statistical concepts (e.g. regressions, A/B tests, clustering, probability) to business problems
Strong problem-solving skills with excellent verbal & written communication and the ability to craft analysis into well-written and persuasive content
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams



Nice to have skills


Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, AI, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Machine Learning, or related fields.
Deep understanding of current DataOps & MLOps practices, deploying and monitoring models and ETL (extract, transform and load) pipelines
Experience with AI/ML R&D
Experience across startups and enterprise firms
Experience with distributed data tools (e.g. Spark, Dask, Apache Arrow), observability frameworks (OTel)



"Come as you are"

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity & Inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

The most trusted digital enabler

team.blue is a leading digital enabler for companies and entrepreneurs. It serves over 3.3 million customers in Europe and has more than 3,000 experts to support them. Its goal is to shape technology and to empower businesses with innovative digital services.

Title: R&D Data Scientist | Automotive
Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Your Role

As an R&D Data Scientist, you will play a key role in:


Analysing vehicle telemetry, driving data, and unstructured data sources (including verbatim text) to build interpretable features and dimensions that define driving patterns and behaviours.
Linking real-world telemetry data with survey responses, customer personas, and behavioural indicators to generate a rich, multi-dimensional understanding of driver profiles.
Reviewing relevant academic and technical literature, assessing applicability to the project, and rapidly testing approaches through proof-of-concepts on real, messy data.
Comparing and validating analytical methods — including clustering, dimensionality reduction, factor analysis, and supervised/unsupervised modelling — with rigorous attention to robustness, reliability, and limitations.
Collaborating with engineers to ensure findings are technically grounded, and communicating results clearly with well-reasoned recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Your Profile


Technical depth: Strong proficiency in Python for analysis, modelling and prototyping, combined with solid foundations in statistics, machine learning and AI — including feature engineering, dimensionality reduction and model validation.
Applied research capability: Able to read and critically assess technical material, adapt methods to real-world constraints, and design experiments on complex, ambiguous datasets — going well beyond running standard pipelines.
Engineering sensitivity: You understand what your data physically and behaviourally represents, and can judge whether results make sense in context — not just statistically, but meaningfully.
Communication and autonomy: You work independently, structure your own analyses, challenge weak or ambiguous results, and clearly communicate assumptions, limitations and conclusions to diverse audiences.
Fluent in English
Minimum 4 years of experience


What You Will Love About Working Here


Empowering environment - Autonomy and Goal setting are among the top scores with 8,4+ ratings in our monthly employee feedback Pulse.
FlexAbroad - Employees in 20+ countries can work abroad for up to 45 days in a 12-month period.
Free access to learning platforms - Free access for all to world-class learning assets and curated programs from Harvard Business Review, Coursera, Pluralsight, Udemy, Microsoft, AWS, Google and many more.
Worldwide Leader of Engineering Services - Capgemini Engineering combines its broad industry knowledge and cutting-edge technologies in digital and software to support the convergence of the physical and digital worlds. We help our clients unleashing their R&D potential to develop smart products and services of tomorrow.


Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

Position Overview

The Junior Data Scientist supports the design and delivery of analytics and machine learning solutions by working with complex datasets, building tailored models, and contributing to scalable data pipelines. The role collaborates closely with technical, functional, product, and client stakeholders to develop robust solutions and help standardize analytics practices across projects.




Key Responsibilities

Analyze and preprocess complex data sets from various sources to prepare them for analytics solutions.
Develop, implement, and fine-tune machine learning models tailored to specific project needs.
Collaborate with the team to build robust and scalable data pipelines.
Participate in client meetings to discuss technical results and gather feedback.
Work together with the functional team involved in the project, including business experts and the project manager.
Work together with the product team to integrate developed solutions into our products.
Document processes and contribute to the standardization of analytics solutions.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in STEM fields, such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related disciplines.
1-2 years of work experience in Data Science and Analytics.
Knowledge for Data Science, including Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Operations Research.
knowledge of Python and main Machine Learning frameworks, such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with object-oriented programming.
Experience in developing, validating, and tuning Machine Learning models.
Experience with cloud services to store data, build automated pipelines, and run analytics or machine learning solutions.
Experience with Databricks.
Familiarity with development tools such as VSCode or other IDEs, and Jupyter notebooks.
Knowledge of Git, including push, pull, fetch, and merge.
Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and communicate complex results clearly.
Analytical skills with a critical thinking attitude.
Proficient in English.

Nice to have:

Experience with SQL for data manipulation and analysis.

Title: Job | GenAI - Data Scientist | Brussel
Description:
Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

AI- & ML-solution development


Machine learning- en deep learning-modellen (inclusief generative AI) inzetten om complexe bedrijfsproblemen op te lossen.
Modellen optimaliseren voor prestaties, schaalbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie in Azure-cloudomgevingen.
MLOps-pijplijnen implementeren om modeltraining, validatie en uitrol te automatiseren.



Cloud- & AI-infrastructuur


Schaalbare AI-infrastructuur ontwikkelen en onderhouden op Azure-cloudplatformen, gebruikmakend van diensten zoals Azure ML en AKS.
Zorgen voor veilige, conforme en hoog-beschikbare AI-implementaties in de cloud.



Generatieve AI & Innovatie


Generative AI-modellen (LLM’s, enz.) verkennen en integreren voor toepassingen zoals: RAG, intelligent document processing, speech-to-text en conversational AI.
Vooroplopen in AI-trends (bijv. fine-tuning, multimodal AI) en innovatieve use cases voorstellen.



Data- & modelgovernance


Zorgen voor datakwaliteit, bias-mitigatie en ethische AI-praktijken bij modelontwikkeling.
Modelmonitoring en explainability-tools implementeren om prestaties en compliance te volgen.



Samenwerking & stakeholder engagement


Samenwerken met productteams, data scientists en zakelijke stakeholders om AI-kansen te identificeren.
Zakelijke vereisten vertalen naar technische AI-oplossingen en inzichten effectief communiceren.



De job in een notendop

Je speelt een centrale rol in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van geavanceerde AI- en machine learning-oplossingen die innovatie en automatisering binnen de organisatie stimuleren.

Je werkt samen met cross-functionele teams om cloudgebaseerde AI-diensten, generatieve AI en schaalbare ML-infrastructuur te benutten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat AI-modellen robuust, ethisch verantwoord en afgestemd zijn op de bedrijfsdoelstellingen.

Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn

Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan als je iemand bent met:


Een master of doctoraat in de wetenschappen met uitstekende academische resultaten op technisch gebied (econometrie, computerwetenschappen, artificiële intelligentie, e.a.).
Deskundigheid op het vlak van
machine learning technieken en bereidheid om die kennis up-to-date te houden; een diepgaande kennis van algoritmes zoals Random Forests, Neural Networks en reinforcement learning is hierbij een must.
genAI: prompt engineering, structured outputs, ...(zie verantwoordelijkheden).

Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python en SQL.
Uitgebreide kennis van Nederlands of Frans, met passieve kennis van de andere taal, en Engels.
Ervaring in het verklaren van complexe analyses aan een niet-technisch publiek aan de hand van je verhalende competenties en je capaciteit om data te visualiseren; je beschikt over uitmuntende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden op technisch en businessniveau.
Honger naar kennis, niet alleen om nieuwe algoritmes en technologieën te beheersen, maar ook op interpersoonlijk vlak; je bent je ervan bewust dat de waarde van jouw werk neerkomt op kwaliteit x acceptatie en je wilt sleutelen aan beide aspecten.
Uitzonderlijke probleemoplossende vaardigheden: je weet dat het juiste inzicht in een probleem minstens 90% van de oplossing uitmaakt, je geeft blijk van creativiteit en volharding bij het doorgronden van problemen en het zoeken van oplossingen.


Je scoort extra met:


Tweetaligheid (Engels en Nederlands of Frans).
Ervaring met het bouwen van dataproducten, van ontwerp tot productie.
Wat full-stack skills.
Kennis van cloud, bij voorkeur Azure.



Belfius koestert zijn talenten

Behalve de kans om elke dag te shinen, bieden wij jou een fulltime contract van onbepaalde duur met:


Een mooi loon aangevuld met een innovatief aanbod om een persoonlijk budget samen te stellen dat je kan besteden volgens je voorkeuren (bv. wagen, fiets, pc, smartphone, tablet, huisvesting onder bepaalde voorwaarden) en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, personeelsvoordeel op eigen producten en diensten, en een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Mogelijkheden te over om je te ontwikkelen door een brede waaier aan opleidingen en carrièrekansen in de hele Belfius-groep.
Een goede werk-privé balans dankzij flexibele uren, de combinatie kantoor- en thuiswerk en een aantrekkelijk aantal vakantiedagen.
Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Brussel met een coole fitness, een lekker gezond restaurant en gezellige ontmoetingsruimtes, dit alles op wandelafstand van de winkelstraat, het treinstation Brussel-Noord en de metrohalte Rogier.

Title: Senior Data Science Analyst - OptimusAI
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

As a Data Science Specialist, you’ll collaborate in a dynamic, multi-disciplinary team of 3–6 experts, using your creativity and analytics expertise to drive client performance in areas like energy efficiency, product quality, and capacity. You’ll work side-by-side with client process engineers and analytics specialists, presenting your insights directly to executive audiences.

Internally, you’ll partner with our talented product engineers to develop innovative products and algorithms that address both current and future client needs. You’ll play a key role in codifying best practices, amplifying our impact both inside and outside the firm, and shaping the product roadmap.

You’ll be based in our Brussels office as part of McKinsey’s manufacturing AI solution, OptimusAI, which sits at the intersection of three practices: Global Energy and Materials, QuantumBlack, and Operations.

Global Energy and Materials: Advises production and investor companies across chemicals & agriculture, paper & packaging, metals & mining, oil & gas, and power generation on strategic, operational, and growth issues.

QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey: The AI arm of our firm, helping clients transform faster, innovate smarter, and anticipate the future.

Operations: Assists clients in solving complex operational challenges by developing and implementing strategies and solutions for their most critical problems—connecting boardroom strategies to shop floor operators.

At the intersection of these groups, OptimusAI is a team of ~10 expert consultants, data scientists, and engineers focused on improving processing plant productivity through data analytics. We develop real-time AI advisory systems to support decision making in plant control rooms, optimize process control systems, and unlock plant bottlenecks through data-driven process changes.

OptimusAI also supports a global community of consultants by developing an innovative machine learning toolkit and codifying our approach to deliver significant and lasting client impact.

You’ll benefit from world-class training in business problem structuring and client advisory, working closely with senior manufacturing and analytics experts. Experience unparalleled career growth, with significant ownership and responsibility from day one, all within a collaborative, diverse, and non-hierarchical environment. Plus, seize the opportunity to travel to client sites—locally and around the world.

There is a flexibility to hire at different role level, depending on your experience.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, computer science, engineering, or a related field
3+ years of hands-on experience in advanced analytics, ideally within heavy industry environments
Advanced Python programming skills, with a passion for writing clean, efficient, modular, and maintainable code
Proven ability to implement and maintain MLOps pipelines for seamless model integration and deployment
Strong DevOps and backend engineering capabilities, including experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible)
Self-starter with excellent organizational abilities—able to independently initiate tasks and drive them to completion
Skilled in making rational, data-driven decisions based on facts and logical reasoning
Ability to create high-quality work products, such as PowerPoint presentations, Excel models, articles, or other written outputs
Exceptional time management skills to thrive in a complex, largely autonomous work environment
Willingness to work or attend meetings outside traditional business hours, and to take on projects at short notice when needed
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English with the ability to tailor your style to different audiences and seniority levels
