Title: Job | GenAI - Data Scientist | Bruxelles
Description:
Description

Vous jouez un rôle central dans la conception, le développement et la mise en œuvre de solutions d’IA et d’apprentissage automatique avancées, favorisant l’innovation et l’automatisation au sein de l’organisation.

Vous collaborez avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour tirer parti des services d’IA dans le cloud, de l’IA générative et d’une infrastructure d’apprentissage automatique évolutive.

Vous veillez à ce que les modèles d’IA soient robustes, éthiques et alignés sur les objectifs commerciaux.

Votre job en deux mots

Principales responsabilités :

Développement de solutions d’IA et d’apprentissage automatique :

Déploiement de modèles d’apprentissage automatique et d’apprentissage profond (y compris l’IA générative) pour résoudre des problèmes métier complexes.

Optimisation des modèles en termes de performance, d’évolutivité et de rentabilité dans les environnements cloud Azure.

Mise en œuvre de pipelines MLOps pour automatiser l’entraînement, la validation et le déploiement des modèles.

Infrastructure cloud et d’IA :

Développement et maintenance d’une infrastructure d’IA évolutive sur les plateformes cloud Azure, en utilisant des services tels qu’Azure ML et AKS.

Garantie de déploiements d’IA sécurisés, conformes et hautement disponibles dans le cloud. IA générative et innovation.

Explorer et intégrer des modèles d'IA générative (LLM, etc.) pour des applications telles que : RAG (Real Agile Agile), traitement intelligent de documents, transcription vocale et IA conversationnelle.

Anticiper les tendances en IA (par exemple, le fine-tuning, l'IA multimodale) et proposer des cas d'usage innovants.

Gouvernance des données et des modèles

Garantir la qualité des données, la réduction des biais et le respect des pratiques éthiques en matière d'IA lors du développement des modèles.

Mettre en œuvre des outils de surveillance et d'explicabilité des modèles afin de suivre leurs performances et leur conformité.

Collaboration et mobilisation des parties prenantes

Collaborer avec les équipes produit, les data scientists et les parties prenantes métier pour identifier les opportunités offertes par l'IA.

Traduire les besoins métier en solutions techniques d'IA et communiquer efficacement les résultats obtenus.

Pas besoin d’être un oiseau rare

Mais vous pouvez en devenir un, parmi nous. Chez nous, vous pouvez vous distinguer et révéler le meilleur de vous-même si vous répondez aux critères suivants:


Un master ou un doctorat en sciences, avec d'excellents résultats académiques dans des domaines techniques (économétrie, informatique, intelligence artificielle, etc.).
Une expertise en
techniques d'apprentissage automatique et la volonté de maintenir vos connaissances à jour ; une connaissance approfondie d'algorithmes tels que les forêts
aléatoires, les réseaux de neurones et l'apprentissage par renforcement est indispensable.
GenAI : ingénierie rapide, résultats structurés, etc. (voir les responsabilités).
De solides compétences en programmation Python et SQL.
Une excellente maîtrise du néerlandais ou du français, avec des notions de l'autre langue, et de l'anglais.
Une expérience dans la vulgarisation d'analyses complexes auprès d'un public non technique, grâce à vos talents de conteur et votre capacité à visualiser les données. Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, tant sur le plan technique que commercial.
Une soif d'apprendre, non seulement pour maîtriser de nouveaux algorithmes et technologies, mais aussi sur le plan relationnel ; vous êtes conscient(e) que la valeur de votre travail repose sur la qualité et l'acceptation, et vous souhaitez travailler sur ces deux aspects.
Des compétences exceptionnelles en résolution de problèmes : vous savez qu'une bonne compréhension d'un problème représente au moins 90 % de la solution ; vous faites preuve de créativité et de persévérance pour comprendre les problèmes et trouver des solutions.


Un plus :


Bilinguisme (anglais et néerlandais ou français).
Expérience en développement de produits de données, de la conception à la production.
Compétences en développement full-stack.
Connaissance du cloud, de préférence Azure.



Belfius prend soin de ses talents

Outre la possibilité de faire votre chemin dans un job qui vous plaît, nous vous offrons un contrat à temps plein à durée indéterminée avec :


Un salaire attractif complété par une offre innovante vous octroyant un budget à utiliser selon vos préférences personnelles (p. ex. voiture, vélo, PC, smartphone, tablette, loyer ou crédit hypothécaire sous certaines conditions) et des avantages extralégaux, tels que des chèques-repas, des avantages sur les produits et services internes, une assurance hospitalisation et une assurance groupe.
Des possibilités de développement par le biais d'un large éventail de formations et des opportunités de carrière dans l’ensemble du groupe Belfius.
Un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à des horaires flexibles, à la combinaison du travail au bureau et à domicile et un nombre attractif de jours de congé.
Un lieu de travail moderne au cœur de Bruxelles, avec une salle de sport branchée, un délicieux restaurant sain et des espaces de réunion confortables, le tout à quelques pas de la rue commerciale, de la gare Bruxelles-Nord et de la station métro Rogier.

Title: AI & Data Engineer
Description:
AI & Data Engineer




SECO Group is looking for a AI & Data Engineer.




We are seeking a motivated and skilled AI, Python & PowerApps Developer to join our digital transformation team. This hybrid role bridges traditional software development with low-code/no-code solutions, supporting business process automation, data analytics, and AI integration. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in Python development, experience with Microsoft Power Platform (especially PowerApps and Power Automate), and a keen interest in applying AI/ML solutions to real-world business problems.




Key responsabilities:

Python & AI Development

Design, develop, and maintain Python-based applications and scripts.
Build and deploy machine learning models using libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Integrate AI solutions (e.g., NLP, predictive analytics, computer vision) into enterprise workflows.
Work with APIs and automation frameworks to connect disparate systems.




PowerApps Development

Design and build custom applications using Microsoft PowerApps.
Develop and automate workflows using Power Automate.
Integrate Power Platform apps with SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, Dataverse, and other Microsoft services.
Ensure responsive and user-friendly UI/UX in PowerApps.




General

Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, project managers, and end users.
Document technical specifications and provide end-user training and support.
Stay current on emerging AI trends, Microsoft Power Platform updates, and relevant technologies.
Ensure security, performance, and scalability of all solutions.




Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Proven experience in Python development.
Experience with machine learning, AI frameworks, or related projects.
Hands-on experience developing with Microsoft PowerApps and Power Automate.
Good understanding of data integration, REST APIs, and Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Experience with Power BI and data visualization.
Familiarity with Azure AI services, Dataverse, and Microsoft Copilot integration.
Knowledge of DevOps practices and version control (e.g., Git).
Experience working in agile environments.
Microsoft certifications in Power Platform, Azure, or AI/ML (a plus).




Soft Skills:

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
Agile mindset and a passion for continuous learning and innovation.




SECO offers:

Opportunity to work on impactful digital transformation projects.
A collaborative and forward-thinking team environment.
Flexible work arrangements and competitive compensation.
Professional development and training opportunities.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You’ll work with McKinsey’s agricultural and nature analytics team (ACRE) in Brussels, Belgium, part of our Agriculture Practice and Nature & Natural Capital Service Line.

Our Agriculture Practice advises agribusiness, consumer food, government, and investor clients on strategic, marketing & sales, and operations issues, helping support industry-shaping decisions that impact the future of global food production.

The Nature & Natural Capital Service Line helps corporations, public-sector actors and institutions in enabling nature-positive outcomes by integrating biodiversity, land use, water, and ecosystem information into strategy, investment decisions, and operations.

Within this group, ACRE is a team of ~30 expert consultants, data scientists, and engineers focused on bringing cutting-edge analytics to our clients. We apply real-time data and advanced analytics or AI – generally predictive or geospatial in nature – to solve the biggest problems currently facing global agriculture and nature.

You will leverage industry knowledge and analytical expertise to provide insights both to clients as part of client service teams and within the ACRE team by strengthening the core products and algorithms we build for clients. You can expect to split your time delivering impact at clients (either remotely or on site) and building up ACRE’s core analytical offerings.

In the agriculture sector, issues to solve could include determining the suitability of growing different types of crops across different geographies, using local agronomic data and satellite imagery to determine market potential for input products, or optimizing farm operations using yield forecasting. For the nature sector, you may help public-sector clients from low- and middle-income clients define their nature conservation strategy, supporting them through geospatial analysis and your domain knowledge.

Along the way, you will receive best-in-class training in structuring business problems and serving as a client adviser, develop tech-skills through (in-person) trainings curated by big-tech companies, and have opportunities to work closely with and learn from our senior agriculture and nature leaders and industry players that are shaping the future of these fields. You will get access to unparalleled career acceleration, with a huge amount of ownership and responsibility from the get-go in a collaborative, diverse, non-hierarchical environment. You will get the opportunity to travel to client sites and attend in-person trainings, locally and around the world. Lastly, you will be able to provide direct and measurable impact towards solving some of the largest problems facing the global food-system and natural ecosystems.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Master’s in a quantitative agriculture- or nature-related field
Strong experience with agronomy/crop science, animal sciences and farm-level production systems, AND/OR nature- and natural-capital–related topics, such as biodiversity, land use, water systems, ecosystem services, or nature-related risk and impact assessment, preferred
Geospatial and spatiotemporal analysis, remote sensing, image processing, preferred
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, paired with the ability to develop creative and efficient solutions
Clean, efficient coding abilities in Python ideally with experience parallel processing and using cloud computing resources
Ability to design and develop geospatial workflows and pipelines for data analysis and processing; ability to use version-control & collaboration tools
Strong multitasking and parallel development abilities
Strong interpersonal communication skills
Creative, naturally curious, and willing to take intellectual risks
Able to work under competing, quickly-changing priorities, manage expectations effectively and support the team under pressure
Self-management skills and ability to work as part of an Agile team preferred
Willingness to travel up to 50%

Title: Talencia Consulting - Data Scientist / Data Engineer - Medior
Description:
We are looking for a Medior Data Engineer / Data Scientist to join an Advanced Analytics team and contribute to a wide range of data-driven and AI initiatives.

The role combines data science, Machine Learning, advanced analytics and generative AI, with projects covering various business areas such as Marketing, e-Commerce, Product, Customer Excellence, Stores, Supply Chain and Procurement.

You will work closely with data, technology and business teams to transform complex datasets into actionable insights and develop innovative AI-driven solutions.

Responsibilities


Data analysis & Machine Learning:
Analyze large and complex datasets using advanced statistical and Machine Learning techniques.
Identify trends, patterns and opportunities to support data-driven business decisions.
Develop, deploy and optimize Machine Learning models.
Work on Generative AI and Agentic AI use cases, including AI agents.
Continuously evaluate and fine-tune models to improve their performance and business value.
MLOps:
Apply MLOps best practices throughout the Machine Learning lifecycle.
Implement model versioning, continuous integration and automated deployment processes.
Monitor model performance and ensure the reliability of production models.
Contribute to model retraining, maintenance and continuous improvement.
Collaboration:
Work closely with Data Platform, Data Insights and Business teams to understand requirements and deliver appropriate solutions.
Translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Present complex technical findings and analytical results clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Contribute to Agile squads and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Innovation & AI:
Stay up to date with the latest developments in Data Science, Machine Learning and Generative AI.
Investigate and experiment with emerging AI technologies.
Explore Agentic AI and AI-agent architectures to identify new opportunities and improve data capabilities.
Contribute to the adoption of innovative data and AI solutions within the organization.

Required Skills & Experience


Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Economics or another relevant scientific/business-oriented field.
3+ years of professional experience as a Data Scientist, Data Engineer or in a closely related role.
Strong experience applying advanced statistics and Machine Learning to real-world business problems.
Ability to transform complex data into clear, actionable business insights.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
Experience working with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly technologies such as:
Vertex AI
BigQuery
Dataform
Understanding of MLOps principles and practices.
Experience working in Agile environments, such as Scrum or Kanban.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects from concept through implementation.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to interact with both technical and business stakeholders.
Fluent in english and proficient in french or dutch.

Nice To Have


Experience with Generative AI.
Experience with Agentic AI / AI Agents.
Experience with GCP agentic AI technologies such as ADK or Model Armor.
Previous experience in the Retail sector.
Experience working on large-scale data or AI transformation projects.


Candidate profile

We are looking for a hands-on Medior Data Scientist / Data Engineer who combines strong technical skills with a solid understanding of business needs.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working with Python, SQL, GCP, Machine Learning and MLOps, while also being able to communicate effectively with business stakeholders. A genuine interest in Generative AI and Agentic AI is highly valued.

The ability to work independently, take initiative and collaborate within multidisciplinary Agile teams will be key to succeeding in this role.

In case of interest in this job, please send us immediately your updated resume.

Title: Specialist Tech – Data Scientist (M/V/X)
Description:
Werkomgeving

De Algemene Dienst Inlichting en Veiligheid (ADIV) – QUAERO ET TEGO: IK ONDERZOEK EN BESCHERM

De bedreigingen voor onze samenleving veranderen voortdurend. ADIV is de Belgische referentiedienst voor inlichtingen wat betreft Defensie en het buitenland. Met onze inlichtingen dragen we bij tot het beschermen van de belangen van Defensie, ons land en zijn bevolking. We hebben een diepgaand inzicht in de huidige en toekomstige uitdagingen op het gebied van inlichtingen, veiligheid en cyberspace. Dankzij een geïntegreerde aanpak, zowel nationaal als internationaal, werken we samen met onze verschillende partners om de interne veiligheid te handhaven en te versterken.

De Cyber Command is een cross-functionele eenheid die binnen Defensie zal groeien, terwijl het deel blijft uitmaken van ADIV, waarvan het het wettelijke kader en de missies deelt. Het heeft een dubbele rol. Cyber Command is verantwoordelijk voor de cyberbeveiliging van de netwerken en wapensystemen die door Defensie worden gebruikt, maar ook voor het verzamelen van informatie en het uitvoeren van operaties in cyberspace namens ADIV.

Binnen deze context bouwt het Tech Team van de Digital Influence Collection Unit (DICU) aan innovatieve oplossingen voor data-analyse, infrastructuur en cybersecurity. DICU steunt op twee pijlers:


Open Source Intelligence (OSINT): evolueert mee met moderne technologieën zoals machine learning en sociale media en vormt een essentiële pijler binnen het inlichtingenwerk.
Information Warfare (IW): bestrijdt desinformatie en fake news door geavanceerde technologieën in te zetten om online content te analyseren, te verifiëren en te lokaliseren – cruciaal in moderne conflicten.


Taakomschrijving

Als Specialist Tech – Data Scientist werkt u aan innovatieve oplossingen voor OSINT en cyberoperaties. Uw verantwoordelijkheden omvatten:


Voorbereiden en beheren van datasets (leaks, open source) en integreren in veilige databases
Ontwikkelen van intuïtieve interfaces (GUI) voor data-exploratie en gebruikersinteractie
Testen en implementeren van big data-technologieën zoals ELK Stack en graph databases (bv. ArangoDB)
Ontwerpen van cloudarchitecturen volgens best practices inzake veiligheid en schaalbaarheid
Opzetten van CI/CD pipelines en zero-trustoplossingen voor veilige en efficiënte ontwikkeling
Creëren van containeromgevingen (Docker, Kubernetes) voor flexibele en robuuste toepassingen
Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van anonieme netwerken en IT-infrastructuur voor veilige communicatie
Uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en security audits en definiëren van cybersecurity policies
Ondersteunen van OSINT- en IW-teams met technische expertise en probleemoplossing
Organiseren van trainingen en workshops en actief kennis delen binnen het team


Profielomschrijving


Je bent in het bezit van een Master- of Bachelordiploma in IT, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Je bent vertrouwd met programmeertalen zoals Python en hebt kennis van big data-technologieën, cloudplatformen en containertechnologie.
Je hebt ervaring met data-analyse, modellering en visualisatie.
Je bent analytisch, oplossingsgericht en innovatief ingesteld.
Je beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden en kan complexe materie helder uitleggen.
Je bent een teamplayer, maar kan ook zelfstandig werken.
Een degelijke kennis van het technisch Engels is onontbeerlijk.


Je hebt de Belgische nationaliteit en komt in aanmerking voor Belgische, NAVO- en EU-veiligheidsmachtiging “Zeer Geheim”.

Troeven


Goede kennis van het Frans (tweetalige werkomgeving).
Ervaring met OSINT, cybersecurity en risk management.
Certificaten in data science, cloud of cybersecurity.
Ervaring met CI/CD, zero trust en infrastructuurarchitectuur.


Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Als je geselecteerd wordt, moet je op de datum van indiensttreding voldoen aan de volgende voorwaarden om aan de slag te kunnen:


Belg zijn.
Burgerlijke en politieke rechten genieten.
Van goed gedrag zijn in overeenstemming met de vereisten van de betreffende functie.
In het bezit zijn van een veiligheidsmachtiging “Zeer Geheim” vereist door de functie of bereid zijn om een veiligheidsonderzoek “Zeer Geheim” te ondergaan alvorens in dienst te treden, met de verplichting om een positief resultaat te behalen, zo niet zou dit aanleiding geven tot uitsluiting uit de dienst (conform de wet van 11 december 1998 betreffende de classificatie en de veiligheidsmachtigingen, -attesten en -adviezen, gewijzigd door de wet van 03-05-2005).


Solliciteer je voor een functie binnen ADIV, wees dan discreet en beperk je communicatie hierover, ook binnen je onmiddellijke omgeving.

Wij bieden

Onze federale overheid is volop aan het informatiseren : van cybersecurity uitdagingen tot digitale communicatie, van netwerkverbeteringen om onze nieuwe manier van werken te ondersteunen tot complexe ontwikkelingsprojecten en optimalisatietrajecten van bestaande applicaties.

Wil je hieraan meewerken en zo een maatschappelijke meerwaarde creëren, terwijl je ook aan je persoonlijke ontwikkeling kunt werken en maximale mogelijkheden krijgt om je ambities waar te maken ? Dan bieden we je een duidelijk doel in een stimulerende omgeving en een zeer competitief salarispakket met een hele reeks extralegale voordelen (hospitalisatieverzekering, maaltijdcheques, mobiliteit, pensioenfonds,…).

Tevens hechten we veel belang aan een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé – met telewerk voor de meeste functies – en zijn onze kantoren zeer goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.

Title: Data Scientist

You lead the design, development and industrialisation of machine-learning solutions in Azure Databricks
Work together with data engineers, business analysts and policy stakeholders to identify high-value use cases and translate business needs into data-driven solutions
Develop anomaly-detection, risk-scoring and classification models using supervised and unsupervised techniques
Use Databricks and Azure services including PySpark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Workflows, Azure Data Factory, Azure DevOps and Azure Storage
Provide technical leadership, define standards and coach team members.

You have a Master or PhD and 10+ years of experience in data science, machine learning or advanced analytics
You have strong experience with Python, SQL, Azure Databricks and PySpark
Strong knowledge of ML techniques, including anomaly detection, classification, clustering
Experience with MLflow, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog and Databricks Workflows
Experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD and MLOps practices
Experience with explainable AI, risk scoring and large-scale data processing

As part of the international group bnode, bpost has transitioned from the Belgian postal operator to a regional and digital expert in parcel size logistics. Bpost is looking for a Data Scientist / Operations Research Specialist with proven experience building and industrializing machine learning and optimization solutions.

In Belgium, Bpost operates in a context of structural mail decline, continued parcel growth, increasing operational variability, and strong competitive pressure. Better forecasting and optimization are therefore key to improving service (quality) and network efficiency (cost) across sorting, transport and distribution.

In this role, you will design, prototype and industrialize analytical solutions that drive operational and tactical decisions across Bpost’s network. This includes building robust decision-support tools such as forecasting and optimization models, and ensuring they are deployed, monitored and used in real operations.

You will work closely with operational stakeholders and IT teams to turn business problems into scalable, production-ready solutions. You will also help increase the analytics maturity of Bpost by moving use cases from ad hoc analysis or prototype stage toward robust, reusable and business-embedded analytical products.

Who are you?


At least 5 years of proven experience using both machine learning and operations research to solve real-world problems
At least 5 years of proven experience designing, prototyping, deploying, and monitoring models in production environments
Ability to translate business needs into pragmatic analytical solutions
Interest in logistics, supply chain, and physical network decision-making
Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Full proficiency in English. French and Dutch are a strong plus.

Programming & analytics: Python, SQL, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn

Optimization: OR-Tools, Gurobi or similar solvers

Title: VIE – Data Scientist & Data Analyst (H/F) – Belgique
Description:
Contexte et environnement

Au sein de TotalEnergies Charging Solutions Belgium (TCSB), filiale de la branche Marketing & Services de TotalEnergies, l'entité Data intervient sur les activités d'analyse de données, de data science et de transformation des plateformes de données pour les activités de recharge de véhicules électriques.

L'équipe Data accompagne les besoins métiers de la filiale depuis l'identification des cas d'usage jusqu'à la mise en œuvre de solutions analytiques et prédictives, en passant par la collecte, l'exploitation et la valorisation des données.

Vérifiez votre éligibilité au programme ainsi que les spécificités pays sur le site internet : https://mon-vie-via.businessfrance.fr/qu-est-ce-que-le-volontariat-international

Merci de candidater en anglais.

Activités

Vos principales missions :

Développement de modèles prédictifs et de solutions Data Science


Participer à la création de modèles prédictifs appliqués aux activités de recharge pour véhicules électriques.
Exploiter et analyser des données afin d'optimiser l'implantation des bornes de recharge, les coûts d'installation et les opérations de maintenance.
Exploiter et analyser des volumes importants de données internes et externes.
Développer de nouvelles solutions Data Science.



Migration et transformation des plateformes de données


Accompagner les projets de migration de plateformes et de transformation des environnements de données.
Développer et adapter des traitements, dashboards, modèles analytiques et solutions de reporting pour les équipes métier.
Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de l'architecture data locale et à la structuration des flux de données.
Développer des modèles analytiques, des outils de visualisation et des solutions de reporting à destination des équipes métiers.
Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles belges ainsi qu'avec les équipes Data et Digital du siège afin de répondre aux besoins métiers et d'accompagner les évolutions des outils.



Le poste combine des activités Data Analysis (50%) et Data Scientist Analysis (50%), centré sur l'analyse de données, la modélisation prédictive et la transformation des plateformes data dans le domaine de la mobilité électrique.

Profil du candidat

Diplômé d'un Bac+5 minimum en Data Science, Data Engineering, (école de commerce ou université.)

Vous bénéficiez d'une première expérience en Data Science, Data Analytics.

La connaissance du secteur de l'énergie constitue un atout.

Vous disposez de compétences en :


Databricks ;
Snowflake ;
Clustering ;
Segmentation ;
Scoring ;



Vous maîtrisez les outils suivants :


Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn) ;
SQL ;
Modèles de Machine Learning (Modélisation prédictive).



Un niveau d'anglais B2/C1 est requis. Un niveau de français C1 minimum est également demandé. La connaissance du néerlandais constitue un atout.

Informations supplémentaires

Date de début : Q4 2026

TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, promeut le développement individuel et offre des opportunités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats.

Title: AI & Data Engineer
Description:
What You'll Do

Are you the AI & Data Engineer who wants to join our team to develop innovative data pipelines and state-of-the-art AI solutions?

As an AI & Data Engineer at iO, you are first and foremost an experienced software engineer who builds, integrates, and operationalizes AI and data solutions within clients’ existing IT ecosystems.

You will work on a wide variety of AI challenges: from intelligently leveraging or fine-tuning Large Language Models, agent and multi-agent setups, and applying RAG patterns, to building ETL pipelines that feed a data platform. A recurring pattern in your work is integrating existing cloud services and APIs into an efficient, scalable, and reliable solution. The focus lies on building production-grade systems that function correctly within complex, often enterprise-level IT landscapes.

Prompt engineering is an art form to you. You think creatively about how to achieve the best results, while paying attention to preventing hallucinations and implementing smart guardrails. You evaluate your solutions systematically to gain insight into output quality.

In your work, you will encounter many forms of AI: from statistical models to Large Language Models, from Generative AI in the domains of image, video, and audio to Natural Language Processing. The emphasis is mainly on applying and integrating existing models and services, and building the infrastructure around them.

You will work on a wide range of client challenges: from automatically analyzing documents to detecting events in audio or video data, building agents and orchestration solutions, generating graphical output based on data, or creating and validating content. Wherever AI can add value, you design and implement the complete solution as an engineer.

You collaborate with various AI experts within iO and with technical teams on the client side. Your solutions are based on modern (cloud) platforms, SaaS services, and programming languages such as TypeScript and Python.

What Are Your Responsibilities as an AI & Data Engineer?


Designing AI & Data solutions: Analyze client challenges related to AI and data and define solutions, approaches, and architecture
Software engineering & integration: Develop backend components, APIs, and services to ensure AI solutions integrate seamlessly with existing applications and platforms
Data Pipeline Development: Design and build robust ETL/ELT processes and real-time data streams
Data Platform Architecture: Set up modern data warehouses, data lakes, and analytics platforms
AI Integration: Implement machine learning pipelines and integrate AI services into data workflows
Data Quality & Governance: Ensure data quality, security, and compliance within data ecosystems
Performance Optimization: Optimize data processing performance and scalability
Cloud Data Services: Work with cloud-native data services such as AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, or Google Dataflow
Monitoring & Observability: Implement monitoring and alerting for data pipelines and AI workloads


Your Qualities And Skills As AI & Data Engineer


You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with a focus on software engineering
You have several years of experience as a software engineer and have worked on data- and/or AI-driven systems in a professional, preferably enterprise, environment
You have experience with different LLM architectures and understand the strengths and weaknesses of various AI solutions
You are familiar with the principles of modern data architectures, data modeling, and big data processing
You are proficient in modern data processing languages such as Python and SQL, and have experience with frameworks such as Apache Spark, Pandas, or Dask
You are familiar with AWS or Azure cloud data platforms
You have a strong foundation in software engineering, including knowledge of CI/CD, unit testing, Git (flow), secure development, error handling, asynchronous operations, and real-time data streams
You are able to translate your ideas into technical architecture diagrams, data flow schemas, and documentation, while also clearly explaining your solutions to less technical stakeholders (clients and colleagues)
You enjoy sparring with colleagues about ideas and solutions and working collaboratively to achieve better results


What’s in it for you

Vacation icon Vacation icon used in website

32 vacation days

Based on a 40-hour work week, you’ll have 20 vacation days and 12 compensatory days of leave (reduction of working time).

Money icon Money icon used in website

Mobility & end-of-year bonus

After working at iO for 6 months, you can count on an end-of-year bonus. And in terms of mobility, you can choose from various options, depending on your job or preference.

SafeEnvironment icon Safe Environment icon used in website

Hospitalisation insurance

When something unfortunate happens, the last thing you need is the added stress of unexpected costs. That’s why all employees get hospitalisation insurance at Axa.

HybridWorking icon Hybrid Working icon used in website

Hybrid working

A good work-life balance is super important. Together with your team, you’ll decide when and where you work.

FoodBenefits icon Food Benefits icon used in website

Healthy snacks & lunch

At every iO campus, you can grab a healthy snack throughout the day and have a healthy and varied lunch for a small fee.

TrainingBudget icon Training Budget icon used in website

Personal training budget

Each year, you’ll get a budget of €3,000 to develop yourself, in your profession or as a person, through training, events, or courses.

Celebrations icon Celebrations icon used in website

Celebrating together

If there’s something to celebrate, we know how to party! From time to time, the party team at your campus will organise the best (theme) parties.

Title: Data Scientist - GenAI
Description:
Join Artefact Belgium: Shape the Future of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)

Are you an early-career professional excited to harness the power of generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)? Artefact Belgium is seeking a Data Scientist - Gen AI to join our innovative team in Brussels. Our Belgian team specializes in LLM and GenAI projects, and this is your chance to work on cutting-edge solutions, collaborate with top-tier experts, and contribute to impactful projects in a dynamic, forward-thinking environment.

Who You Are

A recent graduate or professional with 1 to 3 years of experience, with hands-on experience working with LLMs and a passion for generative AI and NLP. Motivated to apply your technical expertise to real-world challenges in AI. Able to thrive in collaborative settings while independently driving your own workstreams. Eager to learn, grow, and push the boundaries of what's possible in AI innovation.

Who We Are

Artefact is a leading Data & AI consulting firm operating at the forefront of AI innovation. With a global presence, we help clients across industries—public health, manufacturing, etc. —leverage generative AI to achieve transformative outcomes. Our team in Belgium is specialized in LLM and GenAI projects, working on the most advanced applications of these technologies. At Artefact, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, with a strong commitment to inclusivity and employee growth.

What You Will Do


Collaborate with the team to design, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art models for client projects and internal tools.
Develop and integrate agentic AI solutions using tool calling, and emerging protocols like Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create autonomous, context-aware applications.
Research and implement innovative generative AI applications to solve complex business problems.
Design and implement comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure LLM performance, establishing quality metrics and benchmarks that guide development decisions and ensure reliable, production-ready solutions.
Optimize the performance, scalability, and usability of LLM-powered products and tools.
Contribute to the deployment and maintenance of AI systems, including models, APIs, and supporting infrastructure.
Participate in technical discussions and brainstorming sessions to shape impactful solutions.


What You Bring


A degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, physics, or a related field.
Experience working with LLMs, generative AI, or advanced NLP applications (e.g., fine-tuning models, using frameworks like Hugging Face or OpenAI).
Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with AI and NLP libraries.
Analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with an ability to address real-world challenges through AI.
Good communication skills in English, Dutch or French; additional languages are a plus.
A growth mindset, adaptability, and eagerness to work in a fast-paced, cutting-edge environment.


What We Offer


A competitive salary with benefits tailored for early-career professionals.
Hands-on experience with state-of-the-art LLM technologies in impactful projects.
A dynamic and supportive work environment that fosters creativity and professional development.
Resources for ongoing training, certification, and skill-building in generative AI and related fields.
A collaborative, inclusive workplace with access to global expertise through Artefact's network.


This position is based in Brussels.

Don't worry if you don't meet every criterion! We value passion, potential, and a commitment to innovation. If you're excited about generative AI and ready to grow your career, we'd love to hear from you!

Title: Data & Simulation Specialist
Description:
Cartamundi is wereldmarktleider in “play”-oplossingen. Denk aan speelkaarten, kaart- en bordspellen, collectibles en trading card games.

Ons doel? “Live Different, Play Different” voor iedereen. Met bijna 3.000 mensen zetten we ons elke dag in om die ambitie waar te maken. Ons familiebedrijf, met hoofdkantoor in België, heeft daarvoor een wereldwijd netwerk van designcenters, verkoopkantoren en productiefaciliteiten. Een netwerk dat loopt van de VS en Brazilië tot Europa en Japan.

Cartamundi heeft een wereldwijde merkenportefeuille met heritage brands zoals Bicycle®, Bee®, Copag®, Shuffle® en heel wat lokaal geliefde merken. We zijn ook de vertrouwde partner van toonaangevende speelgoed- en entertainmentbedrijven voor productie- en distributieoplossingen.

De drukpersen van Cartamundi draaien al sinds 1765. We koppelen die rijke traditie aan innovatie in digitale en hybride speelervaringen. Om zo relevant te blijven – vandaag en morgen.

Cartamundi voert een strategie van duurzame en winstgevende groei. Op die manier streven we ernaar om onze planeet en ons bedrijf in topconditie te houden voor de komende generaties.




Lees meer op www.cartamundi.com

Volg ons op LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/cartamundi




Data & Simulation Analyst

Als Data & Simulation Analyst ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van complexe en unieke klantbehoeften naar correcte, efficiënte en productieklare collatieschema’s voor collectible kaartenproducten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat alle kaartvarianten in de juiste aantallen, samenstellingen en configuraties in flowpacks, decks en displays terechtkomen, in lijn met zowel klantverwachtingen als productietechnische mogelijkheden.




Jouw functie

Met jouw analytische blik en technische feeling…




…Vertaal je klantbehoeften naar haalbare oplossingen

Je analyseert klantwensen en adviseert op basis van technische en statistische inzichten.




…Ontwerp je collatieschema’s van A tot Z

Je ontwikkelt vorm-, lay‑out- en dropschema’s en zorgt voor correcte kaartcombinaties.
Je maakt scenario­berekeningen voor duidelijke keuzes en alternatieven.




…Lever je sterke simulaties en analyses

Je bouwt displaysimulaties op basis van kansberekening.
Je maakt impactanalyses en rapporten die beslissingen ondersteunen.




…Bewaak je data en kwaliteit

Je houdt namelists en control sheets up-to-date.
Je voert nauwkeurige 4‑eyes checks uit.




…Optimaliseer je tools en processen

Je verbetert bestaande tools en workflows en ondersteunt toolontwikkeling.




…Communiceer je vlot met interne partners

Je stemt af met Sales en productie en maakt technische info begrijpelijk voor iedereen.




Jouw profiel

Je bent voor ons de ideale kandidaat omdat je…

Denkt op masterniveau en een wetenschappelijke of wiskundige achtergrond hebt.
Sterke analytische skills hebt en vaardig bent in statistische berekeningen.
Nauwkeurig werkt, een oog hebt voor detail en steeds gaat voor topkwaliteit (4 eyes mindset zit in jouw DNA).
Complexe materie helder kan uitleggen en graag meedenkt in oplossingen.
Uitblinkt in Excel. Basis tot programmeervaardigheden is mooi meegenomen.
De taal van zowel Sales als Productie begrijpt en deze werelden moeiteloos met elkaar verbindt.
Proactief verbeterkansen ziet en graag werkt aan efficiëntere processen en slimmere tools.
Je jezelf vlot kan uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Engels.




Aanbod

We bieden je de uitdaging om zelfstandig een boeiende en gevarieerde job uit te oefenen. Je komt terecht in een dynamische onderneming en een hecht team waar je kan werken in een aangename werksfeer. Je krijgt de mogelijkheden jezelf te ontwikkelen. Het salarispakket is in overeenstemming met je ervaring en de verantwoordelijkheden van de functie.




Interesse?

Toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging? Surf naar www.cartamundi.com/nl/careers en solliciteer online.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
What does this job involve?




Machine learning models only create real value when they are reliable, scalable and ready for production. That's where you come in. As a Machine Learning Engineer at Discai, you bridge the gap between data science and software engineering.




You will contribute to the development of our AI-powered solutions and ensure that machine learning models evolve from proof of concept to robust production systems. In this role, you combine machine learning expertise with strong software engineering and MLOps practices.




You will join an innovative fintech company where AI, data and technology are at the heart of everything we do. Working alongside data scientists, software engineers and cloud specialists, you will help build scalable solutions that support financial institutions in the fight against financial crime.







What do we expect from you?




You transform machine learning prototypes into scalable, production-ready solutions.
You design, develop and maintain end-to-end machine learning pipelines.
You optimise the performance, reliability and cost-efficiency of ML solutions.
You strengthen and automate model monitoring capabilities to ensure model quality and performance.
You develop and automate testing strategies for machine learning pipelines.
You collaborate closely with data scientists to build scalable solutions using MLOps best practices.
You work with data engineers to ensure seamless integration of data pipelines.
You maintain and improve CI/CD workflows and automated quality controls.
You document architecture decisions, technical designs and implementation choices in a clear and structured way.




Please note that this role requires you to be based in Belgium.







Your strengths?




You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field.
You have at least four years of experience in machine learning engineering, data science or a similar role.
You have a proven track record of operationalising machine learning solutions and transforming prototypes into production systems.
You have strong programming skills in Python.
You have solid SQL knowledge.
You are experienced with widely used machine learning and data processing libraries such as scikit-learn, SciPy, SHAP and Polars.
Experience with MLflow or similar tools for experiment tracking and model registry is an asset.
You have experience working with cloud platforms and production environments, preferably within AWS.
You are familiar with orchestration tools such as AWS SageMaker Pipelines or equivalent solutions.
Knowledge of Docker, CI/CD practices, GitHub and software design principles such as SOLID and clean coding is a plus.
You communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You have a strong analytical mindset and are passionate about building scalable and maintainable solutions.
You are eager to learn and stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
You adopt a security-conscious approach when handling sensitive data.







What can we offer you?




The opportunity to join an innovative fintech company developing AI-powered solutions for financial institutions.
Collaboration with experienced data scientists, machine learning engineers, software developers and cloud specialists.
The chance to build AI solutions that have a direct impact on customers and the market.
A working environment where innovation, autonomy and ownership are encouraged.
Continuous learning and development opportunities through training, coaching and challenging projects.
The opportunity to help shape the future of our products and technology landscape.
A flexible working environment where collaboration, initiative and knowledge sharing are highly valued.
A permanent contract, a competitive salary and an attractive package of additional benefits.

 




Think you could be a great fit?

Send your application to hr.recruitment@discai.com.

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
Company Description

Sopra Steria offers tailored, end-to-end corporate technology and software solutions to help clients make bold choices and deliver results. Successfully so! With more than 56.000 colleagues in 30 countries, we rank as Europe’s leading digital solutions provider. Some of the most successful companies in Europe rely on our technology due to our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and value in business development.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together!

Job Description

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

You are fully convinced that data science isn’t a hype, but you also believe that, in order to be valuable and really make a company smarter, it must be done right. Your goal is therefore to create the most impactful solution possible in the quickest and easiest way possible so that real value can be extracted from data and artificial intelligence. 

Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who has:


A master’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, or a related field.
Min. 2 years of hands-on experience developing and implementing AI/ML models in production environments.
Strong Python programming skills, including experience with API-building frameworks such as FastAPI and prototyping tools like Streamlit.
Experience with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar is considered a strong asset.
Solid understanding of machine learning including model evaluation techniques and familiarity with advanced applications such as: NLP, forecasting, optimization, computer vision.
Experience in working with cloud-based environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and ML pipelines is a strong asset.
Experience with Generative AI technologies, prompt engineering, and large language models, is a strong asset.
Hands-on knowledge of vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Azure AI Search) for semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines is a strong asset.
Strong communication and business analysis skills and genuinely interested in understanding the customer’s business context and challenges.
You can explain complex technical concepts in simple, accessible language to non-technical stakeholders.
A collaborative, open-minded mindset and a drive to keep learning in a fast-evolving field.
You're fluent in Dutch or French, as well as English.


What we can offer:


A dynamic role within OptimAI, a leading AI competence center focused on applied, impactful AI.
The opportunity to work on real-world projects across sectors, from logistics and government to healthcare and finance.
Access to expert colleagues, mentorship, and tailored learning opportunities to accelerate your growth.
A flexible hybrid work model and a strong focus on work-life balance.
A culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous improvement where your ideas and input are valued.


Additional Information

Our employees are known for making bold choices and delivering results. Work among high-level professionals at the forefront of corporate software solutions and innovation at Europe’s Leading Digital Service Provider.  

We offer a generous employee benefits package that includes:

Title: Data Scientist Total Video
Description:
Amsterdam - Combine Data Science, AI, and Media to transform the advertising market. At DPG Media, our work touches over 90% of Dutch households daily. As a Data Scientist Total Video, you will take the lead in integrating TV advertising and digital video advertising into a scalable Total Video advertising product. If you are looking for a high-impact role where you can build an innovative data product from the ground up, this is your call.

What will you do?

As a Data Scientist Total Video, you develop data products at the intersection of data science, machine learning engineering, and AI to enable Total Video at scale. You provide the crucial holistic data focus needed to successfully integrate the worlds of TV advertising and online video advertising. With your expertise, you translate complex business challenges into concrete data solutions and contribute directly to the further development of an innovative product, that will transform the advertising market. You do this by:


Analyzing complex datasets and translating stakeholder challenges into concrete solutions, that you continuously improve iteratively
Developing and implementing scalable data products and models within a production environment
Collaborating within a dedicated development and product team on the realization of Total Video for the Belgian and Dutch markets
Working closely with Ad Alliance in the Netherlands and DPG Media Advertising in Belgium


Who are we?

We are the Total Video team, part of the Advertising Ecosystem & Strategy domain. In the coming years, we are investing heavily in the development of Total Video: a unique opportunity to help build a product from the ground up that will change the advertising market. The team is currently being built and consists of professionals with diverse backgrounds in business, data, product, and technology.

What makes you the ideal candidate?

For this role, we are looking for a person that is able to create and build things from scratch. Is optimistic, committed, driven, and creative. In addition, you bring:


5+ years experience in a similar role
Deep expertise in data science and machine learning, enabling you to design, train, and implement models in production environments
Experience transforming data models into scalable data products, preferably within a media or advertising environment
Strong analytical and conceptual skills, allowing you to recognize patterns in complex datasets and translate them into concrete solutions
Experience with machine learning tools and MLOps systems such as Docker, Databricks, and MLflow
Strong communication skills to clearly convey insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we encourage you to apply for this role. It is precisely the differences between colleagues that lead to surprising insights and innovative solutions. And that fits perfectly with who we are as an organization. We are curious to learn more about you and the qualities and experience you bring. Want to know more about our inclusive working environment? Click here!

What do we offer?

You will join an inspiring work environment that is constantly evolving. You will work with colleagues who think in possibilities, see opportunities, and encourage you to continue developing yourself every day. We support this through our DPG Academy, giving you every opportunity to get the best out of yourself and grow as a true media maker.

💰 A salary that matches your experience

📝 A 36-hour working week

💰 8% holiday allowance and a 4% personal choice budget

💰 Annual profit sharing based on DPG Media’s performance

🎓 Plenty of opportunities for development, both on the job and online through our DPG Academy

🎉 Flexibility to align your own cultural holidays

🏢 A fantastic new office in Amsterdam (Mediavaert). From spontaneous drinks to team outings and our legendary staff party, you will quickly feel at home here!

Even more reasons to join DPG Media

At DPG Media, we work for more than 90 strong news brands, magazines, television programs, radio stations, and online services such as Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM, and more. Every month, we reach over 90% of the Dutch population and 8 out of 10 Flemish people. We offer a professional work environment where freedom and ownership are highly valued. You will have every opportunity to work on your future through workshops and training programs. Feel free to be an entrepreneur, a learner, a team player, and above all, yourself. Everyone is welcome at DPG Media, regardless of background. More than 5,500 talented colleagues are ready to welcome you into a team, whether it is a project team, a pub quiz team, or a sports team.

Discover what we have to offer you. And while you are at it, you can also find us on Instagram, LinkedIn and X.

Applying, and then?

Ready to get started? Apply directly no later than January 12. You will receive a response to your application within 10 working days. Interviews will take place between January 13 and January 23, and final decisions will be communicated by January 31. If you are selected for the first round, we will contact you by phone to schedule an interview at our Amsterdam office.

Title: AI Engineer - AI Lab (kantoor Antwerpen)
Description:
Delen Private Bank is gespecialiseerd in discretionair vermogensbeheer en vermogensplanning. Onze missie? Het vermogen van onze klanten op een actieve en doordachte manier beheren en plannen, met het oog op een evenwichtige groei en een vlotte overdracht naar de volgende generaties. Persoonlijk contact, een langetermijnvisie en een duurzame aanpak kenmerken onze filosofie. Groep Delen is actief in vijf landen en telt meer dan 1000 medewerkers.




Het AI Lab binnen Delen Private Bank

De gedeelde missie van business, IT en het AI Lab is het vereenvoudigen en ondersteunen van processen, zodat collega’s minder administratieve lasten ervaren en meer tijd kunnen besteden aan persoonlijk contact met klanten en een uitstekende dienstverlening.




In het AI Lab luisteren we naar onze collega’s om hun uitdagingen in processen en werkmethoden te begrijpen, en verkennen we waar AI hen echt kan ondersteunen. Daarna bouwen we AI‑oplossingen om de meerwaarde voor onze collega’s concreet te maken. Wanneer die duidelijk is en er vraag ontstaat, neemt IT de oplossing over voor verdere uitwerking binnen onze systemen.




AI Engineer binnen het AI Lab

Als AI Engineer speel je een sleutelrol in het onderzoeken, ontwerpen en bouwen van AI‑oplossingen en capabilities die bijdragen aan efficiëntie, kwaliteit en schaalbaarheid van onze dienstverlening. Je opereert op het kruispunt van business, data, software engineering & AI.

Je bouwt end‑to‑end AI‑oplossingen: van data‑ingestion en modelontwikkeling tot concrete applicaties waarmee we de business versneld kunnen ondersteunen.
Wanneer een oplossing succesvol is en de business er klaar voor is, dragen we deze over aan IT voor volledige integratie. Onze rol is dan puur adviserend.
Je bouwt AI‑services die veilig, uitlegbaar en performant zijn, en je waakt over stabiliteit, monitoring en lifecycle management van modellen in productie.
Je denkt actief mee over architectuurkeuzes, herbruikbare componenten en best practices binnen het AI Lab.




Jouw profiel

Wat breng je high-level mee?

Minstens 2 jaar ervaring in een AI-, ML- of Software Engineering‑rol, waarbij je technische expertise combineert met een pragmatische, proactieve aanpak gericht op business value.

Jouw achtergrond & basis vaardigheden:

Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden om technische concepten helder over te brengen aan business stakeholders
Gedrevenheid om waarde te leveren en collega’s te helpen
Diepgaande kennis van Python en solide softwareprincipes
Aantoonbare ervaring in het bouwen van LLM‑applicaties in een productieomgeving
Ervaring met Git en versiebeheer (GitHub)
Ervaring met Docker & GitHub Actions
Ervaring in data cleansing en feature engineering (Python & SQL)
Oog voor datakwaliteit en metadata‑management
Aandacht voor access management en het veilig omgaan met gevoelige data
Kennis/ervaring met RAG‑systemen (embeddingstrategieën, vector databases, retrieval, guardrails, evaluatie, QA, …)
Ervaring met cloudplatformen, bij voorkeur Azure
Gevorderde promptingtechnieken
Een echte teamspeler die graag samenwerkt, kennis deelt en nieuwe technologieën verkent
Liefst werk je in tandem, zowel binnen het AI Lab als met de businesscollega’s
Vloeiende kennis Nederlands en Engels




Extra punten indien:

Ervaring binnen de financiële sector
Ervaring met Pydantic, LangChain, LangGraph, …
Ervaring met workflow orchestration
Ervaring in webapplicatie‑ontwikkeling (front‑ en/of backend)
Een actief GitHub‑profiel
Ervaring met multi‑agent frameworks
Een echte teamspeler die graag samenwerkt, kennis deelt en nieuwe technologieën verkent




Andere verwachtingen:

Bij Delen Private Bank geloven we in betere samenwerking door aanwezigheid op kantoor. “By default” werk je vanuit Antwerpen, met ad‑hoc uitzonderingen mogelijk.
Je hebt passie voor je vak en gaat van nature de extra mile in een dynamische, voortdurend evoluerende omgeving.
De collega’s zijn onze klanten. Je bent gemotiveerd om met hen samen te werken, duurzame relaties op te bouwen en steeds in tandem te werken.




Wij bieden

Aantrekkelijke voorwaarden: je ontvangt een competitief salaris aangevuld met een uitgebreid pakket extralegale voordelen, zoals hospitalisatie- en tandzorgverzekering, groepsverzekering, ecocheques, gsm met abonnement, optieplan, extra verlofdagen (bank holidays), Benefits at Work, restaurant met versbereide maaltijden, keuze uit bedrijfswagen of andere (mobiliteits)oplossingen via het mobiliteitsbudget.
Ontwikkelkansen & intrapreneurship: jouw groei staat centraal. We luisteren naar je ambities en helpen je actief om stappen te zetten binnen onze organisatie. Via opleidingen, interne mobiliteit en intrapreneurship krijg je de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en nieuwe uitdagingen aan te gaan. Jij bent de architect van je loopbaan – wij zorgen voor de juiste ondersteuning.
Persoonlijke aanpak: als familiebedrijf sinds 1936 geloven we in de kracht van een persoonlijke aanpak. Je werkt in een warme en betrokken omgeving waar je écht gezien wordt. Dankzij onze vlakke structuur zijn de lijnen kort en is de directie – inclusief de familie – bereikbaar en betrokken. Ideeën krijgen snel gehoor, beslissingen worden doortastend genomen.
Collegiale sfeer: samenwerken zit in ons DNA. Je komt terecht in een hecht team waar collega’s elkaar ondersteunen, kennis delen en elkaar motiveren. We werken in een open en toegankelijke sfeer aan gedeelde doelen – met succes én met ruimte voor humor.
Duurzame samenwerking: we bouwen aan relaties voor de lange termijn – met onze klanten én onze medewerkers. Ons zeer laag personeelsverloop is daar het bewijs van. Dankzij een cultuur van vertrouwen, open communicatie en stabiliteit krijg je de kans om samen met ons te groeien.

Title: Freelance Data Scientist with Ontology and Graph expertise
Description:
Job Description

adesso Belgium is looking for a data scientist (2) to support our customer in building an AI Agent Platform Data Foundations.

Customer Info

Our customer is an international, independent provider of indirect procurement services.

Job Requirements

Preferred start date: 1xASAP and 1x January 2027

Duration: 12 months

Rate: depending on your location

Time Zone: CET

Your role

Build the data and context layer that powers the customer's procurement AI agent platform — canonical models, knowledge graph, semantic/taxonomy layer, and the retrieval and evaluation pipelines agents depend on. This is production infrastructure from day one, not a proof of concept: versioned, tested, and built for multiple tenants.

You Will Work On


Data products & canonical modeling — Design and deliver the first reference data products (Supplier Master, Spend Cube, Contract Register) end to end, from source ingestion through the canonical model.
Knowledge graph & ontology — Stand up and operate the platform and working graphs (ontology, reference data, tenant separation); own the graph-plus-vector retrieval design, deciding per source whether data is represented as entities/relationships, embeddings, or both.
Master data & semantic layer — Build matching rules, golden records, and stewardship processes for Suppliers, Contracts, and Categories; contribute to the business glossary and taxonomy-to-ontology mapping.
Extraction & evaluation — Build document-extraction pipelines (e.g., from SharePoint sources) with confidence scoring and human review for uncertain cases; build and maintain labelled evaluation datasets and accuracy benchmarks against agreed thresholds.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Scientist to join an innovative team working at the intersection of data, human behavior, and advanced analytics.







In this role, you will leverage large-scale sensor, operational, and customer-related datasets to uncover meaningful behavioral patterns and generate actionable insights. You will apply advanced statistical, machine learning, and AI techniques to solve complex real-world challenges, transforming raw data into practical and explainable business value.




This is an exciting opportunity for a curious and autonomous professional who enjoys combining analytical rigor, applied research, and stakeholder collaboration to drive impactful results.




Key Responsibilities




Analyze large and complex datasets from connected systems, operational environments, and customer feedback sources.
Design and develop interpretable features and behavioral dimensions to identify patterns, trends, and user profiles.
Combine multiple data sources, including structured and unstructured data, to generate richer insights and predictive capabilities.
Evaluate, compare, and validate analytical approaches suchas:
Clustering
Dimensionality reduction
Factor analysis
Correlation analysis
Supervised and unsupervised machine learning models
Conduct proof-of-concept studies to rapidly assess the applicability and value of new methodologies.
Review scientific literature and industry best practices to identify innovative approaches that can be adapted to business challenges.
Validate model performance, robustness, reliability, and limitations using sound statistical practices.
Collaborate with engineering, technical, and business stakeholders to ensure findings are relevant, actionable, and aligned with operational realities.
Present insights, recommendations, assumptions, and limitations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.




Required Qualifications




Master's degree or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Approximately 4-8 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning, or Applied AI.
Strong expertise in Python for data analysis, machine learning, experimentation, and rapid prototyping.
Solid knowledge of statistics, machine learning, and AI techniques, including: Feature engineering
Model validation
Dimensionality reduction
Predictive modeling
Pattern discovery
Ability to work independently, structure analytical approaches, and challenge assumptions when results are unclear or inconclusive.
Experience applying analytical methods to complex, real-world datasets rather than solely relying on standard modeling pipelines.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and accessible way.
Business-oriented mindset with a focus on delivering practical and explainable outcomes.




Nice to Have




Experience working with connected systems, IoT, sensor, mobility, industrial, or operational data.
Exposure to customer analytics, behavioral analysis, survey data, persona development, or user experience analytics.
Experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as:
SQL
Snowflake
Databricks Similar cloud-based analytics environments
Knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, or AI-assisted analytics.
Experience in interdisciplinary environments combining data science, engineering, and product development.




What we have to offer




At Akkodis, we want to give you the right environment to develop your expertise and grow throughout your career. You can count on:

A permanent contract
An attractive compensation package, including 13.92 months of salary

A flexible cafeteria plan
Hospitalization insurance
Training and development opportunities to strengthen both your technical and professional skills
A structured onboarding and regular follow-up, including career discussions and support from your managers
Access to technical communities and experts to exchange knowledge and develop your expertise
Referral and business bonuses when you contribute to growing our teams and business
Opportunities to develop your career across different projects, technologies, and areas of expertise

Title: Applied Machine Learning Engineer - IoT
Description:
Your role

Do you want to apply machine learning and signal processing to real industrial equipment operating worldwide? Join our Applied Machine Intelligence & IoT team and help transform data from more than 250,000 connected compressors into smart-maintenance and optimization solutions that create measurable customer value.

Is your ideal day one where you combine signal processing, machine learning, and a genuine curiosity about mechanical systems to build models that make real machines run better? Then you might be the perfect fit for our Applied Machine Intelligence & IoT team.

As an Applied Machine Learning Engineer in the Applied Machine Intelligence team (part of the Aftermarket R&D organization), you will turn sensor and machine data from our connected products into optimization and smart-maintenance models that deliver measurable value to our customers. You'll work across our global connectivity ecosystem and help bring proven optimization and uptime algorithms into our SMARTLINK AI platform.

As an Applied Machine Learning Engineer, you will analyze vibration, temperature, pressure, and operational data using both time-domain and frequency-domain techniques. By leveraging machine learning methodologies such as anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, classification, clustering, and forecasting, you will extract valuable insights from equipment data and translate them into actionable improvements.

You will be responsible for developing and enhancing models focused on energy efficiency, performance optimization, and smart maintenance for our connected product portfolio. In addition, you will integrate, validate, and deploy optimization algorithms within the Smart Events engine and the broader connectivity platform, ensuring that insights are effectively translated into customer value.

Working across the entire connectivity ecosystem, you will take an end-to-end approach, spanning from physical equipment and controllers to the generation of insights and the delivery of tangible business value to customers. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues from engineering, marketing, and operations to shape product roadmaps and deliver comprehensive solutions that address customer and business needs.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our approach for many positions is “hire for attitude and train for skill.” We support people through learning, coaching and on-the-job training. Do you only partly meet the profile below? No problem, we still encourage you to apply.


You hold a master's degree in engineering (Electronics, Computer Science, or equivalent)
You're skilled in Python, PySpark, Databricks, Pandas, Scikit-learn, MLflow
You have hands-on experience with, or a strong interest in, signal processing and machine learning applied to sensor data
You have a strong interest in mechanical systems (compressors, dryers, chillers or similar) and are eager to dive deeper into the domain
You enjoy working in diverse, international teams and are comfortable collaborating across functions
You are a problem-solver with a passion for innovation and a drive to continuously improve


In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.

You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at Airpower in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

Title: Junior Data Scientist
HTML:
Om ons data team verder te versterken, zoeken we een enthousiaste Junior Data Scientist.


Christeyns is een Belgische specialist in hygiëne- en reinigingsoplossingen voor onder meer wasserijen, de voedingsindustrie, schoonmaakbedrijven en de gezondheidszorg. De groep combineert de ontwikkeling en productie van reinigings- en desinfectieproducten met apparatuur, engineering, digitale toepassingen en technische dienstverlening.


Met meer dan 1.800 medewerkers en 47 dochterondernemingen wereldwijd rapporteerde Christeyns in 2025 een omzet van meer dan 487 miljoen euro. Het familiebedrijf werd opgericht in 1946 en is sinds 1989 in handen van de familie Bostoen.


Functieomschrijving


Bij Christeyns zetten we data om in waardevolle inzichten. Als internationale B2B-speler in de hygiënechemie investeren we sterk in een toekomstgerichte data-omgeving die onze bedrijfsprocessen en duurzaamheidsambities ondersteunt.


Om ons data team verder te versterken, zoeken we een enthousiaste Junior Data Scientist. In deze rol krijg je de kans om je analytische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen en stap voor stap door te groeien naar een functie als Business Analyst. Je werkt mee aan projecten die een directe impact hebben op de werking en besluitvorming binnen onze internationale organisatie.


Jouw functie


  • Je vertaalt ruwe en complexe data uit verschillende interne en externe bronnen naar heldere, bruikbare inzichten voor proceseigenaars en management, zodat beslissingen onderbouwd en datagedreven kunnen worden genomen.
  • Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en onderhoudt dashboards, datamodellen en API's die bedrijfsprocessen meetbaar, stuurbaar en transparant maken binnen een internationale organisatie.
  • Je werkt actief mee aan de verdere uitbouw en optimalisatie van de data-architectuur en -infrastructuur, waarbij betrouwbaarheid, performantie en schaalbaarheid centraal staan.
  • Je ontsluit data via gebruiksvriendelijke visualisaties en rapporteringen in tools zoals Power BI en Grafana, ondersteund door Databricks en Microsoft Azure.
  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor duurzaamheids- en ESG-gerelateerde data en zorgt voor correcte definities, consistente datasets en duidelijke rapportering ter ondersteuning van strategische doelstellingen.
  • Waar relevant pas je machine learning en geavanceerde analysetechnieken toe om patronen te identificeren, inzichten te verdiepen en data verder te verrijken.
  • Je stemt noden en verwachtingen rond data, visualisatie en voorspellende modellen af met proceseigenaars en werkt hiervoor nauw samen met IT en het data team.
  • Je rapporteert aan de Data Team Lead


Profiel


  • Master in Data Science, Toegepaste Informatica, Handelsingenieur, Economie of een vergelijkbare richting;
  • Je bent een starter of hebt een eerste relevante ervaring via stage, studentenjob of een eerste werkervaring;
  • Interesse in data-analyse, bedrijfsprocessen en business intelligence;
  • Basiskennis van SQL, Power BI of Python is een pluspunt;
  • Interesse om door te groeien richting Business Analytics;
  • Zeer goede kennis van Nederlands en Engels.


Aanbod


  • Een uitdagende startersfunctie binnen een internationale en groeiende organisatie;
  • Begeleiding en opleiding door ervaren collega's;
  • Werken in een gemotiveerd en dynamisch data team;
  • Ruimte voor initiatief, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en professionele groei;
  • Een marktconform salarispakket met extralegale voordelen.

Bij Bike Republic geloven we dat data, automatisering en artificiële intelligentie cruciale bouwstenen zijn om onze groei op een rendabele manier verder te zetten.

De afgelopen jaren investeerden we in een modern dataplatform met Azure, Databricks, Power BI en verschillende automatiseringen. Vandaag worden al tal van administratieve processen automatisch uitgevoerd zonder menselijke tussenkomst. De volgende stap is duidelijk: AI inzetten om processen slimmer, sneller en kwalitatief beter te maken.

Daarom zoeken we een Data, Automation & AI Engineer die mee bouwt aan de digitale toekomst van Bike Republic.

Je bevindt je op het kruispunt van business, data, automatisering en AI.

Je analyseert hoe onze bedrijfsprocessen werken, begrijpt hoe data door onze systemen stroomt en vertaalt die kennis naar oplossingen die onze organisatie efficiënter maken.

Dat kan gaan van het bouwen van een Power BI-dashboard, over het opzetten van een Power Automate-flow, tot het ontwikkelen van een AI-oplossing die repetitieve taken overneemt of medewerkers ondersteunt in hun dagelijkse werk.

Begrijpen van ERP-systemen en bedrijfsprocessen.
Integreren van data in onze Azure Data Lake omgeving.
Werken met Azure Data Factory, Databricks, SQL en API's.
Ontwikkelen van rapportering en dashboards in Power BI.
Vertalen van businessvragen naar bruikbare inzichten.

Detecteren van repetitieve administratieve taken.
Ontwerpen en bouwen van automatische workflows.
Werken met Microsoft Power Automate en andere integratietools.
Verbinden van verschillende systemen via API's en koppelingen.
Processen sneller, schaalbaarder en minder foutgevoelig maken.

Onderzoeken hoe AI kan bijdragen aan onze operationele processen.
Implementeren van AI-oplossingen binnen de Microsoft-omgeving.
Toepassen van AI voor analyse, classificatie, voorspellingen, klantencommunicatie en procesondersteuning.
Experimenteren met nieuwe technologieën en deze vertalen naar concrete bedrijfswaarde.
Collega's inspireren en begeleiden in het gebruik van AI-tools.

Meedenken over de verdere uitbouw van onze data- en IT-architectuur.
Samenwerken met externe partners en consultants.
Interesse tonen in infrastructuur, hardware en bredere IT-vraagstukken.
Mee bouwen aan een technologisch vooruitstrevende organisatie.
