Title: Data Engineer (h/f)
Description:
Contexte et environnement

TotalEnergies a l’ambition de se positionner en tant qu’acteur majeur de la transition énergétique.

La branche GRP est pleinement engagée au service de cette ambition et se transforme pour permettre à la Compagnie de devenir un électricien intégré dans un marché en croissance et orienté positivement.

Pour cela, la branche GRP a créée nouvellement une Business Unit depuis juillet 2023.

Cette nouvelle BU a pour missions de :


Se positionner en tant qu’expert interne sur les marchés de l’électricité et définir la stratégie Electricité de la Compagnie;
Assurer le marketing des actifs renouvelables de la Compagnie et optimiser leur valeur ;



Au sein de cette nouvelle Business Unit, la direction Tech&Transfo fournit les solutions informatiques à nos métiers et à nos clients externes. La ligne de Service Data And Reliability Team a notamment la charge de l’ensemble des projets DATA des filiales RPG FR et RPG BE.

Activités


Concevoir, développer et maintenir les architectures de données (data pipelines, data warehouses, data lakes).
Collecter, nettoyer, transformer et structurer les données provenant de différentes sources (internes et externes).
Assurer la qualité, la sécurité et l’intégrité des données.
Optimiser les performances des systèmes de traitement de données.
Mettre en place des processus d’automatisation pour l’ingestion et le traitement des données.
Documenter les flux de données, les modèles et les procédures.
Analyser les données et développer des solutions BI pour les visualiser et fournir des informations exploitables.
Construire des algorithmes complexes et élaborer des modèles prédictifs afin d’anticiper les comportements des clients ;
Analyser les données pour en extraire les informations les plus utiles au Groupe et les restituer de manière visuelle ;
Travailler conjointement avec les équipes Marketing, Vente, Energie Management…. Afin de comprendre leurs besoins et élaborer des modèles qui répondent à leurs problématiques
Faire de la veille technologique, et proposer les solutions techniques.
Rédiger les documentations nécessaires (Techniques et fonctionnelles), et les fiches de tâches au support pour assurer un bon suivi de la production



Profil du candidat

Formation supérieure (de type BAC+5 ingénieur ou universitaire)

2+ années d’expérience dans le domaine de la Data

Bonnes connaissances des environnements décisionnels et de leurs contraintes de fonctionnement et de service, de l’alimentation à la restitution


ML, Intelligence artificielle, modèles supervisés, modèles non supervisés, modèles d'apprentissag e par renforcement (obligatoire).
Python (panda, udf, …), SQL, Databricks, Devops, Java



Qualités personnelles :


Autonomie
Rigueur, capacité d’analyse et de synthèse
Esprit d’équipe
Bon relationnel
Sens du service et des responsabilités



Informations supplémentaires

TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, promeut le développement individuel et offre des opportunités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats.

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
🤖 The Job

At Dataroots, we deliver end-to-end data and AI solutions, from strategy and platform design to data engineering and AI-enabled systems. That broad scope is reflected in our team: AI/ML engineers, data engineers, cloud architects, and data strategists. Each discipline brings its own expertise, but we share knowledge, perspectives, and a common way of thinking across disciplines.

Within that team, you design, build and deploy AI solutions that deliver tangible business value for our clients across a variety of industries, spanning classical ML, modern GenAI, and Agentic AI use cases. Your work goes beyond getting the models to work; you help bring AI systems into production in a robust and scalable way, applying best practices in MLOps and LLMOps to ensure they are reliable, maintainable, and adaptable over time.




💼 What we’re looking for

You bring the following qualities & experiences to the role:

A deep passion for Artificial Intelligence and its applications.
A minimum of 2 years of experience developing AI-driven applications or systems.
Strong foundation in software design principles; Proficiency in Python & SQL is a must.
A solid understanding of core machine learning techniques and how to apply them pragmatically in production settings.
Familiarity with modern generative AI and agentic approaches, including retrieval-based systems and LLM orchestration patterns.
Experience deploying AI systems into production, with a solid grasp of model lifecycle management and cloud-native deployment practices.
Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and a solid understanding of cloud-based AI and data workflows.
Front-end experience is considered a plus.
Strong communication skills and the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for clients.
A pragmatic, business-oriented mindset: able to translate business problems into technical scopes and help AI solutions land, with a focus on product thinking and real business value.
Fluency in English and Dutch.




Not every box needs to be ticked to be a great fit. If you’re excited about the role and eager to grow, we’d still love to hear from you.




🎉 Why choose Dataroots?

We’re a data & AI consulting company where people, growth, and impact go hand in hand. Since our early days, we’ve built a culture that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and an environment where individuals can thrive. This focus has allowed us to grow steadily while staying true to what matters: delivering meaningful results for our clients and creating a place where people enjoy doing their best work.

Working at Dataroots means gaining exposure to a wide range of industries, challenges, and technologies. You’ll have the opportunity to step outside your comfort zone, while being supported by experienced colleagues who are always ready to share their expertise.

As part of the Talan Group, we further extend these opportunities by offering an international dimension to your career path.




💰 The Offer

An attractive salary with extralegal benefits, including:

+ Mobility budget or a company car with fuel/charging card

+ Hospitalisation and group insurance

+ High-end laptop

+ Smartphone with subscription

+ Substantial amount of holidays

+ Meal vouchers

+ ...

Diverse and welcoming work environment, where you’ll collaborate & unwind with colleagues from different cultures and disciplines. The organization of both fun & professional events and initiatives is actively encouraged and supported.
A training budget for individual and team learning opportunities.
Tons of team-building events and sports initiatives to stay connected and unwind.




📍 Where you’ll work

Our main offices are in Leuven and Ghent. These spaces are perfect for both focusing and unwinding with colleagues, as well as brainstorming sessions and team events.

While much of your work can be performed remotely, you will also work on-site with clients.




🎯 Ready to join Dataroots?

Excited to shape the future of AI with us? We’re looking forward to hearing from you! Apply now and start a new chapter as AI/ML Engineer at Dataroots! 🎉

Title: Decision Intelligence Developer
Description:
Can’t wait to make an impact on the world? You’re not alone. Join us in driving progress in the working world and beyond.

Your journey with us

We’re seeking a talented Data Skill Builder to join our Supply Chain Data Team. In this role, you’ll be the bridge between complex data systems and actionable insights—extracting, transforming, and visualizing data from diverse sources to fuel intelligent decision-making. You’ll work closely with architects and business stakeholders to build robust data pipelines and compelling analytics that drive supply chain optimization. If you’re passionate about turning raw data into business value and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, this is your opportunity to make a tangible impact.

What You’ll Do


Data Extraction & Integration: Extract data from multiple enterprise systems (ERP, WMS, TMS, planning tools) and third-party sources; design and build reliable data pipelines that consolidate information into unified datasets
Data Analysis & Transformation: Perform exploratory data analysis, identify data quality issues, and transform raw data into clean, structured formats ready for analytics and modeling
Analytics Development: Develop analytical queries, dashboards, and reports that surface key insights; translate business questions into data-driven answers
Data Visualization: Create compelling visualizations and interactive dashboards (Tableau, Power BI) that communicate complex data stories to business stakeholders in clear, actionable ways
Collaboration with Architects: Work closely with Solution Architects to understand technical requirements; implement data solutions according to architectural specifications and best practices
Data Quality & Governance: Implement data validation checks, monitor data quality, and maintain documentation; ensure data consistency and reliability across systems
Continuous Learning: Stay current with data engineering tools, analytics techniques, and emerging technologies; contribute ideas for improving data processes and methodologies


Let's Talk About You


Data Engineering Fundamentals: 3+ years of hands-on experience building data pipelines, ETL processes, and working with SQL and relational/non-relational databases
Programming Proficiency: Strong experience with Python, SQL, or similar languages; ability to write clean, maintainable code and debug technical issues independently
Analytics & Visualization: Demonstrated expertise with analytics tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and statistical analysis; ability to translate data into compelling visual narratives
Cloud & Data Platforms: Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience working with data warehouses, data lakes, or big data platforms (Spark, Hadoop)
Problem-Solving Mindset: Strong analytical thinking; ability to break down complex data challenges and find practical solutions with minimal guidance
Communication Skills: Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders; comfortable presenting findings and collaborating across teams
Passion for Data: Genuine curiosity about data; track record of delivering data projects that drove measurable business insights or operational improvements


Primary Focus: Data Excellence Over Platform Specificity

While Familiarity With Aera Technology Is a Nice-to-have, Data Engineering And Analytics Expertise Is What Matters Most. We Value Professionals Who


Prioritize data quality, pipeline reliability, and analytical rigor above platform-specific knowledge
Can quickly learn new tools and platforms as business needs evolve
Understand when to build custom solutions vs. leverage existing platforms
Bring deep experience with core data technologies: Python, SQL, cloud data warehouses, BI tools, and ML frameworks


Supporting Technologies

Data & Analytics : Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost

Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP

Data Warehousing: Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Delta Lake

Visualization & BI: Tableau, Power BI, Looker

DevOps & Deployment: Git, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines

Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, design tools

Our story

Enterprise Performance is about achieving maximum impact and value from investments in finance, supply chain, and IT operations requires a holistic view of key business functions from strategy through process design and technology enablement

Deloitte is a globally recognized professional services firm committed to making an impact that matters. Our Supply Chain & Network Operations practice supports clients in addressing their most critical supply chain challenges through strategic, analytical, and technology-enabled projects. We deliver end-to-end, data-driven redesign and digitization to transform key areas such as planning, sourcing & procurement, manufacturing, and logistics & distribution. Join our team in Belgium and work with clients across diverse industries as we advise, implement, and operate solutions that drive sustainable growth and operational excellence.

Who is Deloitte?

We provide industry-leading audit and assurance, tax and legal, consulting and related services. We are committed to driving innovation across offerings to help our clients address their challenges, while giving our professionals opportunities to learn and grow in this era of transformation.

In Belgium, +5000 dedicated professionals active in +10 offices, take great pride in bringing multidisciplinary expertise to a wide variety of clients, from national and international companies, small, fast-growing and large organizations to public institutions and governmental authorities.

Why Deloitte?

Be the true you! We foster diversity and inclusion and encourage you to bring your authentic self to work. Explore, question and collaborate while building a career that inspires and energises you.

Never stop growing! Diversity of thought makes us stronger. At Deloitte, we tailor a personalized learning experience, offering you the opportunity to grow at your own pace and achieve maximum impact.

We practice what we preach! As a Purpose-led organisation, at the heart of everything we do is a set of timeless principles and unifying values .

Life looks different for each of us, so we created a varied benefits package that you can tap into:


My Benefits My Choice, a flexible rewards plan tailored to your lifestyle and priorities
Sustainable transport options offered by Mobility@Deloitte
Flexible work arrangements for all and initiatives supported by Parents & Caregivers @Deloitte
Wellbeing tips and activities powered by Energise@Deloitte
Topped off with other health benefits and insurance opportunities


Empowering our employees with flexible work arrangements remains essential in today's reality:


Hybrid workplace: combination of home office and on-site (+10 offices in Belgium or client's premises).
Part-time employment: all our jobs are open to full-time or part-time work under a 90% or 80% regime.


Join us to make an impact together! Apply now!

About the job

Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence and eager to build solutions that create real business impact? At Bleckmann, you will play a key role in the development, implementation and continuous improvement of AI-driven solutions, intelligent agents and machine learning applications.

Your role

As an AI Developer, you contribute to the development, implementation and continuous improvement of AI-driven solutions, intelligent agents and machine learning applications. You play a key role in delivering innovative AI capabilities while ensuring alignment with governance, data quality standards and business objectives.




Your responsibilities

AI Solution Development (35%)

Design and develop AI/ML and GenAI solutions based on prioritized business use cases
Build scalable AI pipelines leveraging Snowflake and integrated tools
Develop, test, and deploy models (e.g. forecasting, classification, optimization, LLM-based applications)
Translate prototypes or PoCs into production-ready solutions
Integrate AI capabilities into BI solutions, workflows, or applications
Maintain and improve existing AI solutions

Use Case Implementation & Innovation (20%)

Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and refine AI use cases (e.g. during AI bootcamps)
Translate business questions into technical AI solutions
Perform feasibility assessments and validate potential business value
Contribute to shaping and prioritizing the AI roadmap
Prototype innovative AI solutions and experiment with new technologies

Support deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of solutions
Communicate progress, risks, and results clearly to stakeholders

Strong programming skills in Python (AI/ML, APIs, data processing)
Solid experience with SQL and working in Snowflake (or similar cloud data platforms)
Understanding of data modeling concepts and ability to work with structured data environments
Experience with machine learning techniques (regression, classification, clustering, etc.)
Experience with Generative AI / LLMs and agent-based solutions

Knowledge of

Prompt engineering
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Embeddings and vector search
Experience integrating AI services or APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Azure AI, etc.)
Understanding of AI limitations, including hallucination risks and mitigation techniques
Experience working with data pipelines and data products (as consumer, not owner)
Ability to design feature engineering and data preparation logic
Understanding of semantic layer concepts and business metrics definitions
Awareness of performance optimization and cost control in cloud environments

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
Ability to translate business problems into technical AI solutions
Focus on delivering value, not just building models
High attention to data quality, reliability, and correctness
Passion for innovation and continuous learning in AI
Strong collaboration skills in cross-functional teams
Ability to work effectively in an Agile / Scrum environment
Comfortable working in a hybrid setup (internal + external partners)
Proactive and ownership-driven mindset
Ability to manage ambiguity and evolving requirements
Ability to explain complex AI concepts in a clear and business-friendly way
Strong communication towards business stakeholders (translate needs into solutions) and technical teams (align with Data Engineers / IT)

Ability to

Document AI solutions and decisions clearly
Present results and insights in an understandable way
Comfortable challenging requirements when needed (critical thinking)

Nice to have

Experience with Snowflake AI capabilities (e.g. Cortex, Snowpark,…)
MLOps / model lifecycle management
Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment (Scrum methodology can be learned)
Ability to collaborate with external partners / vendors
Awareness of AI governance, security, and data privacy (GDPR)
Experience in Logistics / supply chain / operational environments
Building AI agents in enterprise environments
Working in governed data environments (enterprise BI setups)




What we offer

A role with direct impact on business development
Exposure to international clients, carriers and internal stakeholders
A dynamic environment where requests are varied and often cross-functional
Room to improve processes, templates, data quality and ways of working
Guided freedom to take initiative and grow your expertise
A collaborative team environment with short communication lines
Hybrid working possibilities, depending on location and business needs

Title: AI & Data Engineer
Description:
What You'll Do




Are you the AI & Data Engineer who wants to join our team to develop innovative data pipelines and state-of-the-art AI solutions?

As an AI & Data Engineer at iO, you are first and foremost an experienced software engineer who builds, integrates, and operationalizes AI and data solutions within clients’ existing IT ecosystems.

You will work on a wide variety of AI challenges: from intelligently leveraging or fine-tuning Large Language Models, agent and multi-agent setups, and applying RAG patterns, to building ETL pipelines that feed a data platform. A recurring pattern in your work is integrating existing cloud services and APIs into an efficient, scalable, and reliable solution. The focus lies on building production-grade systems that function correctly within complex, often enterprise-level IT landscapes.

Prompt engineering is an art form to you. You think creatively about how to achieve the best results, while paying attention to preventing hallucinations and implementing smart guardrails. You evaluate your solutions systematically to gain insight into output quality.

In your work, you will encounter many forms of AI: from statistical models to Large Language Models, from Generative AI in the domains of image, video, and audio to Natural Language Processing. The emphasis is mainly on applying and integrating existing models and services, and building the infrastructure around them.

You will work on a wide range of client challenges: from automatically analyzing documents to detecting events in audio or video data, building agents and orchestration solutions, generating graphical output based on data, or creating and validating content. Wherever AI can add value, you design and implement the complete solution as an engineer.

You collaborate with various AI experts within iO and with technical teams on the client side. Your solutions are based on modern (cloud) platforms, SaaS services, and programming languages such as TypeScript and Python.




What Are Your Responsibilities as an AI & Data Engineer?

Designing AI & Data solutions: Analyze client challenges related to AI and data and define solutions, approaches, and architecture
Software engineering & integration: Develop backend components, APIs, and services to ensure AI solutions integrate seamlessly with existing applications and platforms
Data Pipeline Development: Design and build robust ETL/ELT processes and real-time data streams
Data Platform Architecture: Set up modern data warehouses, data lakes, and analytics platforms
AI Integration: Implement machine learning pipelines and integrate AI services into data workflows
Data Quality & Governance: Ensure data quality, security, and compliance within data ecosystems
Performance Optimization: Optimize data processing performance and scalability
Cloud Data Services: Work with cloud-native data services such as AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, or Google Dataflow
Monitoring & Observability: Implement monitoring and alerting for data pipelines and AI workloads




Your Qualities And Skills As AI & Data Engineer

You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with a focus on software engineering
You have several years of experience as a software engineer and have worked on data- and/or AI-driven systems in a professional, preferably enterprise, environment
You have experience with different LLM architectures and understand the strengths and weaknesses of various AI solutions
You are familiar with the principles of modern data architectures, data modeling, and big data processing
You are proficient in modern data processing languages such as Python and SQL, and have experience with frameworks such as Apache Spark, Pandas, or Dask
You are familiar with AWS or Azure cloud data platforms
You have a strong foundation in software engineering, including knowledge of CI/CD, unit testing, Git (flow), secure development, error handling, asynchronous operations, and real-time data streams
You are able to translate your ideas into technical architecture diagrams, data flow schemas, and documentation, while also clearly explaining your solutions to less technical stakeholders (clients and colleagues)
You enjoy sparring with colleagues about ideas and solutions and working collaboratively to achieve better results




What’s in it for you




32 vacation days

Based on a 40-hour work week, you’ll have 20 vacation days and 12 compensatory days of leave (reduction of working time).

Money icon Money icon used in website




Mobility & end-of-year bonus

After working at iO for 6 months, you can count on an end-of-year bonus. And in terms of mobility, you can choose from various options, depending on your job or preference.




Hospitalisation insurance

When something unfortunate happens, the last thing you need is the added stress of unexpected costs. That’s why all employees get hospitalisation insurance at Axa.




Hybrid working

A good work-life balance is super important. Together with your team, you’ll decide when and where you work.




Healthy snacks & lunch

At every iO campus, you can grab a healthy snack throughout the day and have a healthy and varied lunch for a small fee.




Personal training budget

Each year, you’ll get a budget of €3,000 to develop yourself, in your profession or as a person, through training, events, or courses.




Celebrating together

If there’s something to celebrate, we know how to party! From time to time, the party team at your campus will organise the best (theme) parties.

Title: Freelance Data Scientist with Ontology and Graph expertise
Description:
Job Description

adesso Belgium is looking for a data scientist (2) to support our customer in building an AI Agent Platform Data Foundations.

Customer Info

Our customer is an international, independent provider of indirect procurement services.

Job Requirements

Preferred start date: 1xASAP and 1x January 2027

Duration: 12 months

Rate: depending on your location

Time Zone: CET

Your role

Build the data and context layer that powers the customer's procurement AI agent platform — canonical models, knowledge graph, semantic/taxonomy layer, and the retrieval and evaluation pipelines agents depend on. This is production infrastructure from day one, not a proof of concept: versioned, tested, and built for multiple tenants.

You Will Work On


Data products & canonical modeling — Design and deliver the first reference data products (Supplier Master, Spend Cube, Contract Register) end to end, from source ingestion through the canonical model.
Knowledge graph & ontology — Stand up and operate the platform and working graphs (ontology, reference data, tenant separation); own the graph-plus-vector retrieval design, deciding per source whether data is represented as entities/relationships, embeddings, or both.
Master data & semantic layer — Build matching rules, golden records, and stewardship processes for Suppliers, Contracts, and Categories; contribute to the business glossary and taxonomy-to-ontology mapping.
Extraction & evaluation — Build document-extraction pipelines (e.g., from SharePoint sources) with confidence scoring and human review for uncertain cases; build and maintain labelled evaluation datasets and accuracy benchmarks against agreed thresholds.
Connector framework — Build source connectors (starting with Fabric data products and master data golden records) so new sources can be onboarded without modifying the graph core or query service.
Quality feedback loop — Implement the mechanism routing agent overrides, failures, or low-confidence retrievals back to data owners so data products improve over time rather than decay.
Engineering practice — Work exclusively in the GitHub/Azure environment; ship via pull request with CI (build, tests, security scan, evaluation fixtures); version all schemas, connector contracts, and extraction configs.


Hard Skills

Required Experience


Demonstrated experience taking a knowledge graph system to production (not just prototyping) — schema design, query performance, tenant/data isolation - Using Neo4J and Python
Strong background in semantic modeling: ontologies, taxonomies, business glossaries, and their relationship to graph and canonical data models.
Hands-on experience with semantic web standards and technologies including OWL/OWL2, RDF, RDFS, SPARQL, ontology lifecycle management, taxonomy alignment, and semantic reasoning.
Experience building data products and master-data pipelines (entity matching, golden-record consolidation, stewardship workflows).
Experience designing and implementing hybrid retrieval architectures combining graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) and vector databases to support semantic search, RAG, and AI agent workloads.
Experience with retrieval architectures combining graph and vector/embedding approaches.
Experience building and maintaining labelled evaluation datasets and measuring extraction/model accuracy against a threshold.
Proficiency with modern data/ML engineering practices: version control, CI/CD, automated testing, containerized deployment
Experience with Microsoft Fabric and SharePoint-based document extraction pipelines.


Soft Skills


Fluent in ENG
Open to travelling if needed (EU), this position is fully remote
Collaborative mindset, ideally with a proven similar work experience


Why join adesso Belgium?


Work in an international group with strong local expertise in Belgium.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver trusted, compliant, reusable data products.
Flexible freelance setup with the support of a growing adesso Belgium community.

Our customer is an international, independent provider of indirect procurement services.

Job Requirements

Preferred start date: 1xASAP and 1x January 2027

Duration: 12 months

Rate: depending on your location

Time Zone: CET

Your role

Build the data and context layer that powers the customer's procurement AI agent platform — canonical models, knowledge graph, semantic/taxonomy layer, and the retrieval and evaluation pipelines agents depend on. This is production infrastructure from day one, not a proof of concept: versioned, tested, and built for multiple tenants.

You Will Work On

  • Data products & canonical modeling — Design and deliver the first reference data products (Supplier Master, Spend Cube, Contract Register) end to end, from source ingestion through the canonical model.
  • Knowledge graph & ontology — Stand up and operate the platform and working graphs (ontology, reference data, tenant separation); own the graph-plus-vector retrieval design, deciding per source whether data is represented as entities/relationships, embeddings, or both.
  • Master data & semantic layer — Build matching rules, golden records, and stewardship processes for Suppliers, Contracts, and Categories; contribute to the business glossary and taxonomy-to-ontology mapping.
  • Extraction & evaluation — Build document-extraction pipelines (e.g., from SharePoint sources) with confidence scoring and human review for uncertain cases; build and maintain labelled evaluation datasets and accuracy benchmarks against agreed thresholds.
  • Connector framework — Build source connectors (starting with Fabric data products and master data golden records) so new sources can be onboarded without modifying the graph core or query service.
  • Quality feedback loop — Implement the mechanism routing agent overrides, failures, or low-confidence retrievals back to data owners so data products improve over time rather than decay.
  • Engineering practice — Work exclusively in the GitHub/Azure environment; ship via pull request with CI (build, tests, security scan, evaluation fixtures); version all schemas, connector contracts, and extraction configs.

Hard Skills

 Required Experience

  • Demonstrated experience taking a knowledge graph system to production (not just prototyping) — schema design, query performance, tenant/data isolation - Using Neo4J and Python
  • Strong background in semantic modeling: ontologies, taxonomies, business glossaries, and their relationship to graph and canonical data models.
  • Hands-on experience with semantic web standards and technologies including OWL/OWL2, RDF, RDFS, SPARQL, ontology lifecycle management, taxonomy alignment, and semantic reasoning.
  • Experience building data products and master-data pipelines (entity matching, golden-record consolidation, stewardship workflows).
  • Experience designing and implementing hybrid retrieval architectures combining graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) and vector databases to support semantic search, RAG, and AI agent workloads.
  • Experience with retrieval architectures combining graph and vector/embedding approaches.
  • Experience building and maintaining labelled evaluation datasets and measuring extraction/model accuracy against a threshold.
  • Proficiency with modern data/ML engineering practices: version control, CI/CD, automated testing, containerized deployment
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and SharePoint-based document extraction pipelines.

Soft Skills

  • Fluent in ENG
  • Open to travelling if needed (EU), this position is fully remote
  • Collaborative mindset, ideally with a proven similar work experience

Why join adesso Belgium?

  • Work in an international group with strong local expertise in Belgium.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver trusted, compliant, reusable data products.
  • Flexible freelance setup with the support of a growing adesso Belgium community.

Title: AI/ML ENGINEER
Description:
At Ayesa Digital, we grow with you.




Every professional in our company is essential. Thanks to their talent, we continue to expand: today, we are a global team of more than 11,000 people working toward a shared mission.




Ayesa Digital is currently participating in high-impact European Union projects designed to address major European challenges and drive science and innovation. These strategic technological initiatives stand out for their international scope and strong commitment to socially oriented results.




We are looking for a AI/ML Engineer to join our international team and contribute to the developing, training and maintenance of the machine learning models and software applications in the fields of Nature Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligencia (AI), including the application of Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI for specific use cases.




Key Responsibilities




Deploy generative AI models or integrate their APIs, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques.
Select features, build and optimize classifiers using machine learning techniques.
Perform studies and developments aiming at improving the quality of machine translation (MT) engines for each installed language pair, addressing the specific needs of customers of the service concerning MT quality and contributing to a general strategy for the systematic evaluation and long-term improvement of MT quality.
Interact with data stewards and other IT stakeholders to define the data rules.
Define data controls and implement strategies to ensure data quality, integrity, and the detection and mitigation of bias in datasets and AI models.
Create automated anomaly detection systems and constant tracking of its performance.
Perform processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis.
Design and propose the technical architecture for NLP/ML/AI solutions, coordinating its implementation with engineering teams while adhering to data management principles (master data management, metadata).
Assess data architecture against quality dimensions (consistency, completeness, accuracy, reasonableness) and recommend target-state improvements.
Draft technical guidelines, documentation, and presentations to effectively communicate complex AI concepts, project status, and results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ensure compliance with data protection and AI Act regulations.
Implement MLOps practices to automate the machine learning lifecycle, including continuous integration, delivery, and monitoring (CI/CD/CD) of models.
Monitor model performance in production, identifying model drift and initiating retraining processes to maintain accuracy and relevance.
Stay abreast of the latest academic and industry research in AI/ML to propose and pilot innovative solutions that provide competitive advantage.




What We Are Looking For (Requirements):




Excellent knowledge of programming languages essential for AI/ML, primarily Python and R, and their key libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, SpaCy, NLTK).
Excellent knowledge of machine learning techniques and algorithms, such as k-NN, Naive Bayes, SVM, Decision Forests, Neural Network, and/or artificial intelligence frameworks.
Good knowledge of cloud tools for Fine tuning or training Models, like AWS SageMaker or Azure Machine Learning Studio.
Good knowledge of cloud platforms for building LLM solutions (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Studio) and frameworks for orchestration (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and safety/guardrails.
Good knowledge of AI Agent Orchestration frameworks, like Langchain or Semantic Kernel.
Good knowledge of quality assurance and quality control for machine translation (MT) and experience with MT quality procedures, testing methodologies and tools, such as automatic quality metrics (BLEU scores and similar) and human evaluation of MT quality.
Knowledge of query languages, such as SQL, Hive, Pig, etc and with information extraction
Knowledge of data visualisation tools, such as D3.js, GGplot, etc
Knowledge of NoSQL databases, such as MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase, etc
Knowledge of relevant elements of cybersecurity of AI systems
Knowledge of the relevant aspects of the AI Act and AI risks.
Experience with MLOps practices and tools for model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and governance (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow).
Knowledge of techniques for responsible AI, including bias detection and mitigation (e.g., IBM AIF360, Fairlearn) and model explainability (e.g., SHAP, LIME)
Good level of English, optionally French as an additional asset.




One of the following or an equivalent certification:

AWS Certified Machine Learning
Specialty, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate,
SAS Certified Professional AI and Machine Learning.




What We Offer:

Prestigious projects within European institutions.
International, innovative, and multicultural environments.
Continuous support from a team of experts in EU projects.




If you are ambitious, enthusiastic, and seeking a new professional challenge in international projects with real-world impact, this is the place for you!

Why are you looking for a job?

If your answer ticks all the boxes, this could be the start of a great collaboration.


You have a curious mind - You won't understand what we're talking about if you don't 🤔
You want to learn more around technology - You won't survive if you don't 😱
You want to make the world a bit better 😇


We happen to be just like that as well. We like hacking things here and there (you included) and create scalable solutions that bring value to the world.

SquareDev? 🐿️

We use state-of-the-art technology to build solutions for our customers and our partners' customers. We make sure we stay best-in-class by participating in research projects across Europe, collaborating with top universities and enterprises on AI, Data, and Cloud.

About QnR Group

SquareDev is a member of the QnR Group, a leading technology organization specializing in end-to-end custom software solutions, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business One, ServiceNow, and FinTech solutions.

As part of QnR Group's ongoing expansion — both in Greece and internationally — we are continuously hiring across a wide range of tech roles. Successful candidates may be hired by QnR Group, or another company within the Group, depending on the role and project.

Role Overview

We are looking for an Engineer to join one of our EU public sector clients based in Brussels. You'll will contribute to the design, development, and deployment of core platform components, focusing on data engineering, analytics and AI-enabled capabilities. The role requires a strong ability to work across structured and unstructured data, enabling reporting and advanced analytical and AI use cases.

Requirements

The ideal candidate will be responsible for:


Building and maintaining data pipelines integrating heterogeneous structured and unstructured sources, including batch and near-real-time ingestion
Performing data cleansing, validation, standardization, metadata tagging, and supporting data lineage across data flows
Contributing to the Data and Product Catalogue and implementing data quality checks and monitoring
Designing solutions that combine structured data (databases, tabular datasets) with unstructured data (documents, reports, text) into reusable data products
Supporting AI-driven processing of document-centric data and contributing to AI-enabled use cases with explainability, traceability, and human-in-the-loop controls
Automating pipelines and reporting workflows, and implementing event-driven processing, alerts, and monitoring
Implementing security controls (IAM, encryption at rest/in transit, audit logging) and supporting separation of classified/unclassified and secure or air-gapped environments
Building modular, scalable platform components using open standards/APIs, and supporting integration with existing EDA systems


To excel in this role, you'll need:


Proven experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines and working with data lake/warehouse architectures (Microsoft Fabric, Azure ecosystem, or open-source platforms)
Demonstrated experience integrating structured data (databases, tabular) with unstructured data (documents, PDFs, text corpora) end-to-end
Experience in analytics development, data modelling, and exposure to AI/ML on text/document-based data, with understanding of explainability and traceability
Knowledge of DevOps, Git, CI/CD, and pipeline automation; ability to work in multi-stakeholder environments
Strong English communication skills.

Be at the heart of digital innovation

We are looking for visionary Data Engineers, ready to lead technological transformation through the power of Google Cloud. Join us to make a concrete contribution to the future of digital transformation, where creativity, strategy, and cross‑cultural collaboration are the driving forces of change. If you want to apply your skills to cutting‑edge technologies and play a leading role in designing innovative solutions for our clients, this is the right place for you.

Your role and career prospects

Join our international network of Google Cloud talent. You will work with innovative technologies on exciting projects, implementing modern and scalable solutions. You will have the opportunity to engage with leading organizations in the field, access tailored learning paths and training delivered directly by top Google experts, and become part of a highly skilled team with a constant focus on innovation.



You will take on a key role as a Senior Data Scientist, providing strategic consulting to clients and developing AI‑driven solutions that enable their growth and innovation.

Design and build advanced data pipelines on Google Cloud, integrating heterogeneous data sources to feed predictive and AI models

Define modern machine learning and deep learning architectures, leveraging cloud‑native frameworks and services, with a strong focus on Generative AI technologies

Lead innovative projects that enable clients to harness the potential of Generative Artificial Intelligence, implementing multimodal models and multi‑agent frameworks on Google Cloud platforms

Manage and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, facilitating dialogue between clients, stakeholders, and technical specialists to ensure the success of each digital transformation initiative

Learn and collaborate with Accenture Google Certified Fellows and Google Cloud professionals, enhancing both your technical and managerial skills in a center‑of‑excellence environment

Proven experience (at least 5 years) in multicultural and inclusive working environments, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in diverse teams on international projects

At least 3 years of experience in enterprise consulting, delivering AI‑driven solutions and innovative strategies on Google Cloud

Strong experience (3–5 years) in designing and implementing complex AI pipelines on cloud platforms (preferably Google Cloud Platform), integrating heterogeneous data sources and powering machine learning and AI models in digital transformation contexts

A strong problem‑solving mindset and the ability to identify AI‑based solutions that enable clients in their digital transformation, including taking a leadership or advisory role in defining such strategies

Solid experience in implementing advanced Agentic AI architectures and multi‑agent orchestration, including experience with RAG development and the use of leading implementation frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google Gen AI SDK, and protocols such as A2A, MCP, AP2)

Advanced knowledge of LLM models, prompt engineering, programming languages, Python (at least 5 years), and familiarity with data science frameworks

A professional Google Cloud certification (ML Engineer preferred, or Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, Cloud Developer, DevOps Engineer, Database Engineer), STEM degree.

13th month + holiday allowance

Essential tools: We equip you with the necessary tools for success, including laptop, smartphone, mobile subscription and internet at home.

Title: Data Engineer - GenAI
Description:
Join Artefact Belgium: Build the Foundation of AI and Data Transformation

Are you an experienced Data Engineer with a passion for building high-performance data pipelines and scalable cloud architectures for the Generative AI era? Artefact Belgium is looking for a Data Engineer to drive innovation and deliver robust data foundations for our global clients. If you have a solid track record in data engineering and consulting, we invite you to shape the future of AI-driven solutions with us in Brussels.

Who We Are

Founded in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm specializing in data, analytics, and AI, focused on transforming data into business impact. We help clients grow their data and digital capabilities while growing ourselves. Our engineering team in Belgium works on the most advanced applications of data technology, from large-scale data platforms to supporting state-of-the-art GenAI projects. Our inclusive and forward-thinking culture encourages creativity, collaboration, and professional growth.

What You Will Do

As a Data Engineer in our GenAI practice, you will own the end-to-end execution of complex technical challenges. You won't just "move" data; you will build the specialized infrastructure and data flywheels that power the next generation of Generative AI, RAG systems, and autonomous agents.


Deploy GenAI-Ready Production Pipelines: Design and deploy advanced data pipelines both batch and streaming optimized for processing unstructured data (text, images, audio) to fuel LLM fine-tuning and retrieval-augmented generation.
Build Scalable AI Platforms & Vector DBs: Hands-on development using modern cloud platforms like Databricks, Azure, or AWS.
Establish Engineering Excellence for LLMs: Implement best practices in data transformation (dbt), orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster), and data governance to ensure that AI solutions are reliable, safe, and compliant at enterprise scale.
Collaborate on AI Innovation: Work closely with Machine Learning Engineers and Generative AI Specialists to design data models and "data-as-a-service" layers that enable rapid prototyping and scaling of AI agents.
Software Engineering Foundation: Advocate for clean, maintainable code using Python, SQL, and Git, and leverage containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) to deploy AI-driven microservices.


Who You Are


Experienced Professional: At least 3-5 years of industry experience in data engineering, ideally within a consulting environment, with exposure to data preparation for AI/ML.
Deep Technical Skillset: Strong programming skills in Python and proven expertise in Spark (PySpark, SparkSQL) for large-scale data processing and feature engineering.
Data Transformation Expert: Extensive experience with dbt for data modeling, and a strong curiosity about emerging patterns in "LLMOps" and vector data management.
Consulting Mindset: Proven ability to navigate multidisciplinary environments and communicate how high-quality data architecture is the primary bottleneck for successful GenAI deployment.
Education: A Master’s in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field).
Linguistic Versatility: Proficiency in English is required; fluency in Dutch or French is a major advantage for our Belgian market.


What We Offer


Competitive Compensation: An attractive package aligned with your expertise, including a mobility budget or company car and premium insurance.
High-Impact Opportunities: Work with state-of-the-art technologies on global projects that transform the world's leading brands through Generative AI.
Professional Growth: Access to a substantial training budget for individual learning, research into new AI frameworks, and certifications.
A Collaborative Workplace: Join a diverse team where fun and professional excellence go hand-in-hand, with access to 2,000+ colleagues across 34 global offices.


This position is based in Brussels, At Artefact Belgium, we value expertise, curiosity, and a drive to innovate. If you're ready to build the data engines of the AI future, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: AI Engineer

Als gedreven expert combineer jij sterke technische vaardigheden met een scherp probleemoplossend vermogen, waarbij je de schaalbaarheid van intelligente modellen nooit uit het oog verliest. Je vertaalt je passie voor technologie dagelijks naar innovatieve oplossingen, zoals Generative AI en Machine Learning toepassingen, die nauw aansluiten bij de behoeften van de klant. Vanuit een natuurlijke nieuwsgierigheid volg je de bliksemsnelle ontwikkelingen binnen het AI-landschap op de voet om voorop te blijven lopen in de markt. Jouw ambitie om continu te leren zorgt ervoor dat je jezelf blijft ontwikkelen en altijd op zoek gaat naar verbetering. Zo bouw je met een frisse blik mee aan de slimme, toekomstbestendige systemen van onze klanten.




Jouw profiel

● Je hebt een Bachelor/Master diploma en 3 tot 5 jaar relevante ervaring in software of data engineering.

● Je hebt diepgaande kennis van Python en ervaring met frameworks zoals PyTorch, TensorFlow of Scikit-learn.

● Je hebt ervaring met het implementeren van LLM’s (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source) en technieken zoals RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).

● Je begrijpt hoe MLOps werkt en bent bekend met het deployen van modellen via Azure AI Studio, AWS SageMaker of Google Vertex AI.

● Je bent kwaliteitsgericht: "Responsible AI" en "Model Monitoring" zijn voor jou geen buzzwords, maar essentiële voorwaarden voor betrouwbare intelligentie.

● Je bent een vlotte communicator en positief ingesteld

● Je bent vloeiend in Nederlands en Engels ; goede kennis Frans is een pluspunt




Ons aanbod

● Uitdagende AI projecten in een entrepreneurial omgeving

● De kans om ons AI & Data departement verder uit te bouwen en onze interne werking te optimaliseren

● Onze Data & AI Practice lead en onze L&D Manager begeleiden je samen richting passende opleidingen en nieuwe certificaten

● Team events waarbij je andere Data consultants beter leert kennen, en bijleert van elkaar

● Salarispakket op maat inclusief bedrijfswagen, laadpas, maaltijdcheques, groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, 32 vakantiedagen, Flex Income Plan

Title: Data Science Lead
Description:
Make your mark for patients

To strengthen our Global Advanced Analytics team, we are looking for an adaptable, collaborative individual with an intrapreneurial mindset for our Data Science Lead opening. This hybrid role is based in our headquarters in Anderlecth, Brussels, Belgium requiring 40% onsite presence and 5-10% international/ domestic travel.

About The Role

You will help to inform on the commercial viability of various assets in development.You will be responsible for making exceptional business impact with the use of secondary data and insights development through advanced analytics methods, enabling an increased use of data and, where applicable, reducing the necessity for building primary data. You will also be responsible for managing and implementing advanced analytics/AI projects to ensure successful delivery. You will oversee the ongoing operations of advanced analytics solutions to ensure that models continue to work and scale them up with additional demand and applications. You will serve as the subject matter expert for Advanced Analytics/AI capabilities in support of business needs within Patient Solutions and Patient Evidence.

Who you’ll work with

You will co-create with Integrated Insights Leads from early asset and late stage (Phase 0-3) teams, Real world evidence teams, Translational Medicine and Bioinformatics, Clinical operations, clinical recruitment, and asset teams, new product planning teams, Commercial teams, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Finance, and IT. Externally, you will work with data and analytics vendors and partners.

What you’ll do


Analytics Leadership: Provide clear expertise for opportunities to leverage advanced analytics, especially where they are advantageous to reducing the need for primary data or have high marginal impact
Deliver the most impactful data and analytics projects that:
address the most compelling business questions, and/or
identify new opportunities for patients and UCB through effective visual displays of quantitative and qualitative information
Partnership and Collaboration: Be the key strategic partner for functional stakeholders and co-create plans and priorities for data and advanced analytics with them together with the Patient Solutions and Evidence Leads. Ensure tight relationships and collaboration with IT, Data Office, and other Analytics teams using relevant data sources.
Team Leadership . Serve as a mentor and guide to more junior data scientists and translators in demonstrating the application of cutting-edge analytics, clear communication and presentation of insights and practical/pragmatic implementation of key recommendations
Drive the execution of regional and local data-driven insights research and data analytics plans and priorities
Foster a strong data science community with significant business acumen and communication skills across Hubs and Engine and Supervise the conduct of advanced analytics studies in a collaborative manner ensuring that the study methodology is appropriate to deliver reliable results.
Improve the team’s partnership with, and impact on, key internal (UCB) and external stakeholders within the specific area of focus by:
developing and executing a communication and collaboration plan with key UCB stakeholders
increasing personal and the Advanced Analytics team’s knowledge of the business by ensuring that she/he and each team member has direct interaction with patients and/or other external stakeholders
Attract , retain, motivate, and develop key talent for the Advanced Analytics team; coach and develop team members
Drive deep partnership with the Hub insights team and other “fellow” Engines and insights generating functions (e.g. regional analytics teams) allowing for a joined delivery of cross-functional, deep impactful insights
Be a champion for a data-driven, decision-making culture

Interested? For this role we’re looking for the following education, experience and skills

Minimum Experience/Skills Required:


Bachelor's degree in quantitative area
Minimum of 8-10+ years experience applying predictive modeling techniques such as ML, decision trees, ensemble learning, neural networks etc, and data transformation such as data cleansing and integration, fuzzy matching, etc., is required
Minimum of 8-10+ years of experience developing program/project plans and leading programs/projects from initiation to implementation is required
At least 8 years of experience working with real world data (Claims data, EMR, IQVIA, -omics, etc)
Minimum of 8-10+ years of experience with programming and application development using Python or R is preferred


Preferred Experience/Skills:


Master/Doctor’s degree in quantitative area
Knowledge of pharmaceutical industry, ideally specialty pharma and biologic treatments
Deep expertise in leveraging data science methodologies within the Research and Development and Clinical trials sphere of the pharmaceutical industry. The Go-to-Market domain encompasses the commercial, medical, and market access facets of the business
Expertise in analyzing a range of large, secondary transactional databases, unstructured data or other computationally difficult challenges
You are a structured problem solver
Possess an 80/20 mindset to push for fast model iterations
Interpret model results and identify potential model errors (e.g., overfitting, model bias, correlation vs causation)
Global role, so willingness and flexibility to work across geographies / time zones (sometimes outside of core hours)


Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About Us

UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?

At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless explicitly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. UCB invites you to voluntarily self-identify during the application process. Provision of self-identification information is entirely voluntary and a decision to provide or not provide such information will not have any effect on your application for employment, your employment with UCB, or otherwise subject you to any adverse treatment. Any information you provide will be considered confidential and will be kept separate from your application and/or personnel file and will only be used in accordance with applicable laws, orders, and regulations.

Should you require any adjustments to our process to assist you in demonstrating your strengths and capabilities contact us on US-Reasonable_Accommodation@ucb.com for application to US based roles. Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments; we will not be able to support you through this channel.

Community: A strong network of experts across AI, Data, Development, and Product.

You are an applied AI enthusiast with a strong “production-first” mindset and a focus on business value.

Experience: 4 to 8 years in Data, AI, or Intelligent Automation.

Introductory Call (15 min): Getting to know you and your career goals.
Digital Sales Manager Interview (45 min): Presenting eXalt and diving into your background.

Final Interview: A meeting with one of our co-founders to discuss vision and cultural fit.


Interested? Apply today and be part of the transformation.

En entreprise, comme en musique, tout est une question de tempo. Depuis 2018, nous réunissons des consultant·e·s passionné·e·s, curieux·ses et ambitieux·ses, uni·e·s par une même conviction : mettre leur expertise au service des défis numériques, sectoriels et industriels de nos clients.

Notre mission ? Accélérer les transformations en combinant excellence opérationnelle, curiosité et audace. Nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs du luxe, du retail, de l’énergie, du transport, du tourisme, de la banque ou encore de l’assurance — partout où la technologie rencontre l’humain.

Nous aimons la tech quand elle connecte et libère les potentiels. Nos consultant·e·s ne se contentent pas de conseiller : ils construisent, testent, mettent en production, mesurent, ajustent et recommencent. Avec nos clients, nous faisons partie du jeu, du début à la fin.

Notre organisation repose sur une culture de la confiance, de l’apprentissage et de la collaboration. Nous avons conçu un cadre unique qui accompagne chaque eXalté·e à chaque étape de sa carrière, avec des rôles clairs, des communautés actives et des rituels qui renforcent le collectif.

Nos eXaltemps trimestriels, notre eXalt Academy et nos projets internes sont autant d’occasions d’apprendre, de partager et de grandir ensemble.

Aujourd’hui présents en France, au Canada, aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni, en Belgique, en Espagne, au Portugal et à Monaco, nous sommes portés par un engagement fort et une énergie contagieuse.

Parce qu’apprendre est notre discipline, agir notre obsession et réussir ensemble notre plus belle victoire.

Pulse. Make. Learn.

Title: Short Term Portfolio Optimization Analyst
Description:
Job Description

As a Short Term Portfolio Optimization Analyst, you play a key role in maximizing the value of Luminus’ gas and power portfolio. Working at the heart of energy markets, you combine analytical expertise, market insight and innovation to optimize short-term operations, improve decision-making and support the performance of our generation assets, renewable portfolio and flexibility solutions.

What You'll Do


You optimize gas and electricity portfolios across Day-Ahead and Intraday markets while balancing technical, economic and regulatory constraints to create maximum value.
Working closely with colleagues across Optimization, Forecasting, Pricing, Middle Office, Back Office, Generation and Finance, you continuously improve and align short-term optimization strategies.
You contribute to the development of advanced optimization solutions, including AI, machine learning, automation and forecasting models that enhance market performance and operational decision-making.
Through market analysis and performance monitoring, you identify improvement opportunities and help adapt strategies related to trading, battery storage, renewable assets, ancillary services and flexibility products.
You support operational excellence by monitoring results, defining meaningful KPIs, preparing analyses and ensuring compliance with internal policies, market obligations and risk frameworks.
Beyond daily operations, you coordinate and contribute to business and IT projects, helping to improve tools, processes and ways of working while sharing knowledge and coaching colleagues.


What You Bring


A university degree in Engineering, Economics, Business Engineering or another relevant discipline, or equivalent experience.
At least 3 to 5 years of experience in the energy sector, utilities or commodities markets, where you developed a strong understanding of market dynamics.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities that enable you to translate complex information into practical actions and recommendations.
Excellent communication skills that allow you to advise stakeholders, transfer knowledge and collaborate effectively across teams.
Experience working independently while remaining highly organized, proactive and focused on quality and continuous improvement.
Knowledge of electricity and gas markets, Microsoft Office, Python and modern AI or machine-learning technologies, combined with fluency in English, Dutch and French.


What you'll get in return?

The energy sector is one of the most rewarding industries in Belgium with a highly rewarding compensation and benefits package:


Competitive compensation: Attractive salary with a performance-based bonus that can be optimized to your personal preferences, plus meal vouchers.
Insurance & social benefits: Group insurance and hospitalization coverage for the entire family. Additional reimbursement for healthcare and pharmaceutical costs.
Mobility: Full reimbursement for public transport, kilometer-based cycling reimbursement and flexible mobility choices: you can choose between a company car or mobility budget.
Internet & communication: Home internet covered, reimbursement for a personal mobile device with a phone subscription.
Home Office: A fully-equipped home office, including an ergonomical ICT set-up.
Exclusive discounts: 30% off gas and electricity after six months, discounts on energy-saving services (e.g., solar panels, heat pumps) and reduced prices on top brands, amusement parks, festivals and more.
You'll work on complex and intellectually stimulating challenges where data, markets, technology and innovation come together.
You'll enjoy a high level of autonomy while collaborating with experts from different business domains across Luminus.
You work and connect with your colleagues at a Luminus office or from home. Need some flexibility? Your manager is open to discuss what works.


Luminus values e.v.e.r.y individual.

Are you looking for a workplace where you can truly be yourself, where you feel respected, supported regardless of your background, identity and unique story? Then you’ve come to the right place. Diversity equity and inclusion are not empty words for us — we grant that everyone can flourish and feel valued, so let’s build it together!

What does that mean in practice?

Do you have specific needs or require adjustments during the recruitment process or once you are hired? Let’s discuss about it and we’ll do our best to find a solution. We can also discuss if you want to work at 80% or 100%.

Together we make the difference.

Description:
Société d’ingénierie informatique et de services du numérique créée en 2004, Qim info est implantée en Suisse 🇨🇭 (Genève, Lausanne, Zurich & Bâle) et en France 🇫🇷 (Annecy, Lyon & Paris). Appartenant au groupe MoOngy, l’entreprise bénéficie aussi d’un réseau de développement international 🌐.

3e entreprise informatique de Suisse romande (ICT Journal), Qim info c’est surtout un ensemble de consultant.e.s capables d’intervenir à tous les niveaux d’un système d’information sur différents métiers (Études & Développement 💻, Fonctionnel 🔧, Infrastructures & Réseaux 🌐, Data 📊, DevOps 🚀...) et différents secteurs d’activités (Banque 🏦, Finance 💰, Assurance 📜, Luxe ✨, Retail 🛍️, Aéronautique ✈️...).

Avec plus de 650 collaborateurs, nous sommes toujours à la recherche de nouveaux talents !




En quelques mots !

Notre client a relancé ses initiatives liées à l’intelligence artificielle au début de l’année 2024, dans le sillage de l’essor de l’IA générative.

À ce jour, plusieurs cas d’usage sont déjà en production, de nombreux autres sont en cours d’étude, et une plateforme cloud a été mise en place (Azure OpenAI, Azure Databricks).




Dans ce contexte, notre client recherche un(e) Data Scientist expérimenté(e) disposant de compétences en MLOps, qui prendra en charge les aspects techniques liés à l’étude de faisabilité, à la caractérisation, à l’implémentation et aux tests de solutions, principalement autour de l’usage de l’IA générative pour :

L’extraction de contenu ;
La synthèse de contenu ;
La construction de bases de données RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) via le traitement et l’analyse de documents ;
Le développement d’agents fiables permettant d’interagir avec ces informations.




Cas d’usage typiques

Mettre à disposition un agent capable de fournir des informations relatives aux CGA (Conditions Générales d’Assurance), y compris l’évaluation des performances du système RAG.
Extraire les informations clés de documents liés aux sinistres afin d’alimenter et d’optimiser le processus de gestion des sinistres.
Résumer les interactions clients et en extraire des enseignements pertinents.




Compétences obligatoires

• Python

• Expérience pratique avec les LLM (Large Language Models)

• MLflow (version minimale 3.12)

• LangChain

Une expérience de mise en œuvre sur Azure Databricks constitue un atout.




Expertise attendue

Maîtrise complète du cycle de vie de développement d’agents IA basés sur les LLM, notamment :

Création d’évaluateurs (evaluators) ;
Mise en place de tests de non-régression ;
Gestion et réconciliation des retours utilisateurs (feedback reconciliation).




Atouts supplémentaires

Une expérience dans le secteur de l’assurance sera considérée comme un avantage.




Informations pratiques !

Lieu : Canton de Vaud
Contrat : CDI
Remote : 2 jours
Langues : Français courant et allemand souhaité

Premier contact : Notre équipe de chargés de recrutement est à votre écoute pour comprendre votre parcours et vos attentes 🎧.

Suivi RH & managérial de qualité : Accompagnement dans votre montée en compétences et vos missions au quotidien 🌟.
Culture d’entreprise : Partagez plus qu’une pause-café ! Qim tech talks, soirées annuelles et trimestrielles, Afterwork Qim... de nombreux événements sont organisés chaque année 🎉.

Title: Machine Learning Scientist II
Description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the team

As a Machine Learning Scientist II, you will join Expedia Group's Air Pricing Machine Learning Science team and develop production machine learning solutions for complex, high-volume airline and travel marketplace challenges. At a high level, the team uses predictive modeling, experimentation, and decision science to understand traveler demand and response to price, improve booking and commercial decisions, and support coordinated optimization across Air pricing levers.

You will work across the machine learning lifecycle, from understanding a business problem and exploring data through model development, causal evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. You will collaborate with experienced scientists, engineers, analysts, product partners, and Air domain experts while continuing to develop your technical and business expertise.

In This Role, You Will


Develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning models that address real-world Air product and business problems.
Translate ambiguous problems into measurable objectives, selecting appropriate data, modeling approaches, and evaluation methods.
Partner with engineers, product managers, scientists, analysts, and Air domain experts to move machine learning solutions from experimentation into reliable products.
Analyze large and complex datasets, identify meaningful patterns, and communicate data-driven recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Design and conduct experiments, apply causal-inference methods where appropriate, interpret results, and iterate on models and workflows to improve accuracy, efficiency, and business and traveler outcomes.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
2+ years of relevant professional experience.
Experience applying machine learning, statistical modeling, or related quantitative methods to technical or product problems, with ownership across a service, product area, or defined technical domain from problem formulation through evaluation and delivery.
Strong programming and data analysis skills, including experience with machine learning methods, model evaluation techniques, and relevant development tools.
Working knowledge of system design, low-level design, API design, and data modeling as they relate to integrating machine learning capabilities into products.


Preferred Qualifications


Advanced degree in machine learning, computer science, statistics, mathematics, economics, operations research, engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Experience or strong domain interest in airlines, travel marketplaces, revenue management, yield management, pricing, or commercial decision science.
Experience operating machine learning models or data products at scale, with attention to reliability, monitoring, maintainability, and responsible performance.
Practical exposure to experimentation or causal-inference methods, such as controlled experiments, quasi-experimental designs, or treatment-effect estimation.
Experience working with large datasets; familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Apache Spark is a plus.
Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products.


Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.
